jobs.occupation: Research technician biobanking and metabolic research
jobs.description:
Are you an accurate and enthusiastic research technician who enjoys working with human biological samples? Join our biobank team and contribute to cutting-edge research into metabolic syndrome and chronic disease prevention. Within the department of Molecular Cell Biology & Immunology at Amsterdam UMC, location VUmc, we are looking for a research technician to support biobanking activities and research within the recently awarded NWA-ORC project Decoding immune-metabolic homeostasis to better understand chronic diseases (META-IMMUNOTYPES). Metabolic syndrome is a major health problem, affecting up to 40% of the population. It increases the risk of developing chronic diseases such as diabetes, cardiovascular disease, obesity and cancer. The META-IMMUNOTYPES consortium studies the complex interaction between the immune system and metabolism in metabolic syndrome and related conditions. By identifying early warning signals, such as hidden inflammation, through simple blood tests and advanced technology, the project aims to shift the focus from treatment to prevention. This could enable lifestyle interventions before symptoms arise. As a research technician, you play a central role in the day-to-day management of our biobank. You are responsible for the accurate collection, processing, registration, storage and distribution of human biological samples, mainly blood. You help ensure that samples and associated data are handled according to established protocols and quality standards. You work closely with researchers, PhD candidates, clinicians and laboratory staff. Besides daily biobanking activities, you contribute to improving workflows, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and laboratory processes within ongoing research projects. Your main activities include: Receiving, processing, registering, storing and retrieving human biological samples, mainly blood. Maintaining accurate sample records, traceability and an organized sample inventory in the biobank database.

Preparing samples for research projects and coordinating sample logistics with researchers, clinical departments and other collaborators. Writing, maintaining and improving SOPs and other biobank documentation, while contributing to quality control and continuous improvement. Supporting general laboratory organization and, where relevant, experimental work within ongoing research projects. We are looking for an enthusiastic colleague who enjoys working accurately and systematically. You take responsibility for maintaining a reliable, high-quality biobank and enjoy working in a multidisciplinary research environment. You have: A completed MBO or HBO laboratory education, HLO degree, or an equivalent qualification in biomedical sciences, life sciences or a related field. Experience with laboratory work, preferably with processing human biological material. An accurate, structured and reliable way of working, with good organizational skills and attention to detail. Affinity with sample administration, documentation and working according to quality-controlled procedures. The ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, with good communication skills in English and/or Dutch. Experience with biobanking, laboratory information management systems (LIMS), electronic lab notebooks, SOPs or quality management systems is an advantage. A flying start to your career in scientific research. Plenty of room for your drive to shape tomorrow's healthcare. Working on large-scale and in-house research, with motivated colleagues from all over the world. You will be employed by Amsterdam UMC Research BV. A contract for 12 months, with the intention to extend for a total of 3 years. Classification in salary scale 7M: € 3.171 to € 4.492 gross for full-time employment (depending on experience). In addition to a good basic salary, we offer 8.3% end-of-year bonus. Calculate your net salary here. Holiday hours: 194.4 per year for full time and a possibility to save

jobs.occupation: PhD metabolic footprint in human enterovirus infections along gut-brain axis
jobs.description:
Do you want to better understand how viruses affect the human body? Then apply for a PhD position to study the metabolic footprint in human enterovirus infections along the gut-brain axis as part of the MERIT MCSA doctoral network. About the project MERIT (MEtabolic Reprogramming in viral pathogenesis: from Infection to Therapeutic innovations) is an EU-funded MSCA training programme aimed at better understanding how viruses affect the human body. Coordinated by Dr. Adithya Sridhar, Assistant Professor, and Prof. Dr. Dasja Pajkrt, Professor of Pediatric Infectious diseases, from the OrganoVIR Labs at Amsterdam UMC (location AMC), this project brings together 7 academic institutions and 12 associated partners from across Europe. Within MERIT, researchers will take a new, holistic approach that focuses on infections and host metabolism to unravel virus-induced metabolic reprogramming and its impact on human health. The project’s objective lies in understanding the complex interplay between viruses and host cells, focusing on metabolic reprogramming, and long-term consequences of infection. This will be achieved by combining three methodological pillars: human organoids, integrative and spatial omics, and advanced microscopy. About the role Different enteroviruses genotypes exhibit distinct disease presentations, as demonstrated by recent studies using human brain organoids. Clinical differences are associated with differential inflammatory responses, but the underlying metabolic changes driving these varied immune responses remain unexplored. Emerging evidence suggests that enterovirus infections significantly alter the host metabolic landscape, affecting glucose, glutamine, lipid, and nucleotide metabolism. This doctoral project aims to study the hypothesis that early metabolic changes are key determinants of long-term clinical outcomes of enterovirus infections. To test this, the metabolic landscape following infections with enteroviruses belonging to different

species will be investigated along the gut-brain axis, with the use of immunocompetent and immunodeficient patient-derived organoids. At the Amsterdam UMC in the Netherlands, MERIT is looking for a Doctoral Candidate (DC) to work on Work Packages 1 and 3. As DC10, your objectives are: to study metabolic changes during infection with enteroviruses belonging to species B and C in gut and brain organoids; to study differences in host responses between immunocompetent and immunodeficient patient gut organoids; to perform integrative omics and genome-scale metabolic modelling for EV-B and EV-C infected organoids. You will be guided during your research project by Dr. Katja Wolthers and Dr. Adithya Sridhar. You can apply for this position until 30 October 2026. Applications submitted after this date will not be considered. Profile master's degree in biomedical sciences, infection, immunity or related fields; experience working with viruses, mammalian cell culture, qPCR, and bioinformatics are preferred; excellent oral and written communication skills in English (minimum C1/C2 CEFR level); an interest in working in a multidisciplinary research group; have not resided/carried out work or studies in the Netherlands for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before 1 April 2027 (transnational mobility rule). Our offer A contract with the Amsterdam UMC for 36 hours per week for 4 years (probation of 6 months). The opportunity to work on large-scale and in-house research with motivated colleagues from all over the world. Planned secondments in the Justus Liebig University Giessen (Germany) and the Medical University Innsbruck (Austria), Training in safety and biosecurity aligned with international best practices. You will be trained in hazard identification, containment, incident reporting, and dual-use/gain-of-function issues. Of course: you spend a lot of time on the road and transport (often) goods from A to B. But behind that steering wheel lies a profession where responsibility, independence, and craftsmanship come together. Whether you are just starting or have been driving for years: this is what you need to know as a truck driver. You are the business card on wheels 
As a driver, you represent not only yourself, but also your employer and the client. You are present on customer sites, at loading and unloading locations, and sometimes even at private addresses. A professional attitude, clear communication, and keeping agreements are therefore just as important as good driving skills. Safety always comes first 
Safe working as a professional driver is not a side issue. You deal with heavy vehicles, changing weather conditions, and busy traffic. Knowing and respecting driving and rest time regulations is essential, as is correctly securing cargo. Even small things, such as getting in and out safely, staying alert when reversing, and paying attention to blind spots, make a big difference. If you want to refresh this knowledge, you can consider the training 'Updating professional competence for drivers'. This also falls under the Code 95 regulation. 
In addition, it is important not only to drive safely, but also to know how to act when something goes wrong. Training such as first aid (EHBO), emergency response (BHV), and VCA provides practical knowledge about working safely, recognizing risks, and acting correctly in case of incidents. Would you like to uncover how genetic factors shape brain activity and behaviour? Join the international ENIGMA-EEG consortium and use large-scale genetic and EEG data to investigate brain development and mental health. Genetic factors influence how the brain processes information and regulates behaviour. However, the pathways linking genes to brain function remain poorly understood. In this project, you will investigate the genetic basis of brain activity, focusing on electroencephalographic (EEG) oscillations. These oscillations reflect important processes in communication between brain cells. As part of the international ENIGMA-EEG consortium, you will combine genetic and EEG data to investigate how genes influence brain activity, behavioural traits and mental health. You will identify genetic variants associated with EEG features, explore their effects on brain activity and investigate links between genetic risk factors and neurodevelopment. This interdisciplinary, NWO-funded project brings together large-scale datasets and advanced analytical methods, including machine learning, genomics and transcriptomics. Your research will contribute to identifying new EEG biomarkers for mental health disorders and improving our understanding of brain development from childhood to old age. As a postdoctoral researcher in imaging genetics, you will coordinate data access and integration across the participating ENIGMA-EEG cohorts. You will help develop research projects, communicate with international collaborators and monitor progress across the consortium. Working with researchers from different disciplines, you will analyse large-scale genetic and EEG datasets through meta-analyses. You will translate your findings into scientific publications and conference presentations. You will also contribute to developing protocols and workflows that standardise EEG analyses across cohorts. Your responsibilities include: Coordinating data collection, access and integration across

participating cohorts. Developing research projects in collaboration with international consortium members. Conducting meta-analyses of genetic and EEG data and contributing to scientific publications. Developing and implementing standardised protocols and workflows for EEG analyses. Presenting research findings at scientific conferences and collaborating with researchers across international sites. You will have opportunities to develop your expertise in advanced data analysis methods, including genome-wide association studies (GWAS), polygenic scoring, machine learning, advanced EEG analyses and multi-site statistics. We will support your professional development through training and collaboration with experts in genetics, neuroscience and data analysis. The role also offers opportunities to visit collaborating research groups. You are an enthusiastic and independent researcher who enjoys working across disciplines and collaborating with international research teams. You are interested in the genetic basis of brain function and mental health and are keen to develop your analytical skills. You also have: A PhD in imaging genetics, genetic epidemiology, neuroscience, biological psychology or a related field. A strong interest in the project's research topics and the motivation to engage with ENIGMA-EEG cohort members worldwide. Experience with data analysis using scripting languages or tools such as Bash, Python and/or R. Experience in genetic analysis or physiological data analysis; experience in both is an advantage. Experience implementing neural networks is an advantage. Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. You will be employed by Amsterdam UMC Research BV. A 12-month contract, with the intention to extend it for an additional year. Classification in salary scale 10: € 3.724 to € 5.867 gross for full-time employment (depending on experience). In addition to a good basic salary, we offer 8.3% end-of-year bonus. Calculate your net salary

Data scarcity is a major challenge for developing European sovereign foundation models, especially for low-resource languages where additional training data is inherently limited. A promising solution is cross-lingual transfer: training models on related languages can improve performance on a target language more effectively than adding more data from the target language itself. 
The recent ATLAS study (Longpre et al. , 2025) is the largest empirical investigation of this effect to date, training 774 multilingual models across 50 languages and introducing the Bilingual Transfer Score (BTS) to measure how much one language benefits another. The study found that shared language family and script are the strongest predictors of transfer effectiveness. 
However, Dutch was not included in the ATLAS language set. This creates both a scientific and practical gap. jobs.occupation: Sparagus - Principal Architect — OS & System Performance
jobs.description:
The R&D Center of a global leading ICT company, based in Amsterdam.

We are looking for a senior architect to drive the design and development of advanced OS-level system performance technologies and Hardware-software-chip co-optimization for next-generation computing devices.

The role focuses on system scheduling and performance optimization across CPU, GPU, memory, operating system, and chipset layers, balancing performance, power consumption, and thermal constraints. You will work across operating system, Hardware, chipset, runtime, and application layers, driving technologies from architecture and research through implementation and deployment on end devices.
Responsibilities

• Design and develop Hardware-software-chip co-optimization and integrated system scheduling technologies, including CPU/GPU/DDR scheduling, priority management, task grouping, core selection, frequency scaling, resource allocation, and performance/power/thermal-aware scheduling.

• Research and optimize application performance at the OS level, improving application interaction, responsiveness, animation smoothness, and overall system performance.

• Design and optimize high-performance core system modules and resolve critical system performance bottlenecks.

• Research and develop high-performance APIs, runtimes, application frameworks, and performance-oriented system technologies.

• Track advanced industry technologies and academic research and contribute to future technical roadmaps for system performance, scheduling, and Hardware-software co-optimization.

• Drive technical solutions from architecture and research through implementation, validation, and deployment on end devices.

Strong expertise in one or more of the following areas:

• OS or kernel performance optimization

• CPU/GPU/DDR scheduling and system resource management

• Hardware-software or chipset-level co-optimization

• Power- and thermal-aware scheduling and optimization

• Application or runtime performance optimization

• High-performance system, runtime, or framework design

In addition:

• Strong understanding of operating system architecture and system performance fundamentals.

• Hands-on experience identifying and resolving complex system performance bottlenecks.

• Proven ability to deliver measurable performance improvements in real-world systems or products.

• Strong problem-solving and engineering execution capabilities, with the ability to drive solutions from architecture and design through implementation.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and the ability to collaborate effectively across international research and engineering teams.

Preferred skills:

• Experience with Linux, Android, or other modern operating-system platforms.

• Experience with kernel scheduling, Dvfs/frequency scaling, heterogeneous computing, graphics/GPU systems, memory systems, or chipset-level optimization.

• Experience working across Hardware and software boundaries on complex computing platforms.

• Experience translating research or advanced technical concepts into production-level system technologies.

The past decades have been associated with substantial losses of sea ice over both hemispheres. Existing climate models are currently unable to accurately forecast these changes, in part due to their imperfect representation of ocean and sea ice interactions at sub-grid scales. 
This project aims to improve our physical understanding of these fine-scale processes, including the melting and breakage of sea ice, using a framework consisting of an ocean Large Eddy Simulation (LES) and a Discrete Element Model (DEM) of sea ice. Results from these simulations will be validated against a combination of in-situ and remote sensing data from both the Arctic and Antarctic sea ice regions. Based on this new understanding, the candidate will develop parameterizations that can emulate these physics for use in more coarsely-resolved climate models. 
This fully-funded position is part of the European Research Council (ERC) 'ICE-FLOE' project, and will involve collaborations with other team members at TU Delft and internationally. There may also be the opportunity to assist with a research cruise in Antarctica.

 Without insight into costs, no grip on results. We provide control, predictability and better financial accountability. - Contact us directly 
Projects run over budget or returns lag behind? This is often due to insufficient insight into the relationship between progress, costs and planning. With good cost control you can avoid financial surprises and make timely adjustments. What is cost control and why is it crucial? 
Cost control, or cost management, is the process of monitoring, analyzing and adjusting project costs against budget. It is closely related to cost management: the broader set of financial control within projects. 
Well-organized cost control makes project costs predictable, controllable and accountable to the client, management and board. Especially in technical or long-term projects, this is essential to maintain trust, both internally and externally. cost control 
 How does cost control work within project organizations? 
Effective cost control starts with a reasoned budget, but it doesn't stop there. Throughout the project, we continue to test continuously: - How far along are we really in implementation? - What have we spent so far? - How does this compare with the original budget and schedule? - Do we need to make adjustments, and if so, where and when? 
We set up processes and reports in such a way that you have real-time insight into these dynamics. Not explaining afterwards, but signaling beforehand. 
 Earned Value Management (EVM): measuring = knowing 
Earned Value Management (EVM) is a widely used methodology within cost control. It links three dimensions together: - Budget (planned value) - Actual cost - Progress/performance (earned value). 
By monitoring these integrally, you gain early insight into deviations and trends. Ditio applies EVM as part of a broader control framework, tailored to your organization, systems and projects.

Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Barendrecht As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online, you make sure customers receive their online grocery orders at home. Your shift starts in Barendrecht, where you prepare for the route ahead. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel and drive to the first customer on your schedule. At each address, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You hand over the groceries carefully, provide friendly service and collect empty crates when necessary. Once the delivery is complete, you continue to the next stop. Driving is only one part of your working day. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk between the vehicle and customers' homes and lift grocery crates. This makes the role a combination of driving, physical activity and customer contact. After completing your final delivery, you return to the location in Barendrecht and finish your shift. Frequently asked questions Do I need previous delivery experience? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier is not required. You will receive training before working independently. During your first working days, you can join an experienced colleague and learn how a normal delivery route works in practice. What are the working hours?

There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Is Saturday availability required? Yes. You must be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is this a physically active job? Yes. You will regularly carry grocery crates and walk between the delivery van and customers' doors. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks throughout your shift. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Barendrecht You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You are comfortable working independently. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Previous delivery experience is not required. Interested in working as a delivery driver in Barendrecht? Apply through Consolid for Albert Heijn Online. At Vanderlande, we serve customers worldwide by building highly flexible material handling systems out of configurable building blocks. To drive these systems, our Model Based Design (MBD) workflow uses tools like MATLAB/Simulink to develop and test controllers in virtual environments before generating code for various PLC platforms (such as Siemens PLC, Allen-Bradley PLC, and C++). While automated code generation enables versatile deployment, it often makes the generated code unreadable for controls engineers on customer sites, leaving them heavily reliant on basic interface statistics during troubleshooting. 
In this hands-on project, you will explore new ways to make control software transparent and accessible for site engineers. Focusing on solutions like Simatic Target for Simulink, you will investigate how engineers can deploy generated code while maintaining visual access to the original model. You will analyze current MBD workflows, test new tools on existing OT modules, and evaluate how this way of working improves debugging efficiency and commissioning on site. Department description 
You will join the Model Based Design (MBD) team within the Technology department, where we develop reusable Operational Technology (OT) modules applied across Vanderlande's global solution portfolio. Our team bridges systems engineering, simulation, software development, and industrial automation.

Join Albert Heijn Online in Amersfoort as a delivery driver. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21, with part-time and full-time options. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The option to receive your salary weekly or every four weeks. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amersfoort As a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online, you make sure online grocery orders reach customers in Amersfoort and the surrounding area. At the beginning of your shift, you check the route planned for you and prepare for departure. Once everything is ready, you get behind the wheel and drive to your first customer. At each stop, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's front door. You hand over the groceries carefully and provide friendly service. If the customer has empty crates to return, you take these back with you. Then it is time for the next address. This makes every shift a combination of driving and physical activity. You regularly get in and out of the van, walk to customers' doors and carry grocery crates. At the same time, you have the freedom and responsibility of completing your route independently. Once all orders have been delivered, you return to the location in Amersfoort and complete your shift. Do I need previous experience? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier is not required. When you start, you will receive practical training and can join an experienced colleague during your first working days. This helps you become familiar with the job before

driving routes independently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Is Saturday availability mandatory? Yes. You need to be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. What does a typical shift involve? You drive between customers, deliver their grocery orders and provide friendly service at the door. The role also involves regular physical activity, including lifting grocery crates, walking to customers' homes and getting in and out of the delivery van throughout your shift. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amersfoort You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You can work independently and responsibly. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed shifts. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Would you like an active driving job in Amersfoort? Apply through Consolid and start as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online. You have a good job. But you feel there’s more in it for you.

At our client, that’s exactly the challenge.
Today, the global fleet is still largely managed through manual spreadsheets. Data is fragmented, often outdated, and not available in real time.
You are going to fundamentally change that.
For one of the world’s largest tank container leasing companies — managing over 75,000 tank containers globally — we are looking for a Data Analyst for an internationally focused, centrally positioned role based in Rotterdam.
In this role, you don’t just report on numbers — you directly influence the deployment, availability, and planning of tank containers worldwide. Your work ensures that stakeholders across the globe can generate accurate, real-time reports at any moment and use them for decision-making.
This level of tangible impact is rare in a data analyst role.

Our client is one of the largest tank container leasing companies in the world. With a global fleet and international customer base, data plays an increasingly critical role in its success.
The organization is undergoing a transition from manual, Excel-driven processes to data-driven operations with real-time insights.

This role suits you if you look beyond numbers and want to make a real impact in an international supply chain environment.

jobs.description:
Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Amsterdam. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in from age 21 and choose part-time or full-time hours. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83 from age 21. Travel allowance. Pension scheme. Holiday allowance and vacation days. The choice of weekly or four-weekly salary payments. Part-time and full-time opportunities. Morning shifts from 06:00 AM to 02:00 PM. Afternoon/evening shifts from 03:00 PM to 11:00 PM. Practical training when you start. The opportunity to ride along with an experienced colleague during your first working days. Opportunities to develop within Albert Heijn Online and Consolid. A €150 net Bring a Friend bonus, subject to the applicable conditions. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam Your working day starts at the Albert Heijn Online Home Shop Center at Beiraweg 6 in Amsterdam. Before leaving, you check your route and prepare the delivery van for the shift ahead. Once everything is ready, you head out to deliver groceries to customers throughout Amsterdam and the surrounding area. At every stop, you take the correct grocery order from the van and carry the crates to the customer's door. You make sure the order is delivered carefully and provide friendly service during the handover. Empty crates may also need to be taken back with you. Then you continue to your next address. Driving is an important part of the position, but you will also spend plenty of time on your feet. Getting in and out of the van, walking to customers' doors and lifting grocery crates are all part of a normal working day. The routes take you through different parts of Amsterdam and the surrounding area, so your surroundings and customers change throughout the day. After completing your final delivery, you return to Beiraweg 6, finish your route and leave the van ready for the next shift. Do I need previous delivery experience? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier

is not required. You will receive training when you start, and during your first working days you can join an experienced colleague. This gives you the opportunity to learn the job in practice before driving routes independently. What are the working hours? There are two main shifts: Morning shift: 06:00 AM – 02:00 PM Afternoon/evening shift: 03:00 PM – 11:00 PM Both part-time and full-time opportunities are available. Do I have to work on Saturdays? You need to be available for at least two Saturdays per month. This is a mandatory requirement for the position. Is the job physically demanding? The position involves regular physical activity. You will carry grocery crates, walk between the delivery van and customers' doors and get in and out of the vehicle throughout your shift. You therefore need to be physically able to perform these tasks safely. Functie eisen Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Amsterdam You have a valid category B driving licence. You are physically able to lift and carry grocery crates. You are friendly and customer-focused. You are comfortable working independently. You have a sufficient command of Dutch and/or English. You are available for the agreed working hours. You can work at least two Saturdays per month. Interested in working on the road in Amsterdam? Apply through Consolid for the position of Delivery Driver at Albert Heijn Online. For questions about the vacancy, contact Seyyed by phone or WhatsApp at 06 83110102, or email s.parwiz@consolid.nl.

Job description 
The past decades have been associated with substantial losses of sea ice over both hemispheres. Existing climate models are currently unable to accurately forecast these changes, in part due to their imperfect representation of ocean and sea ice interactions at sub-grid scales. 
This project aims to improve our physical understanding of these fine-scale processes, including the melting and breakage of sea ice, using a framework consisting of an ocean Large Eddy Simulation (LES) and a Discrete Element Model (DEM) of sea ice. Results from these simulations will be validated against a combination of in-situ and remote sensing data from both the Arctic and Antarctic sea ice regions. Based on this new understanding, the candidate will develop parameterizations that can emulate these physics for use in more coarsely-resolved climate models. 
This fully-funded position is part of the European Research Council (ERC) 'ICE-FLOE' project, and will involve collaborations with other team members at TU Delft and internationally. There may also be the opportunity to assist with a research cruise in Antarctica.

Functieomschrijving Grocery Delivery Driver Geldermalsen | Part-Time | Flexible Schedule Your shift starts at the Albert Heijn Online depot at Randweg 2 in Geldermalsen. After collecting your handheld scanner and route information, you carefully load your delivery van with grocery orders. You will independently deliver groceries to customers throughout Geldermalsen and the surrounding area. Every day you meet different customers, answer their questions, process payments when necessary and ensure every delivery is completed safely and on time. You also collect empty crates, handle returns and verify age-restricted products according to Dutch regulations. After completing your route, you return to the depot, unload your van and report any important details before ending your shift. Can I choose my working hours? Yes. You provide your availability and work between 12 and a maximum of 28 hours per week. Is this an active job? Yes. Besides driving, you regularly lift grocery crates and stay active throughout your shift. In electric vehicles, the propulsion system operates at high voltages. These can pose a danger to people who have to work on these vehicles. The employer is responsible for the safety of the staff. The EV workshop supervisor (EV-WV) is the one who is actually in charge of the work on e-vehicles. 
In this e-learning you will learn what the NEN 9140 standard entails and what the standard regulates for those who work on e-vehicles in the workshop.  PhD Position in Ocean - Sea Ice Interactions (Delft, NL, 2628 CD) Delft University of Technology (TU Delft) 
Intern 
 Posted on Sep 22, 2026 
Deploy detailed models of coupled ocean / sea ice processes, probe their turbulent interactions, compare with observations, and design parameterizations for global climate models. 
Job description 
The past decades have been associated with substantial losses of sea ice over both hemispheres. Existing climate models are currently unable to accurately forecast these changes, in part due to their imperfect representation of ocean and sea ice interactions at sub-grid scales. 
This project aims to improve our physical understanding of these fine-scale processes, including the melting and breakage of sea ice, using a framework consisting of an ocean Large Eddy Simulation (LES) and a Discrete Element Model (DEM) of sea ice. Work as a delivery driver for Albert Heijn Online in Oosterhout, Gelderland. Earn €18.83 gross per hour all-in and work 12-32 hours per week. Wat bieden wij? An all-in gross hourly wage of €18.83, including holiday allowance and applicable allowances. 25 vacation days based on full-time employment. Pension accrual. Travel allowance. A flexible position for 12 to 32 hours per week. The opportunity to submit your own availability. Shifts from Monday through Sunday. Morning, afternoon and evening shifts. Practical training with an experienced buddy. Employee discount through the Albert Heijn Bonus Card. Opportunities to develop within the role, for example by becoming a buddy for new drivers. Functieomschrijving Delivery Driver Albert Heijn Online | Oosterhout, Gelderland Your working day starts at the Albert Heijn Online location at Linie 11 in Oosterhout, Gelderland. Here, you collect the keys to your delivery van, check the route for your shift and get ready to head out. Once on the road, navigation guides you from one customer to the next. Your route can take you through Oosterhout and other places in the surrounding area, so every shift can look a little different. When you arrive at an address, you select the correct grocery order from the van and check it using a handheld scanner. You then carry the crates to the customer's front door and make sure the order is handed over correctly. Customer contact is an important part of the job. You greet customers in a friendly way, help with questions when necessary and process payments if required. Empty crates and returnable packaging can also be collected before you continue your route. After completing the delivery, you get back behind the wheel and head to the next address. Although driving is a major part of the role, you will not spend your entire shift sitting down. You regularly get in and out of t

van, walk to customers' doors and lift grocery crates. This makes the job a good combination of driving, physical activity and customer service. Once you have completed your final delivery, you return to Linie 11. You finish your route, return the necessary equipment and leave the delivery van ready for the next shift. Do I need experience as a delivery driver? No. Previous experience as a delivery driver or courier is not required. During your first working days, you will be trained by an experienced buddy. You will learn how to use the delivery van, handheld scanner and systems, as well as how to deliver orders and deal with different situations at the customer's door. Once you are familiar with the job, you can start driving your routes independently. Can I submit my own availability? Yes. You can let us know when you are available, and this will be taken into account when the schedule is created. You can work between 12 and 32 hours per week. For this position, you need to be available for at least two shifts per week and at least two Saturdays per month. What does a typical shift involve? You start at Linie 11, collect your van and check your route. You then drive to the customers scheduled for your shift. At each stop, you scan and deliver the groceries, help the customer when needed and collect empty crates. After your final delivery, you return to the location and complete your shift. Can I develop within this role? Yes. Once you have gained experience, there are opportunities to take on additional responsibilities. For example, you may become a buddy and help train new delivery drivers during their first working days. jobs.description:
Are you an Exterior Engineer, CAD Engineer or Product Design Engineer based in Portugal and ready to work on unique, high-end technical projects? Xelvin is looking for an engineer who wants to relocate to the Netherlands and contribute to the exterior design and engineering of luxury superyachts. In this role, you will translate design ideas and customer requirements into smart, manufacturable and high-quality technical solutions. You will work on exterior elements such as railings, sliding door systems, sunshade systems, masts, decorative elements, exterior panels and other visible parts of the yacht. This role combines technical engineering, design sensitivity and practical manufacturability. The exterior of a superyacht must not only function perfectly, but also look flawless. What you will do As an Exterior Engineer, you will be part of a multidisciplinary engineering team. You will work closely with project engineers, architects, production teams and external partners. Your responsibilities include: Creating and developing 3D models for exterior yacht components. Translating design concepts into practical and manufacturable solutions. Engineering exterior parts such as railings, doors, sunshade systems, panels, masts and decorative elements. Checking technical feasibility, quality, cost efficiency and production requirements. Working with other disciplines to make sure exterior systems fit with the overall yacht design. Supporting production and suppliers with clear technical information. Identifying technical risks and proposing smart improvements. Contributing ideas to improve quality, efficiency and manufacturability. Monitoring the technical consistency of your scope within the project. You will work on custom-built projects where every detail must match the overall design and quality standard. What Xelvin offers you A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A gross monthly salary between €3,700 and €5,500, depending on experience.

Relocation support from Portugal to the Netherlands. Help with documentation, registration and practical relocation matters. Guidance from our housing consultant. Paid holidays and holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Training and development opportunities. Personal guidance from Xelvin during the full relocation process. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for engineers with experience in product design, industrial design, shipbuilding, metalwork, exterior systems or high-end technical engineering. You have: A technical education such as Curso Técnico Superior Profissional, Licenciatura, Mestrado or comparable experience. A background in Industrial Design, Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, Naval Architecture, Shipbuilding, Furniture/Interior Technology or a related technical field. At least 3 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: industrial product design; shipbuilding or marine engineering; yacht interiors or yacht exteriors; metal structures, aluminium or stainless steel components; high-end custom engineering. Strong experience with 2D and 3D CAD software. Experience with SolidWorks, Rhino, AutoCAD, Inventor, Siemens NX, CATIA, Fusion 360 or similar software. Good understanding of manufacturability, materials and technical detailing. A strong eye for shape, finish and visual quality. Good English communication skills. Motivation to relocate from Portugal to the Netherlands. Dutch is not required. Willingness to learn Dutch over time is a plus. Hier kom je te werken Our client is a leading organization in the Dutch superyacht industry. The company designs, engineers and builds custom-made luxury yachts for international clients. Every project is unique and requires close collaboration between design, engineering, production, suppliers and specialist partners. The working environment is technical, international and quality-driven, with a strong focus on craftsmanship, innovation and tailor-made solutions.

Senior Database Administrator 

 

Satellit operates a substantial portfolio of mobility assets across multiple European markets and is accelerating its shift toward digital services to improve the customer experience. To support this journey we are hiring a senior database administrator to take responsibility for the current database estate, maintain performance, security and availability, and lead the migration from on-premises data centres to a public cloud environment.
Who are you?

What will you do?

• Deploy, configure, upgrade, administer, monitor and maintain the organisation's relational databases both on-site and in the cloud.

• Define, enforce and document configuration, security and data-integrity standards for databases and related objects; keep operational procedures and technical documentation current.

• Design, implement and operate backup, restore and high-availability arrangements, and coordinate regular disaster-recovery exercises.

• Assess, plan and execute migration of database workloads to a public cloud platform using managed database services, managed instances or database servers on cloud virtual machines, collaborating with cloud engineers.

• Enforce security best practices including least-privilege access, encryption of data at rest and in transit, auditing and patch management.

• Act as a primary responder and escalation point for database incidents and service requests, aiming to minimise downtime and service impact.

• Carry out root-cause investigations for database issues and implement corrective measures to prevent recurrence.

• Review and advise on database schemas and design changes with development teams to ensure scalability, maintainability and security.

• Continuously monitor performance and resource usage, perform query and index optimisation, and forecast capacity and cost implications.

Technologies (mandatory)

• Azure Cloud Platform

• SQL

• Security

• SQL Server

• Postgresql

• Conscientiousness

• Motivation and positive mindset

• Ability to work independently

• Quick learning and strong organizational skills

• Excellent verbal and written communication

• Customer-centric approach

• Teamwork

• Willingness to ask difficult questions

• Professionalism

• Transparency and solution orientation

Preferred Qualifications:

• Minimum seven years of hands-on experience administering databases in production environments where availability and reliability are critical, with deep expertise in mainstream commercial relational database systems.

• Proven experience designing and operating high-availability and disaster-recovery solutions such as synchronous replication and failover clustering.

• Strong proficiency in SQL, including query tuning and execution-plan analysis.

• Practical experience deploying and managing database workloads in a public cloud environment, including managed database offerings and cloud-hosted virtual machines.

• Experience migrating databases from on-premises infrastructure to cloud platforms is highly desirable.

• Familiarity with open-source relational databases is an advantage.

• Ability to automate repetitive tasks using scripting or general-purpose programming languages; experience with infrastructure-as-code or CI/CD for database changes is a plus.

• Track record of leading database projects such as major version upgrades, consolidation initiatives or security-hardening efforts.

• Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; relevant cloud database or IT service-management certifications are beneficial.

• Fluent written and spoken English, plus fluency in either French or Dutch.

The systems that track assets, flag maintenance needs and inform mission readiness do not run on gut feeling, they run on clean data and sharp analysis. As Analytics Engineer you will split your time between being embedded at a defence customer site as part of a structured Forward Deployed Engineer team and contributing to the Product Engineering Team, turning raw operational data into the dashboards and insights that operational teams actually rely on. The rotation structure means you carry real on-site ownership while a full team provides backup and coverage; you are not alone.

Your Mission

• Own the SQL layer end-to-end, from raw source data through to production-ready models, with performance and maintainability as the standard.
• Build and maintain analytical and dimensional models that underpin asset tracking, maintenance workflows, readiness reporting and mission planning, datasets that operational teams act on, not prototypes.
• Author and publish dashboards and views in close cooperation with client stakeholders, translating operational requirements into analytical deliverables that are clear, accurate and fit for a defence environment.
• Apply Python for data transformation, lightweight analysis and integration glue work, keeping pipelines reliable and documented.
• Elicit and interpret requirements directly from French- and Dutch-speaking client teams when forward deployed, then translate those needs into concrete analytical outputs.
• Own testing and technical documentation during on-site rotations, with clean handover to the wider engineering, testing and documentation teams between deployments.

What success looks like

Over time, the client teams you support will reach for your dashboards first because the data behind them is trustworthy and the models are built to last. Requirements you gather on-site translate cleanly into working deliverables. Domain experts recognise that you understood what they needed — not just what they said. The components you build are documented well enough that the wider team can maintain, extend and take them into operational use without relying on your recall.

What you bring

• Production-grade SQL, complex transformations, modelling and query optimisation, not basic retrieval.
• Practical Python scripting for ETL, data transformation, analysis and automation; this is not a software engineering role, but the code you write must be clean and maintainable.
• Analytical and dimensional modelling at mid-to-senior level — this is the core technical differentiator for the role.
• Dashboard authoring experience in at least one BI or analytical tool; you will work with proprietary tooling here and ramp up on it after joining, so transferable experience is what counts.
• Consulting and requirements-gathering skills, when forward deployed you are the primary client interface, and the ability to elicit, interpret and translate operational requirements is essential.

The language requirement and clearance eligibility are firm; for everything else, we consider the overall strength of your experience.

If this appeals to you, we warmly invite you to apply!

What will you do? 
 

To support a strategic memory technology program in our 300 mm semiconductor pilot line, imec is looking for a Process Engineer to join our Deposition and Diffusion Development Engineering Team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, optimizing, and sustaining advanced semiconductor processes used in next-generation memory devices. You will work at the intersection of process development, equipment engineering, manufacturing operations, and device integration, helping to drive innovative technologies from concept to implementation. Typical responsibilities include:
 
 

• Developing and optimizing deposition processes for advanced memory applications. 

• Managing process qualifications and equipment performance to ensure stable and reproducible manufacturing. 

• Coordinating critical lot movement and operational activities within the cleanroom. 

• Stabilizing and simplifying memory process flows to improve manufacturability and cycle time. 

• Evaluating and introducing new materials for future memory technology requirements. 

• Driving Statistical Process Control (SPC) implementation, monitoring, and documentation. 

• Supporting tool installation, qualification, and technology transfer activities. 

• Collaborating with cross-functional teams across process integration, device engineering, operations, and equipment engineering. 

• Daily follow-up of process & tool qualification, stability, improvements and problem prevention 

• Troubleshooting issues related to the processing and enables first and second line trouble shooters to step up 

• Investigating recurring issues, focusing on root cause analysis and structural solutions 

• Designing experimental plans and executes them in the cleanroom, performing data analysis and taking care of reporting and documentation. 

• Depending on project requirements, your scope may be extended to include Dry Etch, Clean, CMP, and related process modules. 

• Working in a dynamic multidisciplinary and multicultural environment in close cooperation with researchers, hardware engineers, operations, industry assignees, device and process experts 

• You are willing to work in a shift regime (early/late) and 1 weekend out of 4, in order to support the continuous FAB production.  

In summary, a very diverse and interesting role with significant responsibilities that allow you to gain a lot of expertise and build a large internal and external network.

Who are you?
 

We welcome applications both from experienced engineers as well as fresh graduates. Please include a motivation letter in your application. Minimum requirements:
 
 

• You obtained a master’s in science or in Engineering or equal to this, and you display strong engineering skills and mindset. 

• 3 years industrial or advanced research experience in semiconductor process mainly in the deposition area. 

• Additional knowledge of memory process integration, Dry and wet etch/clean, CMP and metrology is considered a plus. 

• You can rapidly adapt to changes in circumstances by being able to change priorities at very short notice 

• A process & quality driven problem solver: you manage multiple priorities in a flexible manner in a continuously changing environment with a proactive “can do” attitude 

• You take ownership and you enjoy completing your tasks autonomously 

• Knowledge and experience of various process control and improvement techniques (e.g., SPC, Cp/CpK, FMEA, 8D, 6sigma, etc.). 

• As you will work in cross functional teams, strong communication and reporting skills are required 

• You are a flexible team player, and you enjoy working in environments where experiences and knowledge are shared with colleagues 

• Given the international character of imec, written and verbal fluency in English is a must  

Additional requirements considered as an asset:
 
 

• Any knowledge in advanced software packages (Python, Matlab, JMP, Minitab, Klarity, E3/FDC, etc.)

Our work balances the development of novel and beneficial applications with efforts to mitigate potential risks associated with these technologies. As a military research lab, we focus on applications in public security and Defense. Examples of practical applications include ground robots for detecting and neutralizing landmines, unmanned vehicles for patrolling tough complex conditions, and studies to improve vehicle and environmental conditions.

 

In this position, you will work alongside a large team of research engineers, each leading their own projects. Your role will be to assist in the implementation of various projects, by contributing to the related electro-mechanical aspects. Given our strong involvement in European-scale collaborative projects, you will punctually prepare and follow on-site test campaigns, mainly on military test sites in Flanders, sometimes abroad.

 

WHAT WE OFFER within the projects

• Highly varied job content, giving you the opportunity to work on a very wide range of novel electro-mechanical systems (air, ground, maritime) in a very international context. You will be deployed in a large variety of projects and will be required to work together with dozens of researchers and other technicians to reach objectives. To make this a bit more specific, you will be deployed as an example in these projects:
• TiPODS: To support the construction (steelwork, electronics, automation), commissioning, maintenance, and usage of a test facility for land vehicle tires testing.
• AURORA: To support the development of a new generation of demining robots with dual manipulators
• STRATUS: To develop novel drones that are composed maximally of EU-sourced & developed components
• Opportunity to work in and with an international & dynamic team of research engineers.
• The flexibility and freedom to innovate and bring your own ideas.
• The ability to have an impact and work on societally relevant topics. As an example: many of our research projects are currently seeking solutions for mine clearance in Ukraine.
• An employer that strives towards maintaining a good work-life balance for its employees.
• Training opportunities to get new practical skills and/or improve your current skills (potential example: machinery certifications, heavy trailer driving license, A2-pilot flying license).
• Possibility of travelling for field trials with partners.
MAIN TASKS

• Manufacture mechanical components for scientific research (machining, welding, etc.).
• Utilize specialized instruments (sensor installation, cameras, measurement devices, etc.).
• Conduct mechanical and electrical tests on test benches, ensuring compliance with international standards.
• Calibrate and test laboratory equipment for specific experiments.
• Actively contribute to all project phases, including metalwork, electrical/electronical work, technical drawing, and system assembly.
• Participate in test campaigns (including equipment preparation, maintenance, execution, and problem solving).
• Assist in procurement and maintenance of equipment (including repairs and calibration of instruments). 
SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

The applicant shall have a professional bachelor's degree in electromechanics (a level 6 qualification according to the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) or similar) and should have relevant experience in the field of electronics, metalwork, and mechatronics.

Explicitly, we are not looking for an academic profile but a technical professional profile!

 

This position is ideally open for experienced profiles (minimum 3 years of experience).

However, young graduates are also encouraged to apply.

 

¿MUST HAVE¿ skills:

• Proven experience with electro-mechanical systems and troubleshooting
• Knowledge of security measures to perform work related to electricity (certifiable BA4/BA5 or similar)
• Demonstrated ability to think outside the box and devise innovative solutions to technical challenges in the field (a "MacGyver" mindset). In other words, a problem solver
• Driving license B (or in the process of getting it).
 

¿RECOMMENDED¿ skills:

• Proven workshop experience and skills (ex: welding, electrical design, mechanical design, CNC, etc.)
• Proven experience with robotic systems and troubleshooting
• Training or experience in system integration
• Experience with electrical measurement devices
 

¿NICE TO HAVE¿ skills:

• Experience in programming with Labview/ROS/Matlab/C++/Python
• Proficiency in 3D printing technologies and design software (CAD) for rapid prototyping and repairs
• Knowledge of PCB design and soldering
• Drone Pilot License can be an advantage and/or experience with flying drones
 

Personal skills:

• You are highly motivated (read proactive) to develop technical/workshop skills that are not yet mastered.
• You have a practical mindset, showcasing a hands-on approach to problem-solving.
• You take initiative, you are involved and result oriented.
• You are honest, loyal toward the institution and respect confidentiality.
• You improve the team-spirit and solve interpersonal conflicts. 
 

Other skills:

• The applicant shall have very good knowledge of French or Dutch (oral & written) and a minimum knowledge of (or be willing to learn) the other language (oral), since lots of campaigns will be performed in Belgium. This will be tested during selection.
• The applicant shall have good knowledge of English (oral & written), which will be tested during selection.
 

SPECIFIC REQUIREMENTS

• The researcher is likely to be exposed to classified information and will therefore have to obtain the required security clearance. The candidate must consent with the background check required to obtain this clearance, which will be executed by Belgian Defense.
• The researcher will be working within the context of European Defence Fund projects. Due to this project framework, this position is only open for NATO / EU citizens.
• Working for the Patrimony requires living in Belgium. 
CONTRACT

• Probable date of recruitment: 15 January  2027, in consultation with the applicant.
• Status: Full-time employment (38 hours / week) based on an open-ended contract with the Patrimony of the Royal Military Academy (you will not be a civil servant).
• To be very clear: your contract will be open-ended, but the financing of the contract will be tied to a project that ends in Spring 2030. The financing of your contract beyond that period is therefore not 100% guaranteed. However, the RMA-MECA dept has a policy to keep the good elements and this position will in any case be required beyond that date as well, so if we're happy with you there is a high chance that we will offer you a follow-up beyond that date if you decide to stay.
• Wage scale: NBI1. RMA-Patrimony applies a merit-based research career track, allowing personnel to advance in wage scale based upon annual evaluations. Your bruto and netto salary can be simulated precisely via this tool: simulateur de salaire.
• Holiday pay.
 

EXTRA LEGAL BENEFITS

• Possibility to benefit from a bilingualism allowance (Dutch/French) following a BOSA test;
• End-of-year bonus;
• Free DKV hospitalization insurance. Possibility of additional affiliation for one or more persons living under the same roof: spouse, child(ren) (50% of the price per additional member);
• Bike allowance / Free public transport (home-work commute);
• Meal vouchers (6€/day);
• Digital allowance: 15€/month;
• Free access to campus sports facilities outside working hours;
• On-campus restaurant and cafeteria with democratic prices (discount on the daily menu);
• Flexible working hours within the 38-hour week;
• Teleworking possible with allowance (2 days/week max);
• Holidays: 
• 29 days holiday / year from the 1st year of contract (then from 45 years: +1 day holiday every 5 years)
• 1 week OFF every year between Christmas and New year's Eve (independent of the annual balance of holidays).
• Advantages and interesting offers thanks to the Benefits@work card (discounts, vouchers...);
• Entitlement to services offered by the `Office Central d'Action Sociale et Culturelle de la Défense' (OCASC): among others holiday centres, discount on travel organised by the tour operator...;
• Possibility to benefit from the nursery funded by Belgian Defence (subject to availability).

You will join an international environment where communication plays an important role in showcasing the company's expertise, projects and solutions. You will work closely with different teams and have the opportunity to bring your own ideas to life.

Description

Your responsibilities

• You develop and create a wide range of communication materials, including brochures, presentations, newsletters, product content and social media posts.
• You manage the company's social media channels and create engaging photo and video content, taking ownership of the entire process from the initial idea to publication.
• You coordinate website content, translate technical information into accessible communication and ensure a consistent brand identity across all channels.
• You work closely with marketing, sales, operations and international colleagues, while proactively identifying opportunities to improve the company's communication and digital presence.
Your profile

• You have at least a first experience in a general communication or marketing role and are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.
• You are genuinely passionate about communication and content creation. You take initiative, think ahead and don't wait for someone to tell you what needs to be done. You identify opportunities, come up with ideas and turn them into concrete actions.
• You have a hands-on mentality, work independently and take ownership of your projects. You are creative, organized and detail-oriented, with a good eye for visual content and brand consistency.
• You have experience with social media, graphic content and photo and video editing. Knowledge of tools such as Canva, Lightroom and CapCut is a plus.
• You are curious about digital communication and new technologies, and enjoy finding ways to improve existing processes and content.
• You have a valid driving licence (B) and are willing to travel between the Belgian offices in Antwerp and Brussels and occasionally abroad. You are looking for a long-term opportunity where you can grow and make a real impact.

Opportunity

Hybrid (2 days on-site per week) · Permanent, full-time

About the role

You'll keep one or more defence software Squads moving, running ceremonies, clearing blockers, and turning Agile principles into daily practice, with senior Scrum Masters and Agile Coaches alongside you as you find your footing. This is a permanent role in a Spotify-inspired organisation (Squads, Chapters, Tribes), and the mentoring structure is a deliberate design feature, not a vague promise.

Your Mission

What you'll do

• Facilitate Scrum ceremonies, Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Reviews, Retrospectives and Backlog Refinement, so your Squad leaves each session with clarity and a workable plan.
• Identify and remove impediments that slow delivery, escalating where needed and working with stakeholders to keep momentum.
• Partner with Market Product Managers on backlog refinement, sprint readiness and prioritisation so the Squad is always working on the right things.
• Collaborate with Tech Writers to make sure documentation is planned and aligned with sprint goals, not bolted on afterwards.
• Monitor team health and track Agile metrics, using what you learn to support continuous improvement in ways of working.
• Coordinate with other Scrum Masters, Chapters and stakeholders to surface and manage cross-Squad dependencies before they become blockers.

What success looks like

Over time, your Squads run ceremonies that feel purposeful rather than routine: the team arrives prepared, leaves aligned, and the retrospective actually changes something. Impediments get named early and resolved rather than accumulating. You start spotting dependency risks before they surface as problems, and your collaboration with Market Product Managers and Tech Writers becomes a natural part of the Squad rhythm rather than a coordination overhead.

 

What you bring

• Up to two years of experience in an Agile environment, as a Scrum Master, Project Coordinator, Business Analyst, QA or a comparable role where you worked alongside or within Agile ceremonies.
• Working knowledge of Scrum and Agile principles, conceptual fluency you can apply in a real Squad, not necessarily a certification.
• Facilitation and communication skills strong enough to keep a room moving and surface issues without creating friction.
• Organisational discipline to track dependencies and keep multiple moving parts visible.
• Ability to build working relationships across multidisciplinary teams, including people in technical, product and writing roles.
• Professional working proficiency in English.
• Eligibility to obtain and maintain the required national or NATO security clearance for this role. ILIAS Solutions supports candidates through the clearance process and is glad to explain what is involved before you apply.

Building reliable infrastructure from the inside

As a System Engineer at ILIAS Solutions, you take ownership of the infrastructure behind our international organization. This is an internal IT position: you will not work directly with customers, but you will support the people who build, deliver, implement and support the ILIAS Defense Platform.
You work across Linux systems, hybrid infrastructure and automation. Alongside day-to-day operations, you look for patterns: where recurring work can be automated, where configurations can become more consistent and where better documentation can make the environment easier to understand. The goal is clear: continue moving infrastructure from reactive support towards a structured, automated and predictable engineering environment.

Meaningful work

ILIAS develops software for demanding defense and security environments, and the people behind that work depend on reliable technology every day. As part of Internal IT, your impact is internal but reaches across the organization: you help create the technical foundation that enables development teams to build, implementation teams to deliver and support teams to help customers. • Investigate complex infrastructure, system, software and network issues with an analytical mindset and a focus on sustainable solutions, not quick fixes only.
• Contribute to clear documentation, monitoring, backup routines, operational procedures and continuous improvement of internal IT processes.
• Support secure and reliable access to the internal systems and infrastructure services used by ILIAS colleagues every day.
• Work with the reliability, quality and security awareness expected from a company active in the defence domain and certified according to ISO 9001 and Cyber Essentials.
 

What you bring?

• Proven experience as a Linux System Administrator or System Engineer.
• Strong hands-on expertise in Linux server environments. Linux is not a side topic in this role; it is one of the core areas where we need depth.
• Solid experience with Ansible, including playbooks, automation and configuration management.
• Good knowledge of Azure and experience with cloud or hybrid infrastructure environments.
• Knowledge of VMware and Windows Server environments.
• A security-minded approach to infrastructure and operations.
• Strong analytical thinking skills: you can investigate issues thoroughly, identify root causes and explain your reasoning clearly.
• A predictable and transparent way of working: you document what you do, communicate clearly and keep colleagues informed before, during and after changes.
• The maturity to take ownership, challenge unclear requests, ask the right questions and work towards sustainable improvements.
• A degree in IT, Computer Science or equivalent experience.
• At least C1 level in Dutch and English.

Responsibilities

Nice to Haves

Opportunity
Ensure the quality and reliability of our PLUS Platform .
PLUS exists so ILIAS can focus on its core business. We take on the opportunities, challenges, and initiatives that require new thinking, new technology, or a different approach. By carrying part of the innovation, transformation, and operational load, we help the organisation move faster and prepare for what comes next. Adaptability is our superpower. We don't just respond to change, we work where ILIAS will be tomorrow.
You focus on validating PLUS functionalities and ensuring that systems behave as expected in environments where quality and reliability matter.

Meaningful Work in a Mission Driven Environment
Your work supports applications used in operational environments. You ensure that functionality, integrations, and business processes are reliable, consistent, and ready to support users and operational activities.

The Impact You Help Create
You improve application quality, reduce risk, and ensure that business-critical systems perform reliably. Your work supports consistent and trustworthy outcomes.

Inetum is a European leader in digital services. Every day, the Group's 28,000 consultants and specialists aim to make a digital impact for businesses, public sector bodies and society as a whole: solutions that contribute to performance, innovation and the common good.

Present in 19 countries, close to the regions, and with its major software publisher partners, Inetum meets the challenges of digital transformation with proximity and flexibility.

In response to a market that has been growing steadily for over 30 years, Inetum has made the deliberate choice to refocus on 4 core businesses in order to gain strength and offer customized solutions tailored to the specific needs of its customers: consulting (Inetum Consulting), infrastructure and application management (Inetum Technologies), software implementation (Inetum Solutions) and its own software publishing business (Inetum Software). Inetum has forged strategic partnerships with 4 of the world's leading software publishers - Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft and SAP - and is pursuing a dedicated acquisition strategy to become one of Europe's top 5 in these technologies, and offer the best expertise to its customers.

Inetum Consulting is a strategy and transformation consulting firm part of the Inetum group. With a team of 450 multidisciplinary consultants, we are present in Europe (France, Spain, Portugal, Belgium) and Africa (Morocco).

Inetum Consulting supports companies and public organizations in their strategic projects through five major offerings: CIO Advisory, Sustainability, Data & GenAI, Transformation & Change, Corporate Functions Advisory.

Guided by a sector-specific consulting approach enriched by innovation and technological solutions, we help our customers steer their transformation towards sustainable performance and a more resilient, responsible society.

We value a unique and strong corporate culture, imbued with the values of excellence, which contributes significantly to the success of organizations.

At inetum consulting, we offer more than just a job; we provide an inspiring environment and opportunities for growth and development. we strive to create a workplace where you can harness your talents, contribute to challenging projects, and be part of a leading IT consultancy group.

Job Description

 
• As part of the development of the Industry sector team with a focus on manufacturing & supply chain, we are looking to strengthen the team.
 
• You will participate in on both client activities as internal activities supporting the growth of our Industry sector team within Inetum Consulting:
  
   
• We are interested in people with proven track records in delivering mid-large scale digital projects linked to manufacturing & supply chain topics.
   
• We believe in people we hire, we encourage people to take ownership by given them the right support, environment and tools to be successful at Inetum.
  
 
• You will execute & leading project assignments, including, data analysis, benchmarks, interviews, workshop animation, process mapping, business analysis, implementation roadmaps etc.
 
• Following the assignment, you will take up team lead roles.
 
• You will get the opportunity to contribute actively within the Industry Sector team to support the growth, expand our offering in manufacturing and supply chain and participate to seminars, publications,....
 
• Equipped with the entrepreneurial fibre, you are ready to collaborate within the Inetum Consulting global business line:
  
   
• Carrying out projects to improve operational performance
   
• Assisting the project owner or Program Manager on major digital transformation programmes
   
• Strategic framing and optimisation...
  
...

• You have at least 3 years of experience in the manufacturing or supply chain industry gained within a consulting firm focused on Operations Excellence.

• You have actively participated in cross-functional projects to improve operational excellence.

• Your experience, skills, and communication abilities allow you to manage project teams at our key clients.

• Your ability to propose solutions enables you to assert yourself on high-value-added business topics with Industrial and General Management.

• An interest in ERP tools, MES solutions and Industry 4.0 technologies is a differentiating plus.

• You are fluent in Dutch or French and English and proficient in Dutch or French at least professionally, allowing you to conduct workshops in an international environment.

Are you a CE driver who enjoys being on the road but wants to be home every evening? For a growing transport company in Desteldonk (Ghent), we are looking for a motivated CE driver for shuttle and regional work.

Your job

• Carry out shuttle and distribution trips for various customers (no shops, only industrial companies)
• Mainly drive within the Ghent region
• Transport goods safely and on time
• Loading and unloading is only occasionally done by you via the loading dock or curtain side; warehouse staff usually take care of this
• Provide professional and customer-oriented service
• Possibility to work for a fixed customer, offering extra structure and regularity
• Start each day from Desteldonk
• No overnight stays – home every evening

• You have a valid CE driving licence and some initial experience as a driver
• You are punctual, responsible and customer-oriented
• You work safely and professionally
• You are flexible and enjoy variety in your work
• You speak Dutch or English
• You are motivated and proud of your profession
• You are available to start between 5:00 and 6:00 AM

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, produces and distributes an extensive range of analog and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications.

Are you about to finish your degree with a thesis? Do you want to apply your software engineering skills to a real world product used in medical imaging?

We are offering a thesis position focused on modernizing a legacy software component and better integration into the existing quality assurance infrastructure.

During your project you will use C++, our internal development framework, AI-assisted development tools and modern continuous integration (CI) practices to migrate an existing code base to a new framework and establish a robust automated testing environment. You will collaborate closely with imaging specialists and development experts to ensure the software meets the high quality standards needed for medical applications.

Job Description

Are you about to finish your degree with a thesis? Do you want to apply your software engineering skills to a real world product used in medical imaging?

We are offering a thesis position focused on modernizing a legacy software component and better integration into the existing quality assurance infrastructure.

During your project you will use C++, our internal development framework, AI-assisted development tools and modern continuous integration (CI) practices to migrate an existing code base to a new framework and establish a robust automated testing environment.
