At Allseas, we enable the development of groundbreaking offshore solutions that support the energy transition. Our success depends on making informed decisions, managing resources effectively, and continuously improving the way we operate.
 

Within Business Finance, we act as trusted partners to the business, enabling sustainable performance through cost transparency, financial planning, data-driven insights, and strong financial governance. We challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and support the business in turning strategy into results.
 

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a 
Finance Business Partner for Crewing.
 

 
 

Your role
 

 
 

As Finance Business Partner for Crewing, you will support one of the most critical functions within Allseas: ensuring our vessels are staffed with the right people, at the right time, and at the right cost.
 

You will partner closely with Crewing, Vessel Management, Human Resources, and Operations leadership, providing financial insight and decision support that enables effective workforce planning, cost management, and operational performance.
 

You will act as a trusted advisor, helping stakeholders understand financial impacts, challenge assumptions, evaluate opportunities, and drive continuous improvement.
 

Key responsibilities include:
 

Business Partnering & Decision Support
 
 

• Partner with Crewing and Vessel Management to support operational and strategic decision-making. 

• Develop business cases, scenario analyses, and actionable recommendations. 

• Identify opportunities to improve cost efficiency and resource utilization. 

• Challenge assumptions and support management in making informed decisions.  

Financial Planning & Performance Management
 
 

• Lead budgeting and forecasting activities. 

• Monitor financial performance and analyse variances against budget and forecast. 

• Provide timely insights into cost drivers, trends, opportunities, and risks.  

Cost Transparency & Reporting
 
 

• Deliver reliable and business-relevant financial reporting. 

• Develop and enhance management dashboards and performance analyses.  

Process Improvement & Financial Governance
 
 

• Safeguard data integrity and compliance with financial standards and policies. 

• Identify and implement improvements in end-to-end business processes, systems (SAP, PowerBI) 

You are curious, analytical, and eager to understand how the business operates. You enjoy working with stakeholders across different disciplines and can translate complex data into practical business insights.
 

You also have the confidence to challenge existing ways of working and help drive positive change.
 

Qualifications:
 
 

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related field. 

• 5 years of experience in Business Finance, Financial Controlling, FP&A, or Finance Business Partnering. 

• Experience in a project-driven, engineering, offshore, maritime, or international environment is an advantage.  

Skills:
 
 

• Strong analytical and financial modelling capabilities. 

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. 

• Ability to influence and challenge constructively. 

• Experience with budgeting, forecasting, and business case development. 

• Strong affinity with digital reporting solutions and data analytics. 

• Experience with SAP and Power BI is preferred. 

• Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

What will you do?

• Lead the technical design, development and maintenance of a scalable and secure SaaS platform, making future-proof architectural decisions.
• Develop new features end-to-end, perform code reviews and continuously improve the platform's performance, reliability and maintainability.
• Contribute to the technical roadmap, evaluate architectural approaches and leverage innovative technologies, including AI tools, to continuously improve both the software and development processes.

• You have strong expertise in .NET and C#, combined with experience in fornt-end development. You look beyond the code itself and know how to apply the right architectural principles and design patterns based on the platform's needs.

jobs.occupation: Extra income as CE truck driver - Saturday or weekdays
jobs.description:
Are you living in Belgium and looking for some extra income? Do you have a valid CE driving licence and experience as a CE truck driver, HGV driver or lorry driver? And do you want a flexible way to earn extra money alongside your current job or during your free days?

For a well-established transport company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food transport and temperature-controlled logistics, we're looking for reliable CE truck drivers who want to work one or more days per week. You decide when you're available: weekdays, Saturdays, or both. And the best part is that Dutch isn't required; you can also apply if you only speak English!

Your job

As a CE driver, you will deliver frozen food products to supermarkets, distribution centres, and business customers across Belgium and neighbouring countries.

Your drives:

• Transport of frozen goods

• National deliveries throughout Belgium, but also to the Netherlands, Luxembourg, France and Germany

• Up to 15h/day on the road (waiting and resting times included)

• Varying number of stops: between 5 to 15 stops/day

Routes are prepared in advance and your trailer is already loaded, connected, fuelled, and ready to go before departure.

You'll almost never have to sleep in your truck, except for some for very exceptional cases when there's no other possibility.

We're looking for a driver who:

• Has a valid CE driving licence, code 95 and driver card

• Is residing in Belgium and has legal right to work in the country

• Has a good level of English

• Isn't afraid to start early in the morning and to tackle longer routes

• Has their own transport to the company (no public transport nearby)

Previous experience in frozen food transport, refrigerated transport or distribution transport is an advantage but not required.

jobs.description:
The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, produces and distributes an extensive range of analog and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications.

lobal SAP Process Owner, Order Fulfillment

 

Company Overview:

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, produces and distributes an extensive range of imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications.

Agfa Healthcare IT is a leading provider of advanced healthcare IT solutions, offering a range of software and services that help healthcare organizations improve clinical workflows, enhance patient care, and optimize operational efficiency. Their offerings include electronic health records (EHR), picture archiving and communication systems (PACS), radiology information systems (RIS), and other imaging and data management solutions. By leveraging cutting-edge technologies such as artificial intelligence and cloud computing, Agfa Healthcare IT empowers healthcare providers to streamline operations, improve decision-making, and achieve better outcomes. The company's solutions are designed to be scalable, interoperable, and user-friendly, supporting healthcare providers in navigating the evolving landscape of modern healthcare delivery.

 

Position Overview / Summary:
 
• As the Global SAP Process Owner, Order Fulfillment, you will be responsible for evaluating, designing, implementing, measuring, and continuously improving global order fulfillment processes. Working closely with business stakeholders and external IT partners, you will ensure that processes are effectively integrated into our global SAP landscape and support business transformation, operational excellence, and customer satisfaction. You will play a key role in optimizing end-to-end workflows, driving standardization and automation initiatives, and ensuring that our order fulfillment processes remain scalable, compliant, and efficient. This position reports to the Director of Operational Excellence & Analytics. 
 

Location: (location of position):
 
• Mortsel, Belgium. Hybrid working.  

What You'll Do (Responsibilities):

You will be responsible for:

1) Customer Operations Governance & Continuous Improvement:
 
• Designing and implementing streamlined future-state processes and standardized operating procedures. 
• Identifying opportunities for process improvement, simplification, automation, and standardization across the order fulfillment lifecycle. 
• Establishing, monitoring, and analysing key performance indicators (KPIs) and process metrics to measure operational performance and business value. 
• Ensuring processes comply with industry standards, regulatory requirements, internal controls, and risk management guidelines. 
• Driving operational excellence initiatives to increase efficiency, quality, and customer satisfaction. 
• Developing and enhancing operational reporting and process insights to support data-driven decision making. 
2) SAP tool ownership & Transformation: 
 
• Acting as the primary business owner for Order Fulfillment-related SAP processes and solutions. 
• Serving as the liaison between business teams, IT, and external consultants to align business requirements with standard and custom SAP functionality. 
• Leading global transformation initiatives, including e-invoicing deployment, SAP enhancements, and future S/4HANA migration projects. 
• Translating business requirements into system and process solutions. 
• Defining priorities for change requests, enhancements, and project initiatives. 
• Facilitating process analysis, solution design, and business decision making. 
• Coordinating testing activities and validating system changes before deployment. 
• Managing implementation activities and driving user adoption through effective change management. 
• Monitoring industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices, and assessing their relevance to Agfa HealthCare. 
 

Cross-Functional Collaboration

You will work closely with teams across Finance, Purchasing, IT, and other Business Process Management functions to ensure seamless end-to-end process execution.

This includes supporting initiatives such as Vendor Management, Customer contract management, Licensing Management.

 

Who You Are (Qualifications):
 
• Masters's degree in Business Administration or equivalent experience 
• Strong experience in business process management, operational excellence, or order fulfillment operations. 
• Advanced knowledge of SAP modules (SD, PS, MM) in SAP EEC environment 
• Familiarity with S/4 HANA is a plus 
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and process improvement skills. 
• Strong communication skills in English 
• Process improvement & problem solving mindset 
• Proven ability to influence and drive change across functions without direct authority. 
• Ability to work independently and effectively manage multiple priorities in a global environment.

SAL International is an international player in airport handling and logistics. What you will find there:

Soft skills

jobs.occupation: Technical Safety Officer Maritime Operations - EN
jobs.description:
• Be present on the yard and on board vessels on a daily basis to monitor activities, risks and safety measures. 

• Carry out safety rounds, inspections and audits to identify unsafe situations and technical risks, and quickly implement the necessary corrective actions. 

• Address and raise awareness among employees and subcontractors, and ensure safety rules are applied correctly. 

• Prepare, update and follow up risk assessments, safety procedures and action points. 

• Monitor safety during maintenance and repair activities, including the safe isolation of work areas and technical installations. 

• Provide practical safety advice and discuss improvement points with Superintendents, technical staff, naval personnel, subcontractors and other stakeholders. 

• Ensure proper administrative follow-up and reporting on safety and prevention. 
 

• Strong technical background in shipping, marine engineering, industry, maintenance or complex technical worksites. 

• Experience as, for example, a Superintendent, maritime Project Manager, Engineer, Technical Specialist or in an operational role on board is a strong foundation. 

• Good technical understanding of areas such as mechanics, electricity, hydraulics, maintenance activities, working at height, heavy loads and technical spaces. 

• Strong interest in safety and prevention; previous experience in a formal safety role is not required. 

• Strong communication skills, a practical mindset and the ability to engage people clearly and convincingly in safe working practices.

Volvo Action Service (VAS) takes care of our Volvo Group customers across Europe whenever one of their vehicles has a problem. Delivering great customer service is at the heart of our operation, as we take a proactive approach to get vehicles back on the road as quickly and smoothly as possible.

• You are customer focused, always striving for the best possible service and solution for our customers. 

• You are a confident communicator, adapting your style to each customer to make sure they feel heard and supported. 

• You go the extra mile, solving problems with a proactive and creative mindset. 

• You like working in a team, supporting and lifting each other up. 

• You are keen to keep learning and developing your skills. 

• You are open to working in shifts, just like your colleagues, to provide round-the-clock service to our clients. 

• You are fluent (written and verbal) in English, Dutch and German. French is an asset.

As we expand internationally, we are looking for an Outbound Sales professional to identify new opportunities, build a qualified prospect pipeline and support our commercial visibility.
 

This is a 
 hands-on commercial role 
combining market research, lead generation, outbound sales and business development. You will identify companies whose products could potentially be manufactured by Conforma, assess whether they have internal manufacturing capabilities, and identify the right people to approach.
 

You will help us turn market intelligence into concrete commercial opportunities.
 

Your responsibilities

· Research companies, product portfolios and manufacturing capabilities to identify potential outsourcing and contract manufacturing opportunities
 

· Build and maintain a structured, high-quality prospect database and prioritise opportunities based on commercial potential

· A higher education degree or equivalent experience in business, marketing, life sciences, pharmaceutical sciences, international business or a related field
 

· Excellent written and spoken Dutch & English is essential
 

· Strong research, analytical and organisational skills
 

· Excellent communication skills and the confidence to speak with people you have never contacted before
 

· A commercial mindset and genuine interest in business development
 

· Persistence and the ability to professionally obtain information
 

· Good digital and online research skills
 

· The ability to work independently while collaborating closely with the Business Development team
 

What makes this role different?
 

This is not a traditional telesales position. You will not simply work through a predefined list of leads. Community Engagement Coordinator to join our team.

Events & Coordination

Jobomschrijving

As Country Manager, your main responsibilities will be to :

Shape & own the BeLux market strategy

• Define the market vision and priorities for Belgium & Luxembourg, adapting the global framework to local realities.
• Build a deep understanding of drivers, barriers, competitors, and user/company behaviors to inform strategic decisions.
• Identify high-impact growth levers across B2C and B2B.

Accelerate B2C adoption & engagement

• Boost usage of the mobile app and charging access solution through creative, locally relevant activation.
• Work with Marketing on targeted campaigns and growth experiments; ensure seamless onboarding with Customer Success.
• Influence product developments by sharing market insights and feature needs with Product & Tech.

Drive B2B development & support fleet electrification

• Partner with Marketing & Sales to build a solid lead generation engine and qualify opportunities.
• Secure customer satisfaction and long-term usage through close collaboration with Customer Success and B2B Ops.

Turn strategy into execution & measurable results

• Own the BeLux KPIs and P&L: monitor performance, detect weak signals, and propose data-backed improvements.
• Deploy clear action plans and ensure cross-functional alignment for efficient execution.
• Be the operational link between market needs and central teams (Sales, Product, Tech, Marketing, CS).

Build and represent the brand in the local ecosystem

• Become the face of the company in the BeLux market: attend events, engage communities, and expand visibility.
• Develop partnerships with charging networks, installers, service providers, driver associations, and corporate stakeholders.
• Conduct initial discovery visits with prospects, validate opportunities, and coordinate handovers to internal Business Developers.

Prepare the ground for future local expansion

• Identify organizational needs as the market grows and contribute to planning a future local team (Sales, Marketing, etc.).
• Ensure continuous feedback loops to refine positioning, operations, and product-market fit.

The successful candidate will have the following qualities:

• Relevant experience in market development / new market launch / acceleration (ideally in SaaS, digital products, mobility, energy)
• Proven ability to adapt a global strategy to local dynamics and deliver measurable growth.
• Data-driven: confident with KPIs, dashboards, CRM, and translating field insights into action.
• Strong partnership-building mindset with companies, associations, and institutional stakeholders.
• Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and autonomous, with excellent cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Deep understanding of BeLux cultural and business context; EV ecosystem knowledge is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

Our partner is a well-established Belgian organisation operating across multiple locations, with a strong focus on service, reliability and digital transformation. Its IT environment supports a broad network of sites and business operations, making availability, security and connectivity essential to its day-to-day activities.

 

As part of a growing IT Infrastructure team, you will join an environment where networking is not simply about keeping systems running: you will have the opportunity to take ownership, work on infrastructure projects and influence how the network evolves.
Network Engineer | The Role
As a Network Engineer, you will take an active role in the operational management and continuous improvement of the organisation's network environment.

• Manage and monitor LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN and firewall infrastructure across multiple locations.
• Troubleshoot complex network incidents, identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
• Work closely with external technology partners, coordinating their activities and challenging proposed solutions when needed.
• Contribute to network projects, migrations, upgrades and standardisation, while ensuring smooth change management.
• Proactively monitor performance, availability and security, using KPIs and monitoring tools to prevent service degradation and downtime.

We are looking for a technically strong Network Engineer who enjoys ownership, problem-solving and working across a broader infrastructure environment.

• Solid knowledge of routing, switching, VLANs, Wi-Fi, WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP and network segmentation.
• Experience with network monitoring, incident management, troubleshooting and change management.
• Familiarity with technologies such as Cisco, Meraki, firewalls, SD-WAN or Network Access Control is a strong plus.

• Fluent in Dutch or French, professionally proficient in the other national language, with a good command of English.

What will you be doing?

During the season:

You will be part of a dynamic, energetic team that processes 45 tons of carrots per hour. Together with your colleagues, you will:

• Monitoring the operation of machines (conveyor belts, scanners, cutting and packaging systems)
• Check quality and make changes when necessary

• Detecting faults, responding immediately to breakdowns and making quick operational decisions
• Making settings and quality improvements

• Working in accordance with health and safety and hygiene regulations

Out of season:

You will assist with maintenance and repairs to keep our equipment in top condition. This is not a lab job—you will be working on robust washing and sorting lines, not delicate machines in clean rooms. Practical knowledge and hands-on skills are essential.

• Solid technical knowledge and a proactive approach

About the Company
Our client is an international technology organization with a strong footprint across Europe. Our client is a growing logistics company in the textile industry. The company has positioned itself internationally as an important player in the sector and continues to develop rapidly. Jobomschrijving

• flexible
• Works well under pressure and is solution-oriented

About the role
 

Fintensy builds and operates the technology platform behind mozzeno and other financial services. As we scale, we're looking for a Head of IT to grow our engineering team, sharpen how we work, and make sure our technology delivers on the business's ambitions.
 

This is a leadership role first and foremost. You will spend your time developing people, aligning ways of working, leading our technical initiatives, and giving stakeholders clear visibility into what the team is building and where it is headed. While you won't be writing production code day to day, your credibility with the team comes from having built and operated systems like these yourself.
 

Key responsibilities
 
 

• Team leadership & coaching — Provide mentorship and day-to-day support to developers and data scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning. Help senior engineers grow junior colleagues and keep knowledge flowing across the team. 

• Technical project leadership — Lead the delivery of technical projects end to end — infrastructure, platform, security, tooling and cross-cutting engineering initiatives — from scoping through rollout. Business-driven projects are owned by Product Owners; you partner closely with them while taking the lead on the technical roadmap and its execution. 

• Recruitment & onboarding — Lead hiring for developers, infrastructure engineers, and data & AI specialists. Design and oversee onboarding that integrates new hires quickly and effectively into the team and its practices. 

• Process refinement — Work with Product Owners to shape and fine-tune agile practices (backlog management, sprint planning, retrospectives) that maximise productivity and keep focus on strategic priorities. Continuously trial new techniques — such as AI-assisted coding and process automation — to raise efficiency and quality. 

• Visibility & communication — Ensure transparent reporting of achievements, roadmaps and risks to stakeholders. Run regular updates on progress, risks and resource needs, and build a shared understanding of priorities across engineering, product and business. 

• Collaboration & facilitation — Act as the bridge between developers, Product Owners, data scientists and external partners. Facilitate discussions on requirements and dependencies so projects run smoothly and teams stay aligned. 

• Technical oversight — Bring deep, hands-on experience with our stack or equivalent (AWS, .NET, Angular, Python, event-driven micro-services), enough real depth to debug a production issue or challenge an architectural decision yourself, not just follow the conversation.  Champion security best practices and infrastructure improvements, while delegating implementation to subject-matter experts. 

• Culture & growth — Foster an environment where engineers feel accountable and empowered to take ownership. Encourage curiosity and a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset, and promote AI and emerging tools that streamline work and sharpen the team's skills. 
 

• Several years of hands-on experience as a Software Engineer, Architect, or DevOps/Platform Engineer, ideally followed by a move into a people-management or tech-lead role. 
 

• Experience managing engineering or cross-functional teams, with a track record of coaching people and growing their skills. 

• A record of leading technical projects or initiatives through to delivery. 

• Proven ability to design and refine agile or lean processes that improve delivery effectiveness. 

• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable presenting plans, progress and blockers to technical and non-technical audiences alike. 

• Organised and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple initiatives without losing sight of the big picture. 

• Comfortable introducing new tools and techniques (e.g., AI-assisted development) and measuring their impact. 

• Enough technical literacy in cloud infrastructure, web technologies and DevOps pipelines to understand team challenges and shape high-level decisions. 

• Fluency in French or Dutch alongside professional English.  

Nice to have
 
 

• Prior experience in fintech or other regulated environments. 

• Experience working with near-shore or hybrid teams.

Antwerp Convention Bureau (ACB – www.antwerpconventionbureau.be) focuses on promoting the city of Antwerp as a premium destination for meetings, incentives, conferences, exhibitions, and events (MICE). Their brand promise is ‘The city is your venue’. Antwerp Convention Bureau highlights the diverse range of conference facilities in Antwerp and builds strong local expertise to support conference organizers and attendees in hosting conferences and business activities within the city.
The goal is to use a comprehensive marketing strategy and a proactive approach to attract international B-2-B events for associations or the industry that generate a positive impact on the residents, entrepreneurs, and visitors of the city of Antwerp. These events reinforce local and regional policies because they are linked to strong economic clusters, knowledge institutions, or centers of expertise.
In order to expand its organization and network, Antwerp Convention Bureau is actively seeking a new Managing Director.

Jobomschrijving

As Managing Director, you are the driving force behind the long-term strategy and financial performance of the organisation. Taking full P&L responsibility, you safeguard the financial health and ensure a maximum return on investment for the allocated budgets. You build on the current momentum by prioritizing the structuring of the organisation, implementing clear processes, and inspiring the internal team. Furthermore, you act as the primary local and international ambassador who proudly carries the bureau's successes to the city and its stakeholders, further shaping its vision within the meeting and convention (MICE) industry. 
As Managing Director, you will be responsible for:

• Managing human and financial resources efficiently within the allocated budgets while meeting the city's KPI’s.
• Coaching, motivating, and guiding the team to perform at their maximum potential, ensuring clear roles and responsibilities.
• Maintaining a strong and proactive network of relationships with the financing government, local stakeholders, and various players within the industry.
• Reporting on operations and milestones to the Executive Board.
• Representing ACB with strong communication skills. Expanding the (inter)national network within the highly competitive meeting industry. Simultaneously, you showcase local successes and act as the public face of the organization fostering the local public relations (PR), translating achievements into pride for the city and local stakeholders. 
• Leading the day-to-day management and further development of the organisation in line with the long-term strategy, ensuring the implementation of clear procedures, best practices, and an optimal organisational structure.

You are first and foremost an organisation builder and a true people manager who provides your team with direction, clarity, and structure. Additionally, you are a business-minded networker who effortlessly represents the organisation and inspires others during presentations and networking events. You possess a strategic approach paired with innovative thinking, and you show great diplomatic sensitivity towards the interests of local stakeholders.
Additionally, you possess:

• A Master’s degree (or equivalent working and thinking level), coupled with substantial experience in setting up, structuring, and leading a solid organisation at a senior management level.
• Strong PR skills and a proven track record of local stakeholder management, successfully communicating results to government, partners, ambassadors, the team and other stakeholders.
• A background in the (inter)national hospitality industry, or experience as a senior business marketing and sales professional within a highly competitive international sector. Experience within the MICE sector is considered a strong asset, though leadership skills are prioritized.
• A strict commitment to being based in Antwerp alongside a readiness to travel internationally.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills in both Dutch and English.

jobs.occupation: IT & Cyber Risk Specialist – HQ Brussels
jobs.description:
Your Job at a glance

Ready to Shape the Future of Cybersecurity in Banking?

At the heart of BNP Paribas Fortis, the Centre of Expertise Security (CoE Security) drives innovation in secure solutions, designing, implementing, and maintaining trusted, cutting-edge protections for our teams and clients.

As an IT Cyber Risk Manager, you will operate at the core of our cybersecurity strategy, connecting, influencing, and collaborating across the entire bank. Within our ‘Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)’ team, you will work closely with IT and Business Units to redefine Operational Risk Management, with a sharp focus on IT and Cyber Security.

This is not just a risk management role - it’s an opportunity to:

• Engage diverse stakeholders, from technical teams to C-level executives, across all areas of BNP Paribas Fortis.
• Drive creative solutions, transforming complex cyber risks into practical, forward-thinking strategies.
• Shape a resilient future by proactively managing cyber risks to strengthen the bank’s defenses.
If you thrive in a dynamic, cross-functional environment where innovation and collaboration are key, this is your chance to make a tangible impact in banking cybersecurity

 

And in detail

Your Key Role as IT & Cyber Risk Specialist :

You serve as the critical link between technical risks, business priorities, and strategic decisions, ensuring IT and cybersecurity risks are proactively identified, analyzed, and translated into actionable strategies—fully aligned with the bank’s objectives.

Why this role stands out:

• Cross-functional collaboration: Partner with Tribes, Functions, and Business Units, clearly articulating risks to both technical teams and leadership—enabling data-driven decision-making.
• Proactive risk intelligence: From Shadow IT exposures to operational vulnerabilities, you assess, prioritize, and drive mitigation, delivering practical solutions that balance security with business continuity.
• Strategic advisory: Provide targeted recommendations to IT and business stakeholders, ensuring risks are managed without compromising operational goals.
• Enterprise-wide alignment: Report risks, trends, and insights to Cyber Security, IT, and Business Management, while sharing best practices across the BNP Paribas Group—reinforcing a unified risk posture.
• Process optimization: Leverage your expertise to refine risk management methods and tools, ensuring they remain efficient, scalable, and future-ready."

Your talents and skills

• Risk-to-Solution Mindset: You break down complex IT and cybersecurity challenges, turning them into clear, actionable insights for leadership—viewing risks as solvable challenges, not just warnings.
• Bank-Specific Acumen: Deep understanding of BNP Paribas Fortis’ businesses, functions, and strategic goals, ensuring risk management aligns with our priorities.
• Technical + Risk Expertise: Hands-on experience in IT infrastructure, architecture, and security, blending technical knowledge with risk awareness to design practical solutions—not just identify risks.
• Multilingual Communication: Fluent in French or Dutch + professional English, with strong written and verbal persuasion skills. You adapt seamlessly between IT, business, and management discussions.
• Practical Framework Application: Proven ability to operationalize IT processes, Cyber Security Management Systems, and control frameworks—ensuring they deliver in practice.
• Certifications & Methodologies: CISSP, CISM, Operational Risk Management, or Agile experience are a plus, but not mandatory.

To do so, you are assisted by a softwarearchitect with whom you determine the optimal architecture. From there, you take up your responsibility in the development cycle: from development and design to implementation and documentation.

AND IN DETAIL

• Identification and assessment of risks: You’ll analyse data from risk systems, reports, and governance bodies, turning complex information into practical, risk-based insights. Your conclusions will help leaders make informed decisions.
• Controls Execution & Reporting: You’ll interpret, adapt, and run control tests (compliance, fraud, outsourcing, etc.), then report findings to the CIO, ensuring controls align with IT’s strategic priorities.
• Regulatory & Internal Reporting: You’ll prepare precise, high-impact reports for the Internal Control Committee (ExCo), regulators (NBB/BNB, ECB), and Group entities (CDF/IT Group), shaping risk discussions at the highest level.
• Procedure Governance: As the gatekeeper for IT risk and security procedures, you’ll ensure they’re up to date, accessible, and visible, keeping our compliance framework structured and resilient.
• Governance Body Support: Acting as NAC secretary for major IT initiatives, you’ll track stakeholder conditions (Business & Functions), driving accountability and alignment in high-impact projects.
• Risk & Control Self-Assessment (RCSA): You’ll conduct the annual RCSA for all IT risk categories, using the RISK ORM methodology to assess risks, incidents, and recommendations, giving a full picture of IT’s risk profile, including external threats.
• Regulatory Reporting – IT Risk Questionnaire: You’ll coordinate the bank’s response to the ECB’s IT Risk questionnaire (via Group) and the NBB’s BNP Paribas Fortis reporting, ensuring submissions are accurate, regulator-ready, and endorsed by the CISO/CIO.
• Compliance Controls Execution: You’ll run IT-wide compliance checks (awareness, ethics, etc.), report findings to the IT Management Team, and drive remediation where needed, ensuring actions are documented and evidenced.

YOUR TALENTS AND COMPETENCES

Background & Experience

• A Master’s degree in IT, economics, or engineering, with a strong IT foundation.
• 10+ years of experience, including at least 5 years in Risk or IT whether in financial services, consulting, or another regulated industry.
  
What You Bring to the Table

• IT & Security Process Insight: You understand how IT and security technologies integrate into risk and operational frameworks and where the gaps might be.
• Risk Assessment Skills: Hands-on experience in identifying and evaluating IT and cyber risks, with a practical (not just theoretical) approach.
• Regulatory & Standards Know-How: Familiarity with frameworks like EBA guidelines, DORA, ISO 27001, or NIST and the ability to apply them in real-world IT risk and compliance scenarios.
• Control Design & Testing: You can translate regulations and policies into effective controls and know how to test whether they actually work.
• Agile Mindset: Experience with Agile methodologies in a risk or control environment is a plus, but adaptability matters most.
• Process Thinking: You quickly grasp end-to-end processes, spot risks, and propose practical solutions without getting lost in bureaucracy.
• Clear Communication: Whether it’s a report for executives or a presentation for regulators, you distill complex topics into concise, actionable messages.
• Stakeholder Alignment: You bridge the gap between technical teams, business units, and regulators keeping everyone aligned without losing sight of compliance and risk goals.
• Collaboration: You thrive in cross-functional teams, working smoothly with colleagues and partners to execute risk and control initiatives.
  
Practicalities

• Languages: Fluent in French or Dutch, with strong English (written and spoken).
• Tools: Comfortable with SharePoint, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
• Nice-to-have: Experience with RISK 360 is a plus, but not a must.

jobs.description:
Ensus Consulting BV is a consulting and services firm operating at the interface between science, government and industry. We provide tailor-made Regulatory Affairs dossier management services to national and international customers covering all aspects of dossiers related to chemicals legislations including the Biocidal Products Regulation (BPR), Plant Protection Products Regulation (PPPR), etc. In order to further expand our small regulatory affairs team, we are looking for a highly motivated new colleague.
 

After an initial period of training on-the-job, you will soon be expected to work independently. You will support companies in their regulatory challenges related to chemical products, incl. biocides and pesticides. You coordinate and support regulatory dossiers —covering both national and European chemical legislations— from start to finish. The latter includes for example setting up challenging efficacy testing scenarios, discussions with laboratories on analytical testing, dossier creation, etc. Furthermore, you will be able to take part to European discussions on drafting the guidance and commenting on existing guidance documents.
 

While we strongly value the capacity to work independently, it is also essential to cooperate with your colleagues, external partners and experts, authorities and our (inter)national customers.

The ideal candidate should:
 

be a (recent) graduate (Master or PhD level) in a life sciences discipline (chemistry, biology, biosciences, bioengineering, …).
 

be eager to develop expertise in the main aspects involved in dossier preparation: analytical chemistry, microbiology, (eco)toxicology, exposure assessment, risk assessment, modelling, classification and labelling, ...

jobs.occupation: Senior RF/MMW – Analog and Mixed Signal IC Researcher
jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced IC design researcher who can participate actively in the innovation and design of advanced RF/mmw and high speed (Gs/s) integrated circuits in the most advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies.
Apply 
 

Company
 

Imec performs world-leading research in nano-electronics. Imec leverages its scientific knowledge with the innovative power of its global partnerships in ICT, healthcare and energy. Imec delivers industry-relevant technology solutions. In a unique high-tech environment, its international top talent is committed to providing the building blocks for a better life in a sustainable society. Over 5000 expert scientists from over 95 countries shape tomorrow’s world with their research which is typically 5 to 10 years ahead of the market. Imec is headquartered in Leuven (Belgium) and has offices in the Netherlands, Taiwan, US, China, Japan and India. 

The Imec RF/mmWave and High-Speed ADC group in Leuven enjoys a world-class reputation in advanced high speed ADC and in millimeter-wave (mm-wave) RF Designs. In these fields our expertise is in the design of record-breaking high sampling rate ADCs and integrated RF/mm-wave front-ends in advanced CMOS and III-V based technologies. The design group also performs research in the fields of circuit design for advanced (optical) wireline communication, future RF technologies, mm-Wave sensing for life sciences, and mm-Wave imaging. 

The circuit design group is technically mentored by Piet Wambacq and Jan Craninckx and has an established state-of-the-art research reputation that has been confirmed over the years by our extensive presence in top conferences in solid-state circuit design, such as ISSCC, RFIC, ESSCIRC, VLSI and CICC. 

 

As an independent research center, we collaborate closely with top players in both industry and academia, giving our people continuous exposure to both the latest evolutions in industrial challenges and approaches, as well as into the newest emerging academic ideas and paradigms.
 

What you will do
 

We are looking for an experienced IC design researcher who can participate actively in the innovation and design of advanced RF/mm-wave and high speed (Gs/s) integrated circuits in the most advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies. 
 

Your key responsibilities will be: 
 
 

• Research and design of innovative high-speed, low-power RF and analog/mixed-signal integrated circuits in advanced CMOS and IIIV technologies.  

• Drive the bottom-up evolution of these integrated circuits considering the evolution of scaling.  

• Together with the team, bring new ideas and new technical innovations based on your solid technical experience.  

• Take part in technical interactions with external partners and towards new prospects.  

• Publish your state-of-the-art research results in international conferences or journals.  

Who you are
 
 

• You have a PhD degree in the domain of high-speed analog/mixed-signal and RF/mm-wave IC design or equivalent through experience.  

• You have solid design experience, and you have designed in advanced CMOS technologies (28nm, 16nmFF, 5nm).  

• You have experience designing in IIIV technologies.  

• You have a profound understanding of transistor-level circuits.  

• Experience in state-of-the-art high-speed analog/RF circuit design is a strong plus.  

• You are familiar with the various steps and tools in the design and layout of high performant analog and mixed signal circuits  

• You have solid understanding of solid-state devices, analog/RF circuits, up to the system architecture.  

• You have a broad interest in circuit design and are willing to contribute to multiple high speed analog circuit research domains  

• You can work independently yet in close collaboration with experts from other technical fields.  

• You have excellent reporting skills and can present technical results and choices clearly and concisely.  

• You can easily integrate into an international team.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do
 

IMEC performs world-leading research in nano-electronics, operating a diverse equipment set of most advanced semiconductor wafer processing models. To improve and further roll out our CIM application landscape, we have started the Smart Fab initiative in 2024. Smart Fab is not only about simplification of manual work, it also will deliver more insight into capacity utilization, as well as product quality. You will become part of this journey in a growing team, providing opportunities for your career development. 
 
 

• As a member of our Fab Engineering team, you will closely work with experts of the MES and related software – commonly referred to as CIM.  

• You have an active role throughout the entire equipment lifecycle, from automation specification during procurement, to requirement gathering after commissioning, to operational improvement after production release. You make sure that operations and engineering requirements regarding CIM integration are sufficiently specified and can be implemented accordingly. To enable this implementation, you need to understand equipment behavior and communication capabilities – which frequently requires exploration and diligent testing.  

• While technical knowledge and interest is crucial to be successful in this job, you will collaborate with hardware and software engineers who either deliver details to you or must pick up conclusions made by you. Data Specialist is a pivotal role, putting equipment communication capabilities into practice.  

• Commonly known as Industry 4.0 features, in semiconductor manufacturing such equipment communication feeds applications like MES, SPC, FDC (Fault Detection and Classification), APC (Advanced Process Control), and AMHS (Automated Material Handling).  

• With this open position we are specifically looking for candidates who will work with Metrology equipment, i.e. measuring process results and product properties.  

Who you are
 
 

• You have a master’s degree in engineering, exact sciences, or equal by experience.  

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in a complex manufacturing environment, characterized by demanding processes, high product mix, and delicate materials.  

• Prior experience in or knowledge of semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You have participated in CIM projects, understanding concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.  

• You understand measurement techniques, why different equipment is needed to measure different properties, and how measurement results can be reported.  

• You have a pro-active approach and are solution oriented. You cannot wait to roll up your sleeves and dive right into the action. You easily work independently and are an effective team player as well.  

• You thrive in a complex and demanding environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

What you will do 
 
 

• As a member of our Smart Fab team, you will closely work with developers of the same and adjacent software applications, Functional Analysts, and Business Analysts, to deliver a modern CIM application landscape.  

• Your primary contact will be the developer team lead, responsible for establishing our in-house development capability for the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, and we will assign an additional mentor during your onboarding.  

• You will follow Fab Operations to understand the different levels of automation currently implemented in our cleanrooms.  

• Your initial tasks will be configuration of existing equipment controller software modules, followed by developing clones of software modules for the same equipment type.  

• As we insource more functionality of the commercially sourced Equipment Integration platform, you will start developing equipment controller software modules for new equipment types. You will also be involved in developing custom solutions interfacing with the commercial platform.  

• You will participate in equipment model testing, both with software emulators as well as physical connection to the equipment hardware.  

Who you are 
 
 

• You bring 5 years or more of experience in software development, specifically related to hardware automation, and performing Java OOP.  

• Prior experience in, or knowledge of, semiconductor manufacturing is a strong asset, preferably in a 300 mm Fab.  

• You understand concepts like the automation pyramid and equipment state engines, as well as standards like OPC or SECS.  

• You can work independently and in a team. You do work diligently and are persistent.  

• Prior experience in a cooperative setup, original software supplier's engineers sharing the workload with in-house developers, as well as onsite-remote hybrid collaboration, is highly desired.  

• You feel comfortable in a complex and demanding environment.  

• Since you will be working in a highly international environment and will be maintaining a good contact with colleagues and co-workers from all over the world, fluency in English is essential.

EOC Group is growing its hotmelt adhesives business (Exomelt), as part of a portfolio of startups and new ventures. We are looking for a hands-on, dynamic Technical Service & Development Specialist to be the technical face of hotmelts to our customers, translating their applications, processes and specifications into the right hotmelt solution, and driving technical business development on the ground.
 

You will need a thorough, practical understanding of hot melt adhesives and some formulation know-how of your own, but you won't be doing deep chemistry alone. You can lean on a team of formulation and chemistry specialists to turn your technical offers into robust products. This is a customer-facing, solution-oriented role for someone who is as comfortable on a customer's production line as in a technical discussion.

 

What will you do?

• You understand customers' applications, processes and specifications in depth, and translate them into the right hotmelt solution and a compelling technical offer.
• You drive technical business development, identifying and pursuing opportunities with new and existing customers in a hands-on, dynamic way.
• Once a solution is proposed, you support customers with in-line application advice, helping them run and troubleshoot hotmelt products on their equipment.
• You act as the technical liaison between customers and EOC's formulation and chemistry specialists, briefing the team on customer requirements and translating technical results back to customers.
• You provide training to agents and distributors who are intensively used to market our products.
• You track technical market trends and innovations in hotmelt adhesives, and bring relevant insights back into EOC's product and technology roadmap.
• You represent EOC and the Hotmelts business at industry conferences and trade shows, building EOC's technical reputation and network in the hotmelt adhesives market.

Who are you? 

• You bring a thorough understanding of hotmelt adhesives (EVA, APAO, rubber-based, polyolefin, or similar hotmelt technologies) and their end-use applications.
• You have working formulation know-how, enough to have credible technical conversations and shape a technical offer, while relying on specialists for detailed formulation work.
• You hold a chemistry degree or equivalent technical qualification (preferred).
• You are hands-on and dynamic, with a genuine drive for technical business development, comfortable owning a customer relationship from technical scoping through to in-line support.
• You communicate and build relationships strongly across customers, internal specialists, and management.
• You are willing and able to travel approximately 50% of the time, mainly shorter trips to customer sites, conferences and trade shows, not extended multi-week travel.
• You have a self-starting mindset suited to a startup environment, comfortable with ambiguity and building processes as the business scales.
You are fluent in English and German; additional European languages are an asset given EOC's customer base.

Are you an experienced procurement professional looking to make an impact in a dynamic international aviation environment? As a Senior Purchaser, you will play a key role in ensuring the availability of critical parts and materials that keep our helicopter operations running safely and efficiently worldwide.

Acting as the link between operational departments and our supplier network, you will balance urgent operational requirements with commercial performance, supply continuity, quality, lead times and cost efficiency. In addition to day-to-day purchasing activities, you will help drive continuous improvement across our procurement processes, supplier strategies and supply chain performance.

👉Please note that this is an expression of interest only. We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities and are not actively recruiting for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Managing strategically important supplier relationships and acting as the main point of contact for supplier-related matters. 

• 
Driving supplier performance improvements focused on service levels, lead times, cost efficiency and overall performance.

• 
Collaborating with internal stakeholders to resolve supplier performance issues and ensure continuity of supply. 

• 
Managing procurement activities, purchase orders and supplier agreements while ensuring compliance with agreed terms.

• 
Monitoring open purchase orders and proactively following up to avoid operational delays. 

• 
Maintaining accurate purchasing records and ERP system data.

• 
Providing support for Aircraft on Ground (AOG) situations and participating in the on-call rotation approximately every 4 to 5 weeks.

• 
Acting quickly on urgent procurement requests to minimize aircraft downtime. 

• 
Supporting the development of procurement processes, supplier strategies and supply chain initiatives.

• 
Identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, supplier performance and cost control across the organization.

We are looking for a proactive and commercially minded procurement professional who thrives in a fast-paced operational environment and enjoys building strong supplier relationships.

You bring:

• 
A bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience. 

• 
Previous experience in a purchasing role. 

• 
Experience working with ERP systems such as Navision or SAP. 

• 
Strong negotiation and influencing skills. 

• 
Professional proficiency in English; French is considered an advantage.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Good IT skills and digital literacy.

• 
Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 

• 
Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

• 
The ability to remain flexible and resilient under pressure.

• 
A collaborative approach and the ability to build strong relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders.

Are you ready to begin or further develop your career in procurement within an international aviation environment? As a Junior Purchaser, you help ensure that the parts and services needed for our base and line maintenance activities are available at the right time, in the right place and at the best possible cost.

Working closely with experienced purchasers, internal stakeholders and suppliers, you will support an accurate and reliable purchasing process. You will follow up open orders, maintain procurement data and help resolve delivery issues in accordance with our internal procedures.

👉Please note that this is an expression of interest only. We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities and are not actively recruiting for this position at this time.

Your responsibilities include:

• 
Creating and managing purchase orders while checking pricing, accuracy and compliance with agreed terms and internal procedures.

• 
Monitoring open purchase orders and following up with suppliers to support the timely delivery of parts and services.

• 
Maintaining accurate purchasing records, supplier information and data within our ERP and procurement systems.

• 
Identifying and escalating potential delays, discrepancies and supply risks.

• 
Acting as a day-to-day contact for suppliers regarding order status, delivery information and discrepancies.

• 
Supporting the resolution of late deliveries, shortages and other delivery-related issues.

• 
Assisting with supplier performance monitoring and collecting information for follow-up actions.

• 
Working closely with colleagues in purchasing, maintenance, logistics and other internal departments.

• 
Contributing ideas to improve order follow-up, data quality, team efficiency and service levels.

• 
Gradually building your procurement knowledge and taking ownership of purchasing activities.

You will also participate in the Aircraft on Ground, or AOG, on-call rotation approximately once every four to five weeks. During these time-critical situations, you will coordinate with suppliers, logistics providers and internal teams to help minimize aircraft downtime. This out-of-office-hours support can be provided remotely from home.

We are looking for an accurate, proactive and motivated colleague who is eager to learn and develop within an international procurement environment.

You bring:

• 
A bachelor’s degree or an equivalent level gained through experience.

• 
Initial experience in purchasing, supply chain, logistics or an administrative role, which is considered an advantage.

• 
Experience with an ERP system such as Navision or SAP, or a willingness to learn.

• 
Professional proficiency in English.

• 
Knowledge of French is considered an advantage.

• 
Good written and verbal communication skills.

• 
Good IT skills and digital literacy.

• 
An interest in developing your negotiation and influencing skills.

• 
Strong organizational and analytical abilities.

• 
A proactive, solution-oriented and results-driven approach.

• 
Attention to detail and the ability to remain flexible under pressure.

• 
A collaborative mindset and the ability to build professional relationships.

• 
A genuine willingness to learn and grow within the role.

As a Business Analyst, you start from the business and its processes rather than from a predefined IT solution. You engage with various stakeholders, identify their challenges and needs, and seek to understand how processes actually work today.
You analyze the current way of working, identify bottlenecks and opportunities, and work together with the business to define a clear as-is and to-be situation. You ask critical questions, align different interests and help determine which changes can deliver the greatest added value.
You then translate these insights into clear business requirements, processes, objectives and solution directions. Throughout this process, you maintain a view of the bigger picture and ensure that proposed solutions align with operational reality and the broader digitalization strategy.
You work closely with Product Owners, Project Managers, Architects, Functional Analysts and development teams. While the more functional or technical profiles focus in greater detail on the concrete software implementation, you remain primarily responsible for the business context, process logic, scope and stakeholder alignment.
Throughout the project, you remain involved in validation and decision-making, ensuring that the final solution genuinely addresses the original business problem.

• 5+ years of experience as a Business Analyst or in a similar role. More experience is certainly welcome
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree
• You have strong communication skills and can interact comfortably with operational employees, management and IT professionals
• You communicate professionally in English and understand Dutch and French

Due to a large number of opportunities, we are looking for a driven 
Sales Coordinator / Tender Specialist to strengthen the Sarens Projects team. In this role, you aim to provide clients with a structured, solution-oriented, and clear proposal within the agreed timeline. In collaboration with the Key Account Manager, you clarify the proposal and respond to the client's questions. 
 

Your future responsibilities as a Tender Specialist include: 
 

• Analyzing and summarizing client requests. 
 

• Developing proposals for technical requests and projects in collaboration with the responsible Key Account Manager to achieve the best balance between budget, scope, and timing according to client needs. 
 

• During the bidding process, you collaborate with various support departments such as engineering, logistics, HR, SHEQ, finance, etc. You coordinate their input and deliverables while respecting deadlines to create a structured, high-quality proposal that meets both internal and external expectations.

• Timely and accurately submitting proposals/tender documents after internal approval and following up on them with the Key Account Manager. Responding to internal and external questions and making adjustments where needed.

You have a strong interest in the world of specialized transport and heavy lifting. You possess good reading and listening skills, enabling you to detect and anticipate customer needs. You think outside the box in search of the best solution. You are a sociable team player with a strong sense of responsibility. You work in a structured and precise manner, with attention to detail. Your profile:

• Interest in or experience with sales support, technical inside sales, tender engineering, etc.

• Salary based on experience (and orientated on salary scales of Belgian Universities)

• Support creation of marketing materials and content  
• Analyze consumer trends and competitor activities  
• Share insights on the lifestyle, habits, and culture of younger adult consumers  
• Work closely with sales, trade marketing, and external partners

Flexible start date between October and December 2026, minimum 3 months and maximum 6 months.  
 
Work environment 
 
Work from our GHQ office in Leuven. The office is just a ten-minute walk from the Leuven train station.  

Compensation: 
 
Unpaid (with potential for full-time employment post-internship)

• Students with strong knowledge of their own consumer world and peer culture  
• Curious, creative, digitally fluent  
• Interest in marketing and consumer trends  
• Proactive, hands-on, team-oriented  
• Strong communication and organizational skills  
• You are fluent in English and Dutch or French 
• You are proficient in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with Nielsen is a plus. 
• You have an internship agreement from your University. 
 
 
 
Why build your career with us: 
 
We recruit for mindset, ambition, cultural fit, and growth opportunities. 
 
UNIQUE CULTURE  
We are proud to be part of something bigger than ourselves and are passionate about building upon our company's long legacy. We believe in collaboration and candor, which results in a dynamic culture with open communication. 
  
BRANDS EVERYONE LOVES  
We are part of the collective, global history of beer. We are the proud makers of more than 500 iconic brands, from beloved international classics to local favorites. 
 
GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES  
Our people grow at the pace of their talent. We empower our people to learn, expand their perspectives, and unlock career growth. 
 
If this sounds like the incredible opportunity you've been waiting for, apply today.

Plouvier Group is looking for a Safety Advisor to join our team.
 

With 
20 vessels and 165 colleagues, Plouvier operates a modern inland tanker fleet across Europe. We are looking for an experienced QHES professional with a strong background in 
ADN, dangerous goods and inland tanker operations.
 

As 
ADN Safety Advisor, you will play an important role in maintaining regulatory compliance and continuously improving QHES standards across our fleet.
 

Your role
 

You will be responsible for ensuring that our vessels, procedures and documentation remain compliant with 
ADN and applicable inland shipping regulations.
 

Your key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Ensuring 
ADN compliance across the fleet. 

• Acting as 
ADN Safety Advisor and providing practical guidance to vessel crews. 

• Monitoring regulatory developments and translating them into clear procedures. 

• Conducting and reviewing 
risk assessments, work permits and safety procedures. 

• Supporting incident and near-miss investigations and corrective actions. 

• Maintaining accurate and traceable 
QHES and ADN documentation. 

• Working with Captains, crew and Superintendents through 
focus groups to identify risks and improve procedures. 

• Supporting 
SIRE/VIQ, BIQ, TMSA, OCIMF and ADN audits and inspections.  

 

Your profile
 

We are looking for someone who combines strong 
ADN knowledge with practical experience in the maritime or inland shipping sector.
 

You have:
 
 

• A valid 
ADN Safety Advisor certificate. 

• Practical experience with 
ADN and dangerous goods. 

• Experience in 
inland tanker shipping is highly valued. 

• Knowledge of QHES, HSE and 
Safety Management Systems (SMS). 

• Experience with risk assessments, incident investigations and audits. 

• Excellent attention to detail and strong organisational skills. 

• The ability to turn regulations into practical solutions for vessel crews. 

• Fluent English, German and Dutch 

• A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience. 

• Experience with SIRE/VIQ, TMSA or OCIMF is an advantage.

• 

Trilingual: Fluent in English, Dutch, and French (essential! ). 

• 

Skilled and Professional: Strong administrative, linguistic, and interpersonal abilities. 

• 

Self-starter: Comfortable working independently and managing multiple tasks. 

• 

Well-presented: Classic, professional attire required (no casual wear). 

• 

Reliable and Organized: Punctual, detail-oriented, and proactive. 

Your Responsibilities: 

You are entrusted with overseeing daily operations and ensuring the smooth running of our services. Your duties will include, but are not limited to: 

• 

Welcoming and assisting clients, visitors, and suppliers (EN/NL/FR). 

• 

Managing communications: Answering phones professionally and routing calls as necessary (EN/NL/FR). 

• 

Office Operations: Handling incoming and outgoing mails/packages, filing, data input, and client file management. 

• 

Client Support: Coordinating meeting room and event requests, arranging lunches, and preparing new client offices. 

• 

Problem-Solving: Addressing customer requests, issues, and complaints promptly and professionally. 

• 

KYC – Handling client files in accordance with our obligations under anti-money laundering regulations. 

• 

Administration and Commercial Support: Control, update, and complete client files/data. Process new requests, conduct visits, and be the key to successful new collaborations through meticulous commercial support. 

• 

Facility Oversight: Performing daily checks of common areas, ensuring a tidy and functional workspace, managing stock, and handling kitchen appliances. 

• 

Administrative Reporting: Providing regular reports to management and overseeing office supplies and operations.

- Language, administrative, and interpersonal skills are essential. 

- Computer proficiency: Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, etc.). 

- Multitasking ability: You manage responsibilities efficiently and gracefully. 

- Team player mentality: Though you work independently, you enjoy regular contact with clients and colleagues. 

- Professional ethics: You respect the company, maintain confidentiality, and demonstrate appropriate behavior toward colleagues, management, clients, and partners. You know where the boundaries lie.
 

- Commitment: Understanding the responsibilities and requirements associated with a small organisation in a competitive sector.
 

- Punctuality
 

- Working remotely is not possible for this position.
 

- Dress code in line with the neutrality policy – classic and professional attire.

Your role

As a Customer Service Agent, you will be the main point of contact for customers, workshops and other parties involved. Your goal is to provide excellent customer service while ensuring that every case is followed up accurately and efficiently.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
Handling incoming phone calls and customer inquiries.

 
• 
Managing emails and providing clear and professional responses.

 
• 
Gathering information and checking data for accuracy and completeness.

 
• 
Providing first-line technical support and communicating with workshops.

 
• 
Keeping customers and all relevant parties informed about the progress of their case.

 
• 
Following up and monitoring agreements with all parties involved.

 
• 
Managing contract-related issues within the agreed deadlines.

 
• 
Managing several cases and tasks simultaneously while maintaining a high level of service.

Working hours

The position is Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturday work during particularly busy periods.

You will work in rotating shifts between 07:00 and 22:00.

Flexibility regarding working hours is essential for this position.

Your profile

We are looking for someone who is customer-focused, communicative and able to multitask in a fast-paced environment.

Knowledge & experience

 
• 
Very good English – essential for the position.

 
• 
Good knowledge of German.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Dutch.

 
• 
Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, etc.).

 
• 
Previous experience in administration, customer service or case management is a strong asset.

 
• 
Technical knowledge of the automotive sector, tyres or mechanics is a plus, but not required.

 
• 
No specific experience is required, as full training will be provided.

Skills & personality

 
• 
Excellent telephone communication skills.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

 
• 
Naturally customer-oriented and service-minded.

 
• 
Able to multitask and manage several cases at the same time.

 
• 
Accurate, organised and committed to delivering high-quality work.

 
• 
Stress-resistant and able to remain calm in challenging situations.

 
• 
Flexible and quick to adapt to new tools, procedures and situations.

 
• 
Reliable, motivated and eager to learn.

jobs.employer_name: Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels NV
jobs.description:
Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

To strengthen our Supply Chain department, we are looking for a Team Leader Configuration & Marshalling.

The Configuration & Marshalling Team Leader ensures effective preparation, coordination, and follow-up of the team's activities in compliance with company standards and procedures. The role involves allocating work according to weekly objectives and priorities set by the Completion Manager, while also actively participating in daily operational activities and supporting the team when required.

Your role:
Reporting to the Completion Manager your main tasks and responsibilities are:
Team Management:

• Lead and coordinate daily team activities
• Identify problems, perform root cause analysis, and implement solutions
• Allocate resources based on priorities and objectives
• Monitor skills and ensure development plans
• Ensure compliance with quality standards and company rules
• Manage shift handovers

Daily Operations:

• Perform configuration and marshalling tasks
• Act as technical reference
• Train new employees
• Provide operational backup when needed
Communication & Continuous Improvement:

• Report key issues to the Completion Manager
• Communicate effectively within the team
• Contribute to process improvements

Your profile:

• Secondary education or equivalent experience
• Knowledge of aircraft engine components
• Understanding of quality systems and processes
• ERP and IT proficiency
• Team management skills
• Awareness of logistics risks
• Able to manage priorities and urgent issues
• Able to identify anomalies and suggest improvements
• Working knowledge of French and English required

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels, a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, is located at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium). We specialize in the inspection, maintenance, and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. 

Over the past years, we have successfully expanded our team of Jet Engine Mechanics. As we continue to grow, we are now looking for a limited number of additional mechanics who combine strong technical skills, precision and a genuine passion for aircraft engines. We are looking for people who aspire to become true LEAP engine specialists and who want to contribute to one of the world's leading LEAP engine MRO facilities.

The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

Your Role
As a Jet Engine Mechanic, you will ensure the airworthiness and performance of LEAP engines through maintenance, disassembly & assembly. Your responsibilities include:

• Managing engine induction into the workshop and reporting defects or damage
• Dismantling and assembling engine modules
• Ensuring compliance with quality, safety, and environmental requirements
• Participating in continuous improvement projects
• Completing technical documentation for traceability
• Reporting anomalies in work instructions and proposing improvements

Your Profile
We are looking for mechanics who take pride in delivering high-quality work.

You bring:

• Technical high school diploma in mechanics, aeronautics or a related field
• Strong mechanical aptitude and interest in aircraft engines
• A high level of precision, ownership and attention to detail
• A strong quality and safety mindset
• Curiosity, motivation and a willingness to continuously learn
• Excellent technical English; Dutch and/or French
• Willingness to work in a two-shift system (6:00 AM - 2:00 PM / 2:00 PM - 10:00 PM)
• The ability to thrive in an international, multicultural team

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

A.Collection knowledge
-Develop an in-depth understanding of the hotels in the collection, their positioning and unique features.
-Become fully familiar with the group's brand standards and digital ecosystem.

B.Digital content audits
-Conduct detailed audits of content across the official website, booking engine, OTAs (Booking.com, Expedia, etc.), Google Business Profile, B2B/MICE platforms (Cvent) and other partner platforms.

C.Content harmonization and updates
-Ensure consistency of information across platforms: hotel descriptions, room categories and names, amenities and services, visual content and photo libraries, editorial tone and brand image.
-Continuously update and optimize content.

D.Search engine and AI model (LLM) optimization

-Regularly audit how the collection's hotels are represented in AI-generated answers, identify gaps or inaccurate information, and coordinate corrections.
-Support the improvement of quality and standardization of hotel data to help AI systems interpret it correctly.

E.Monitoring and continuous improvement in generative AI
-Actively track the fast-moving evolution of large language models (LLMs) and AI-powered search tools, along with emerging best practices (GEO ¿ Generative Engine Optimization, AEO ¿ Answer Engine Optimization).
-Translate this ongoing monitoring into concrete recommendations and continuously adjust content strategy as algorithms and tools evolve.
-Share learnings and best practices with the Marketing team and other stakeholders across the group. F.Liaison with the collection's hotels
-Act as the main point of contact for hotel properties' local teams for the collection, validation and regular updating of their content (information, photos, offers, events).
-Maintain regular follow-up with each property to ensure responsiveness, reliability and freshness of content across all platforms.

G.Content moderation and quality control
-Moderate, review and approve all content published on the collection's hotel websites prior to going live.
-Ensure compliance with editorial guidelines, brand standards, legal requirements and accessibility norms across all platforms.
 

H.Technical and cross-functional coordination
-Work with IT/web development teams, hotel properties and external agencies to resolve technical issues (broken links, outdated pages, faulty forms).
-Coordinate translation and localization of content across the collection's markets and languages.
-Manage a publishing calendar and prioritize update requests coming from individual properties.

I.Monitoring, reporting and continuous improvement

-Stay current on best practices in content moderation, SEO and user experience.

-Experience with one or more CMS platforms (WordPress or equivalent) and web analytics tools (Google Analytics, Search Console).

At Dow, our Analytical Science organization plays a critical role in accelerating innovation, supporting manufacturing excellence, and solving complex technical challenges across our global businesses.
 

The Analytical Science team in Seneffe is a key part of this global network, providing world-class analytical expertise to support research, product development, process optimization, and customer-focused innovation. Working closely with global R&D, manufacturing, and business teams, you will provide critical insights that support product development, process optimization, manufacturing excellence, and customer-focused innovation.

Responsibilities

• Manage and maintain state of the art NMR instrumentation including cryoprobe technology. 

• Interpret complex analytical data and provide technical leadership on projects involving materials characterization, process optimization, and product performance.
