- Provide top-tier support for live on-site or off-site technical issues regarding residential energy products via phone, chat, email or other channels
- Follow best practices in case handling, follow-up, and documenting interactions and work performed with great detail
- Become highly knowledgeable in the technical operation and complexities of Tesla’s energy products
- Understand and troubleshoot proprietary power electronics systems and their supporting components
- Read and understand single-line diagrams as they pertain to PV and storage systems as well as load and meter component placement
- Review operational logs in proprietary and non-proprietary applications
- Identify trending issues, collect information and report findings to leadership and engineering teams
- Identify process and knowledge gaps and submit feedback that leads to better training and resources
- Become a subject matter expert (SME) in residential Tesla energy products.

- Fluency in English and Spanish is required for this role

- Outstanding written and verbal interpersonal communication skills
- Experience and understanding of customer service, technical support and engineering environments
- Ability to document interactions and steps clearly, accurately and with detail

jobs.occupation: 585053 Senior Medical Safety Manager HPM (all genders) (Sicherheits- und Gesundheitsschutz-Koordinator/in)
jobs.description:
In this role, you will have the opportunity to ensure patient safety and regulatory compliance across the full product lifecycle for Hospital Patient Monitoring Portfolio by supporting medical product safety surveillance, adverse event reporting, and proactive risk management activities. You will contribute to timely and accurate safety reporting to regulatory authorities and internal stakeholders, analyze safety data from clinical and post‑market sources, and collaborate cross‑functionally to identify, assess, and mitigate potential safety risks. Your work will play a key role in safeguarding patient well‑being and maintaining compliance with global regulatory standards. Please apply in English.

Your Job

- Support the timely and accurate evaluation, documentation, and reporting of adverse events from multiple sources, including post‑market surveillance, literature reviews, and real‑world data, in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements.
- Analyze safety data from clinical trials and post‑market surveillance to identify potential safety signals, trends, and emerging risks, enabling early detection and proactive risk mitigation actions.
- Assist in the preparation and submission of safety reports and safety‑related content for regulatory submissions and key documents such as Risk‑Benefit Analyses (RBA), Clinical Study Reports (CSR), protocols, and Clinical Evaluation Reports (CERs).
- Collaborate with cross‑functional teams during product development and post‑market phases to assess safety risks and contribute to the development and implementation of effective risk management strategies.
- Conduct scientific literature reviews and ongoing safety surveillance activities to identify new or evolving safety issues and ensure continuous compliance with regulatory standards.
- Respond to safety‑related inquiries from healthcare professionals, patients, and internal stakeholders, ensuring transparent, accurate, and professional communication regarding product safety.
- Support the implementation and continuous improvement of safety‑related processes, policies, and procedures, and maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of evolving medical device safety regulations and guidelines.

You should bring the following

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Medical Science, Nursing, Clinical Science, or an equivalent discipline.
- 7-10 years of experience in Medical or Clinical Affairs within the Medical Devices or Biotech industry.

We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform at Smartly!

Smartly is building the standard path for governed data sharing across product services, analytics, and AI/ML. The Data Platform team owns the contracts, control mechanisms, publication paths, catalog metadata, lifecycle rules, lineage, permissions, and runtime building blocks that make reusable data safe and practical at scale.

This is a role for someone who wants to shape a platform early, while working on concrete production problems from the start. Smartly already has the production systems, Kafka backbone, PostgreSQL databases, analytical consumers, and AI/ML use cases that need a better data foundation. The challenge is to turn that reality into a standard path that engineers actually want to use.

Our first milestone is focused: centrally managed publishing tables in service-owned PostgreSQL databases, captured through Debezium CDC into Kafka, and registered in DataHub with ownership, lifecycle, lineage, and impact-analysis metadata. Longer-term, the platform expands toward self-service data products, governed materialisations, durable shared state, and reusable data across Smartly’s operational and analytical systems.

This is not a role where you only maintain an existing reporting pipeline. You will help design and build the platform path that other engineering teams use when they publish and consume shared data.

What you will do

- Design and build platform services, tools, and workflows for contract-driven data publishing and consumption.
- Build the first production path for platform-managed PostgreSQL publishing tables, Debezium CDC, Kafka topics, and catalog registration.
- Create GitOps-style workflows where contracts, schemas, ownership, lifecycle, compatibility, policy metadata, and runtime desired state are reviewed, validated, and reconciled as code.
- Build tooling that gives product engineers fast feedback before they publish or change data products.
- Help define how Smartly models data products, publishing contracts, schema evolution, field stability, deletion semantics, access policy, lineage, and cost attribution.
- Operate and improve the CDC runtime model, including Kubernetes workloads, source-specific isolation, offsets, schema history, heartbeats, signal channels, lag visibility, replay, resnapshotting, and recovery.
- Integrate platform metadata into DataHub so engineers can discover data products, understand ownership, trace lineage, and reason about the impact of changes.
- Work with product, infrastructure, data engineering, analytics, and AI/ML teams to make the standard path easier and safer than bespoke point-to-point integrations.

What we are looking for

- Strong experience building and operating production software systems, preferably in platform, infrastructure, backend, or data-intensive environments.
- Deep understanding of distributed systems trade-offs: reliability, idempotency, replay, eventual consistency, ownership boundaries, compatibility, and operational failure modes.
- Practical experience with PostgreSQL or other relational databases, including schema design, migrations, transactions, replication, or operational performance.
- Experience with Kafka, event streaming, CDC, Debezium, or adjacent data-movement technologies. Direct Debezium experience is valuable, but strong fundamentals matter more.
- Experience building software that other engineers use: CLIs, internal platforms, control planes, automation, CI validation, developer tooling, or self-service workflows.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud or infrastructure platforms, including runtime isolation, deployment, observability, and operational ownership.
- Ability to turn ambiguous architectural direction into practical increments, make trade-offs explicit, and deliver useful production systems without waiting for perfect certainty.
- Clear written and spoken communication in English. This role involves aligning multiple engineering teams around standards, contracts, and ownership boundaries.

Useful experience, but not required

- DataHub or other data catalog, lineage, or governance systems.
- Open table formats such as Apache Iceberg, object-store-backed data lakes, S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, or analytical storage systems.
- GitHub Actions, policy-as-code, infrastructure-as-code, controllers, operators, or reconciliation-based systems.
- Data contracts, schema registries, Protobuf, Avro, JSON Schema, compatibility checking, field-level metadata, or contract testing.
- Experience supporting analytics, AI/ML, feature-store-style access patterns, or cross-domain product-service integrations.
- Experience with JVM languages and Python, TypeScript, Go, or Ruby.

What we offer you

At Smartly, we offer a place where you can do meaningful technical work while growing with a global team.

- Inclusive global culture built on trust, transparency, open feedback, and respect for different perspectives.
- Global impact through technology used by major brands to plan, create, optimize, and understand digital advertising at scale.
- Wellbeing support, paid holidays, family leave, and sustainable ways of working.
- Equity options, performance-based rewards, competitive compensation, and career development opportunities.
- A flexible hybrid workplace that balances office collaboration with focused remote work. At Smartly we work 3 days a week from the office.

About Smartly

Smartly is an advertising technology company helping brands create, manage, optimize, and understand digital advertising across major media platforms. Our engineering organization builds the systems that connect media, creative, and intelligence capabilities into a product used by customers globally.

We value clear communication, ownership, curiosity, and collaboration across teams. We want Smartly to be a place where people can do strong work, grow, and feel respected.

Not sure you tick every box? Please apply anyway. We care about strong engineering fundamentals, ownership, curiosity, and the ability to build reliable systems with others. Direct experience with every technology listed here is less important than the judgment to learn, reason from first principles, and ship useful platform capabilities.

About Smartly

Search and Ranking are among the most demanding disciplines in applied machine learning. A successful system needs to understand user intent, retrieve relevant candidates, rank them effectively and meet demanding requirements for latency, scalability and measurable customer impact.
To strengthen our team, we are looking for someone with first relevant hands-on experience who is eager to grow into a strong Applied Machine Learning Engineer. In this role, you will work on production systems combining classical information retrieval, deep learning, embeddings and Large Language Models and contribute across the entire lifecycle from initial idea and evaluation to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.
We look forward to receiving your application as a (Junior) Data Scientist (m/f/d) Search at CHECK24 AI Forge GmbH.

Was Du mitbringst:

- You have successfully completed a degree (typically a Master's) in computer science, mathematics, statistics, physics, electrical engineering or a comparable quantitative field, with strong grades in quantitative subjects
- At least one year of relevant hands-on experience in machine learning or data science is part of your background, including relevant experience gained through working-student positions, internships or your own projects
- Strong Python skills and practical experience with machine-learning or deep-learning frameworks such as PyTorch are part of your technical toolkit
- Solid classical machine-learning skills like gradient boosting, regression and feature engineering are evident in your CV, beyond LLM or RAG applications
- You have practical experience with applications based on Large Language Models, LLM evaluation, tool use or agentic workflows
- A solid understanding of machine-learning fundamentals and systematic model evaluation enables you to assess and improve model performance
- Practical experience with APIs (e.g. FastAPI), containers and Git, ideally a deployed service, complements your interest in building complete production services
- Knowledge of information retrieval, semantic search, recommender systems or learning-to-rank approaches is a plus
- You have English proficiency at C1 level or higher; German is a plus but not required

Zu Deinen Aufgaben zählen:

- You develop and improve machine-learning services for retrieval, ranking, query understanding and classification
- Hybrid search solutions combine lexical retrieval, embeddings, neural models and components based on Large Language Models
- Model development covers training, fine-tuning and systematic evaluation for semantic search, relevance prediction and learning-to-rank use cases
- You create reliable evaluation datasets and metrics and validate improvements through offline evaluations, user signals and A/B tests
- Production-ready services are built from prototypes using technologies such as Python, FastAPI, Docker, PyTorch and vector databases
- Modern AI-assisted and agentic engineering workflows enable efficient prototyping, testing and continuous improvement
- You research promising approaches in information retrieval, recommender systems and Large Language Models and translate them into measurable customer impact

Development and responsibility

- Work with Sales Leadership and Channel Management to implement systematic account tagging and CRM controls that enforce segregation policies and provide full visibility into coverage boundaries
- Conduct regular audits of direct and partner account assignments to detect and resolve boundary violations, ensuring compliance with Mitel's channel programme terms
- Partner with Legal, Finance, and Channel Programme teams to ensure compensation and incentive structures reinforce the segregation between direct and indirect sales motions

4. Process Excellence & Continuous Improvement

- Own and deliver process training programmes for Sales, PreSales, and Sales Management teams across DACH — preparing materials, conducting sessions, and monitoring adoption

5. Technology, Reporting & Business Intelligence

- Own the deployment and optimisation of enabling technologies including CRM across the DACH region — ensuring data integrity, compliance with global standards, and maximum ROI from Mitel's technology investments
- Monitor the accuracy and efficient distribution of sales reports and intelligence essential to the DACH sales organisation; recommend revisions to existing reports or develop new reporting tools as needed

- Participate in DACH Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) calls, providing Sales data and CRM insights to inform supply chain and inventory planning
- Coordinate CRM data and process alignment with the DACH Marketing team to support campaign execution, pipeline generation, and lead management

6. Deal Desk Oversight & Bid Approval Management

- Provide leadership and strategic oversight of the DACH Sales Deal Desk — ensuring accurate Named Account checks, partner certification verification, competitive analysis, and deal matrix generation for the indirect channel pipeline
- Govern the Bid Approval Management process for the DACH region, overseeing Executive Deal Reviews (Level 1), coordinating approvals in Salesforce, and maintaining thorough documentation and filing of all bid decisions
- Define and continuously refine Deal Desk processes and rules of engagement, managing escalations and ensuring cooperation between direct sales, channel teams, and deal desk resources
- Conduct Named Account list reviews on a regular basis, ensuring accurate maintenance and alignment with agreed direct/indirect coverage boundaries

7. Sales Incentive Compensation

- Working with Finance, HR, and the global Revenue Operations team, provide assistance with sales incentive compensation administration — including arbitration and clarification of compensation policy application
- Ensure compensation and incentive structures are aligned to reinforce go-to-market strategy and channel segregation objectives

8. Governance, Management Support & Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Support the DACH leadership team in Risk Control Board activities, audit processes, and governance obligations — acting as the Sales Operations representative in regional management forums
- Act as a key liaison between DACH Sales management and global Revenue Operations/Sales Operations leadership, ensuring regional priorities are well represented and global programmes are effectively localised

- Direct and support the consistent implementation of company initiatives across the DACH sales organisation
- Build peer support and strong internal relationships with key management personnel across Finance, Marketing, HR, Legal, and IT

The EMEA Infrastructure Development team is seeking a Senior Cost Estimator to serve as the subject matter expert in construction cost estimating across Tesla's EMEA portfolio, including Service Centers, Retail Stores, Delivery Hubs, and Non-SSD sites (R&D, Training, Offices, etc.) You will drive the transition from decentralized regional estimating to a centralized EMEA-wide approach — defining the methodology, standards, templates, and governance for how projects are evaluated. You will deliver independent, reliable construction cost estimates at every project stage, giving project teams, designers, procurement, and leadership a trusted reference for go/no-go decisions.

- Solid understanding of CapEx cost estimating from ROM through detailed CapEx budgeting; proven experience with quantity take-offs and design document interpretation
- Experience maintaining or developing pricing databases or cost libraries at a portfolio or multi-country level
- Ability of identifying main risks especially during ROM which could significantly impact the costs in a later stage

The S4 program at Siemens Energy, formally called S4E or S4E‑Unify, is one of the major global Business- & IT Transformation Programs within Siemens Energy (SE). At the same time, S4E-Unify is aiming for the optimization and harmonization of SE’s worldwide Business Processes across all Business Areas, Regions and Functions. Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. In everything we do and in everything we say, we strive for the best possible ways to help our business serve our patients.
By putting our colleagues in Drug Development Departments for chemical and biological entities (CMC) at the center of our actions, we jointly identify, develop, and implement innovations that enable faster and better decisions across the overall Boehringer Ingelheim pipeline. With the rapid advent of generative AI, LLMs, and agentic technologies, we have the opportunity to accelerate this dramatically and fundamentally change the way we work. Only very few IT roles offer such a direct connection to Boehringer Ingelheim's scientific value chain.
As our Senior System Engineer for Agentic AI / LLM solutions, you will help shape the transformation of CMC into the era of generative and agentic AI. You will work hands-on with and for our business to develop solutions ranging from simple agents to designing and building complex solutions from scratch, while also driving implementation and upskilling initiatives that accelerate the adoption of these technologies across CMC.

- In your new role, you will design, develop, deploy, operate, and continuously enhance highly complex and globally distributed GenAI agents, multi-agent systems, workflow automations, and data integrations
- You will develop production-ready solutions based on modern software engineering, DevOps, and AI-assisted development practices
- Working closely with business stakeholders, you will identify, prioritize, develop, and deliver AI-based use cases that drive measurable business value while adhering to security, privacy, and Responsible AI standards
- You will explore and evaluate the latest GenAI, LLM, and agentic technologies, turning innovative ideas into scalable solutions that accelerate business value and enhance future readiness
- You will shape the foundation for scalable AI innovation by defining governance frameworks, operating models, and architectural standards that drive the successful development and continuous improvement of GenAI, LLM, and agent-based solutions.

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Bioinformatics, Life Sciences, or a related field, combined with several years of relevant professional experience in AI, software engineering, digital innovation, or related disciplines.
- Hands-on experience designing and implementing LLM-based agents, multi-agent systems, workflow automations, and data integrations (e.g., using Python, modern API frameworks, orchestration frameworks, or MCP/tool-calling patterns).
- Proven experience developing, deploying, and maintaining software solutions in enterprise environments using modern software engineering, containerization, CI/CD, and AI-assisted development practices.

- Ability to work directly with business stakeholders to translate needs into practical technology-based solutions, applying structured problem-solving approaches and integrating relevant data sources.

jobs.description:
The position is located at the Department of Trauma and Orthopedic Surgery, University Hospital Erlangen, within the research group Musculoskeletal Inflammation in Traumatology, led by Prof. Jana Riegger-Koch. Our research focuses on the cellular and molecular mechanisms underlying musculoskeletal diseases, particularly osteoporosis, impaired fracture healing, and age-related and post-traumatic osteoarthritis. Two central research pillars are the complement system and its role in inflammation and tissue degeneration, and cell fate decisions in response to cellular stress and injury, including differentiation, senescence, and cell death. We aim to translate these mechanistic insights into novel therapeutic strategies for tissue protection and regeneration. More information: www.riegger-lab.de ( https://www.riegger-lab.de/ )

- Independently plan, perform, and analyse laboratory experiments

- Contribute to laboratory management and coordination of technical staff
- Participate in teaching activities, including practical courses and lectures
- Present research findings at national and international scientific conferences
- Prepare scientific manuscripts and contribute to grant applications

Qualifications

- PhD in life sciences, such as molecular medicine, biology, or a related discipline
- Strong background in musculoskeletal diseases, mitochondria, immunology, and/or molecular biology
- Hands-on experience in cell culture techniques, fluorescence microscopy, molecular biological techniques (e.g., qRT-PCR, siRNA transfection, and others), Western blotting, and/or histology
- Excellent written and spoken English skills

Additional advantages

- Experience in bioinformatics, omics technologies, or single-cell analysis
- Experience in supervising students, preparing grant applications, or working with laboratory animals
- A strong publication record
- German language skills

We offer

- Profile B (Nutanix Insider): A leader with deep Nutanix product, organizational, and GTM knowledge who possesses established ties into the SAP ecosystem.

The Strategic Alliances organization at Nutanix is a high-impact team focused on building and scaling partnerships that help enterprises modernize infrastructure and simplify hybrid multi-cloud operations. Our team collaborates cross-functionally with Product Management, Systems Engineering, Sales and Marketing to deliver differentiated, outcome-based solutions to our customers. - Advance compatibility, supportability, and certification paths (including Nutanix AHV where applicable) to remove customer adoption barriers.
- Align Nutanix enterprise infrastructure solutions with SAP’s core application and platform roadmap.

Manage Secondary Strategic Partnerships (EMEA)

- Drive business development and partner growth for strategic partnerships in EMEA (including NetApp), leveraging complementary infrastructure solutions.
- Identify cross-partner synergies to unlock joint enterprise opportunities.
- Adapt and support additional regional alliance initiatives as business priorities evolve.

We offer a PhD position in the research group of Dr. Frederik Kotz-Helmer, which is embedded within the NeptunLab led by Prof. Bastian E. Rapp at the Department of Microsystems Engineering (IMTEK), University of Freiburg. NeptunLab is a highly interdisciplinary research environment focusing on the development of novel materials, manufacturing technologies, and processes for industrial applications. Research from the NeptunLab has been published in leading international journals, including Lab on a Chip, Advanced Materials, Angewandte Chemie, and Nature, and has received attention from national and international media outlets such as the BBC, The New York Times, and the Discovery Channel.
Glass is an essential engineering material for applications ranging from optics and photonics to microtechnology and high-performance components. However, conventional glass manufacturing technologies strongly limit the geometries that can be produced and often require complex and energy-intensive processing routes.
Within this PhD project, a novel extrusion-based manufacturing technology for glass will be developed. The approach is based on highly filled thermoplastic nanocomposites containing silica nanoparticles dispersed in a polymeric binder system. These materials are shaped in the polymeric state by extrusion and subsequently converted into dense, transparent glass through debinding and sintering.
A major focus of the project will be the development of thermoplastic nanocomposites with tailored rheological and mechanical properties. Polymer composition, molecular weight, particle loading, particle dispersion, and processing conditions will be systematically investigated to establish relationships between material formulation, flow behavior, extrusion stability, and the geometry of the resulting components. Structured extrusion dies will be used to directly manufacture complex cross-sectional geometries, providing a new route toward continuous manufacturing of structured glass components.
The successful candidate will work at the interface of materials science, polymer processing, rheology, nanocomposites, and glass technology. The project combines fundamental materials research with the development of a new manufacturing process and therefore provides substantial freedom for both scientific investigation and technology development.
Developing highly filled thermoplastic silica nanocomposites for extrusion-based glass manufacturing.
Designing polymer binder systems with tailored rheological, mechanical, and debinding properties.
Developing and optimizing extrusion processes for complex and microstructured geometries.
Investigating the relationship between extrusion parameters, die geometry, material flow, and dimensional accuracy.
Designing and evaluating structured extrusion dies for the continuous manufacturing of complex glass components.
Characterizing nanocomposites and glasses using techniques such as SEM, XRD, FTIR, Raman spectroscopy, rheology, thermal analysis, and optical characterization.
Establishing quantitative material-process-structure relationships for extrusion-based glass manufacturing.
Presenting research results at international conferences and publishing findings in peer-reviewed journals.

jobs.description:
Shape the Future of Engineering Test & Validation

We are a leading global software company dedicated to the world of computer aided design, 3D modeling and simulation - helping innovative global manufacturers design better products, faster! With the resources of a large company, and the energy of a software start-up, we have fun together while creating a world class software portfolio. Our culture encourages creativity, welcomes fresh thinking, and focuses on growth, so our people, our business, and our customers can achieve their full potential.

Our Testing business sits at the heart of this transformation. As products become more software-defined, connected, electrified, and complex, manufacturers need to bring together physical testing, data acquisition, simulation, analysis, and engineering software into a connected validation process.
This creates a significant growth opportunity - and we are looking for an exceptional commercial leader to lead it across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland (DACH).

The Opportunity
As Test Country Lead (w/m/d) DACH, you will own the commercial success and growth of the Siemens Test business across the region.
You will lead the Sales and PreSales organization while remaining highly visible in the market and directly engaged with strategic customers. This is a player-coach leadership role: you will build and develop a high-performing organization while personally shaping major opportunities, executive relationships, and strategic accounts.
You will spend at least 50% of your time with strategic customers and in the market, ensuring that you remain close to customer priorities, technology trends, competitive dynamics, and the opportunities shaping the future of engineering test and validation.
This is an opportunity to build and grow a significant business in one of the world's most important engineering markets, supported by Siemens' global technology portfolio, resources, and customer relationships.
What you will ownLead the DACH Test Business

- Own the overall commercial performance of the Test business across Germany, Austria, and Switzerland.- Drive revenue, growth, profitability, and market-share objectives across hardware, software, maintenance, and customer & engineering services.- Define and execute the regional business strategy and annual operating plan.- Identify new growth opportunities, markets, customers, and routes to market.- Establish clear commercial priorities, KPIs, and accountability across the organization.

Lead from the Market- Personally engage with strategic customers and executive stakeholders, building trusted relationships at C-level and senior engineering levels.- Lead major strategic sales pursuits and complex, multi-year opportunities.- Develop compelling value propositions and quantified business cases that connect technology investment to measurable customer outcomes.- Understand customer engineering and validation challenges and translate them into differentiated Siemens solutions.- Maintain a strong understanding of market trends, competitor strategies, technology shifts, and emerging customer requirements.- Represent Siemens Test at customer events, industry conferences, and executive forums.

Build a High-Performing Sales Organization- Lead, coach, and develop the DACH Sales and PreSales organization.- Recruit and retain exceptional commercial and technical sales talent.- Create a culture of accountability, customer obsession, collaboration, and continuous improvement.- Align individual strengths and expertise with strategic market opportunities.- Establish clear development and succession plans for key roles.- Raise the overall standard of consultative, value-based, and solution-oriented selling.

Win in a Competitive Market- Develop differentiated strategies for strategic accounts and competitive opportunities.- Build strong account and territory plans that increase market penetration and customer value.- Lead competitive positioning across the Test & Validation landscape.- Govern Proof-of-Concept engagements with clear success criteria, commercial objectives, and transition plans.- Develop and manage a high-performing partner ecosystem to extend market reach and accelerate growth.

Connect Customers with Siemens Technology

- Work closely with global Product Management, Industry, Engineering, and Services teams to bring the right solutions to customers.- Ensure that customer feedback and market intelligence directly influence regional and global strategy.- Drive adoption of the broader Siemens portfolio by connecting test, measurement, simulation, engineering software, and services into compelling customer solutions.- Ensure operational excellence through accurate forecasting, disciplined opportunity management, reliable demonstrations, and measurable sales performance.

What You Bring

We are looking for an accomplished Sales Director, Business Leader, or Commercial Leader who combines strong sales leadership with a deep understanding of engineering-driven technology markets, especially in test & validation.

- A successful track record in B2B sales leadership within engineering software, test & measurement, validation, simulation, industrial technology, or a closely related field- Experience leading Sales and PreSales organizations with direct responsibility for regional business performance.- A proven record of winning complex, high-value opportunities involving multiple technical, commercial, and executive stakeholders.- Strong experience developing strategic accounts and building long-term relationships with senior engineering and executive decision-makers.- Experience selling solutions such as test & measurement, data acquisition, test automation, validation, simulation, NVH, HIL/XIL, engineering software, or related technologies is highly valuable.- Strong commercial judgment and demonstrated success in negotiations and complex deal structures.- The ability to translate sophisticated technology into clear customer value and compelling business outcomes.- Experience building, coaching, and motivating high-performing sales organizations.- A strong external network and understanding of the DACH engineering and manufacturing ecosystem.- Experience working with strategic partners and developing indirect routes to market.- Strong understanding of industries such as Automotive & Transportation, Aerospace & Defense, Electronics & Semiconductors, Energy, and Industrial Machinery.- Excellent executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and storytelling skills.- Willingness to travel regularly across the DACH region and internationally.- Highly proficient spoken and written German and English.

Why Us

We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across many countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

jobs.occupation: Data & AI Engineer (all genders), PharmaHera Service GmbH (Data-Warehouse-Analyst/in)
jobs.description: Deine neue Umgebung: Behind PharmaHera is Atida - one of Europe's leading online pharmacy groups, serving over 5 million customers across 9 countries. Together with the CEPD Group, we combine more than 25 years of pharmaceutical expertise with digital excellence to redefine the online pharmacy experience: We are building a trusted, personalized health ecosystem that guides people from prevention to cure - backed by medical expertise and driven by our conviction: Pharmacy is about people. Based in Berlin, we serve as the group's competence center for Germany and the Netherlands. As a specialized partner, we manage e-commerce, marketing, IT, and logistics for our local mail-order pharmacies, such as APONEO. Our European markets run on a single, standardized data platform (our Foundation layer). Your mission for the future: To transform this data infrastructure so it is not only usable by people, but specifically prepared for AI agents that read, analyze, and autonomously act on it. The role Reporting to the Data & AI Engineer Lead, you will own the data pipelines, datasets, AI agents and tools built on top of Foundation, and you will build most of them with AI agents as part of your toolchain. The role sits one level of abstraction above the code: you specify, review and take responsibility for systems rather than typing every line. Core responsibilities Pipeline development: build and optimize data flows in Apache Airflow, from our European markets into BigQuery. Modeling in BigQuery: implement tables and views in the Foundation layer, guaranteeing KPI comparability across Spain, France, Italy and Germany. Semantic layer and data contracts: keep business definitions consistent across dashboards, models and agents, and define the schema, granularity and quality a dataset guarantees. AI-assisted delivery: use Claude Code and the Anthropic API as your everyday engineering environment -- turn a requirement into a precise specification, let the agent produce the pipeline, then review, test and own the result. Building for agents: expose Foundation through MCP tools and skills so that AIDA and our decision agents can query it reliably. A dataset is finished when an agent can use it without being misled. Evaluation: build the evals, checks and monitoring that tell us whether an agent's output is correct. Unit tests are not enough for non-deterministic systems. Data products: design data products for management, finance, commercial, operations and marketing -- reusable across markets. Visualization and reporting: work with the business team on reports and consumable datasets in Apache Superset. Code and traceability: clean Python and SQL, with every task traceable through our GitLab-Coda integration. Agent-generated code included. Your Profile & Tech Stack What You Bring to the Role (Must-Haves): Education & Experience: 2+ years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Data Science. AI-Assisted Engineering: Regular, demonstrable use of an LLM coding agent (Claude Code or equivalent) in daily work, plus the technical judgment to critically review agent-generated code. Tech Stack & Cloud: Solid experience with Google Cloud Platform (especially BigQuery), Apache Airflow, strong SQL, data-oriented Python, and version control via Git/GitLab. Languages: Fluent English for daily collaboration within our international team. Mindset & Work Ethic: Strong analytical skills, an independent and results-focused approach ("you get the problem and context, the solution design is yours to propose"), and a commitment to deeply understanding code rather than using AI as a blind shortcut. What Rounds Off Your Profile (Nice-to-Haves): Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol), LLM APIs, ClearML, Docker, or Apache Druid. Know-how in evaluating non-deterministic systems and using BI tools (ideally Apache Superset). Industry experience in the healthcare, pharmacy, or e-commerce sectors, plus basic knowledge of German. What we are not looking for Someone who ships code they cannot explain. Someone who needs a ticket with the solution already inside it or with full requirements in place. We act fast: you get the problem, the context and access -- the design is yours to propose. Someone who uses AI as a shortcut and doesn't understand the problem they are solving. Someone who only thinks short-term. We build future-proof solutions. What You'll Get Your Work Environment: Freedom to Shape Your Role from Day 1: A position of responsibility with real opportunities for growth, where you can proactively drive initiatives and actively help shape strategies. Permanent, Full-Time Position: Long-term prospects in a future-proof market. Agile Work Environment: A motivated, dynamic team and flat hierarchies with short decision-making paths that enable fast execution. Flexibility with Team Spirit: Flexible working hours and a hybrid work model (mobile work & in-office) - with a focus on our Berlin office to foster collaboration and team cohesion. Direct Mentoring: Close collaboration and mentoring by the Data & AI Engineer Lead in a technically demanding environment. Hands-on Production Tech Stack: Real-world experience with Airflow, BigQuery, Druid, GCP, and a modern production AI stack (Claude, MCP, Agents, Evals). Professional AI Tooling: First-class AI engineering tools come as standard equipment. Your Benefits at a Glance: Health & Mobility: Urban Sports Club membership at an unbeatable price and a heavily discounted BVG corporate transit pass for your daily commute. Exclusive Perks: Attractive employee discounts on our entire APONEO product range, access to a wide variety of corporate benefits, and a Selgros card. All-Round Care: An on-campus cafeteria, free fresh fruit, vegetables, and snacks every day, plus an unlimited coffee and tea flat rate. Your Compensation & Terms: For this full-time, permanent position, we offer an attractive, market-based, and competitive compensation package. We anticipate an annual gross salary between EUR45,000 and EUR55,000 p.a. Together, we will determine your exact positioning within this range through a transparent process based on the following criteria: Your relevant practical work experience in Data & AI Engineering. Your professional qualifications and specific additional skills. Our internal salary structure to ensure fairness within the team. Equal Opportunity & Fair Pay: We don't leave fair pay to chance. We compensate all team members in equivalent positions transparently and fairly, regardless of gender or any other personal characteristic. Ready to join? Ready to actively shape the future of e-commerce and data-driven healthcare at Atida? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your CV and your earliest possible starting date.

Responsibilities

- Requirements and test management: Reviewing requirements and developing corresponding test cases.
- Planning, designing, documenting and implementing software and system tests.
- Coordinating and carrying out system and integration tests.
- Developing and maintaining test environments and the associated test infrastructure.
- Contributing to the development of new functions and creating the associated test models.
- Automating tests, including the development of automated test scripts and tools.
- Evaluation and selection of suitable tools and technologies for testing Safety PLCs.
- Supporting the continuous improvement of test strategies, test methods and processes.
- Ensuring and implementing quality requirements in accordance with internal and external standards.
- Ensuring the traceability of requirements through to test cases and test results.
- Reviewing and evaluating test results, including reporting and documentation.
- Carrying out qualitative fault analyses and assisting with root-cause analyses.
- Working closely with the development teams to seamlessly integrate testing into the development process.

Requirements

- A degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering or a comparable qualification.
- In-depth experience in software design, testing methods and programming skills, ideally in Python and/or Robot Framework.
- Knowledge of relevant functional safety standards (e.g. IEC 61508) and security standards (e.g. IEC 62443-4-X).
- Experience in working with safety PLCs and knowledge of industrial communication protocols such as Profinet, Ethernet/IP, Modbus, etc.
- A strong focus on quality and a systematic, analytical approach.
- Experience in working with test management tools and version control systems (e.g. Polarion, SVN, Git, or similar tools).
- Knowledge of test automation, including the development of test scripts for Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) environments.
- Experience in carrying out system and integration tests, ideally in the field of safety or embedded systems.
- Understanding of hardware-level testing and interfaces between software and hardware.
- Ability to work in interdisciplinary teams and to communicate technical content clearly and precisely.
- A structured and independent approach to work, with a focus on meeting deadlines and achieving objectives.
- Good written and spoken German and English.

- Work cross-functionally with technical experts, service teams and product management.

Keys to Success:

- Proven experience selling complex technical solutions to manufacturing customers.
- Experience within one or more of the following industries is highly desirable:
- Metal

- Battery Manufacturing
- Experience working with distributors or channel partners is desirable.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Strong consultative selling and negotiation skills with a customer-focused mindset.
- Excellent presentation and communication skills for both technical and business audiences.
- Ability to understand complex manufacturing processes and translate them into customer-focused technical solutions.
- Understanding of AI and digital technologies as emerging commercial enablers within industrial markets.

Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

You assess current systems, infrastructure, and business processes to identify improvement opportunities and ensure compatibility with new solutions

- 
You collect and analyze stakeholder requirements to define solution scope and objectives

- 
You architect the Mercedes Pay Digital Voucher Solution, detailing structure, components, interfaces, and data flows, and select suitable technologies, platforms, and tools

- 
You create proof-of-concept projects to validate solutions and demonstrate feasibility

- 
You work with an experienced team of Solution Architects as well as the company's Enterprise, Cloud and Security Architects to derive right-fit solutions

- 
You facilitate the collaboration with external development teams, ensuring adherence to architectural guidelines and best practices

- 
You communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating complex technical details into accessible language

- 
You document solutions and disseminate best practices among team members

Qualifikationen

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TABLE

- 
You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field

- 
You have 5+ years of experience as a Solution Architect, with a strong focus on software product development

- 
You have practical experience in at least one of the following domains: regulatory environments, agentic commerce, loyalty programs, vouchers, digital marketing, or payments (including PCI DSS, PSD2/SCA, or AML/KYC)

- 
You are proficient in microservices, event-driven architectures, cloud-native technologies (e.g., Kubernetes, CI/CD), Auth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) protocols, alongside practices like Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and DevOps

- 
You have hands-on experience with tools such as Jira, GitHub, and Datadog

- 
You have a proven track record of implementing cutting-edge technologies within a corporate environment

- 
You possess strong teamwork and good communication skills, with the ability to maintain composure under pressure

- 
You are fluent in English; German language skills are a strong plus

OUR OFFER TO YOU

·       Modern and dynamic work environment

·       Flexible and mobile working

·       Attractive fitness offer

·       Numerous employee discounts

·       Excellent infrastructure

jobs.occupation: Postdoc Position in Preclinical Development of Bicyclic Peptides for Nuclear Medicine (Biochemiker/in)
jobs.description:
The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

The DKFZ is a place where the brightest minds pursue bold ideas and seek answers to pioneering scientific questions through collaboration, innovation, and exploration across many disciplines. We provide a dynamic environment which empowers excellence with state-of-the-art technologies, cutting edge infrastructure, and a global scientific network. 

Contribute your knowledge, vision, and dedication to create a space where scientific discovery in cancer research is transformed into benefits for human health.

Together with selected university partner sites, the DKFZ has established the German Cancer Consortium (DKTK) (https://dktk.dkfz.de/en) . The alliance between the DKFZ as the core center and the university partner sites in Berlin, Dresden, Essen/Düsseldorf, Frankfurt/Mainz, Freiburg, Heidelberg, Munich, and Tübingen operates joint translation centers at the University Medical Centers of each of the selected partner sites. The DKTK contributes significantly to filling the translational gap between basic and clinical cancer research, thereby developing new strategies for personalized oncology in prevention, diagnosis, and treatment of cancer. DKTK conducts transformative translational cancer research, educates the next generation of translation-oriented medical and clinical scientists and establishes strong pipelines towards clinical cancer research and the economy.

At the DKTK partner site Freiburg, we are offering, starting at the earliest date possible, a Postdoc Position in Preclinical Development of Bicyclic Peptides for Nuclear Medicine.

The Division of Radiopharmaceutical Development at DKTK Freiburg focuses on the development and clinical translation of novel radiopharmaceuticals for molecular imaging and targeted radionuclide therapy. A key emphasis is on radiotheranostics, from the identification of new targets and tumor-targeting compounds to preclinical evaluation and first-in-human translation.

The position is located at the University Medical Center Freiburg, Department of Nuclear Medicine (www.uniklinik-freiburg.de/nuklearmedizin/radiopharmakaentwicklung).

Your Tasks

The position is part of a long-term collaboration with the company Bicycle Therapeutics (https://www.bicycletherapeutics.com/)  and covers the preclinical characterization of novel bicyclic peptides for clinical translation. This established and successful research platform includes the identification and evaluation of novel radiopharmaceuticals for positron emission tomography (PET) and radionuclide therapy. The relationship between DKFZ and Bicycle Therapeutics has expanded to include a more continuous and purpose-driven commitment towards advancing candidates towards the clinic. The current project aims at the preclinical development and clinical translation of novel radiolabeled, tumor-targeting bicyclic peptide conjugates for diagnostic and therapeutic application in nuclear medicine. The bicyclic peptide conjugates are synthesized by solid phase synthesis and modified by bioconjugation chemistry. Finally, the conjugates are labeled with several clinically relevant radioisotopes for in vitro and in vivo evaluation. Your task is to elaborate the scientific data within this work plan and to communicate the results with our collaboration partner. 

Your Profile

- Master's degree and PhD in biochemistry, chemistry or pharmacy or equivalent
- Experience in peptide chemistry and related analytical methods
- Experience in biological assays and in vivo experiments would be advantageous
- Good communication skills in English
- Motivation to work in an interdisciplinary team
- Interest in application-oriented / translational research

To apply, please submit a brief cover letter stating your motivation, a curriculum vitae as well as certified copies of your university degrees with grades (BA and MA certificate / Diploma / PhD certificate) and contact details of two referees via our online application portal.

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Possibility of mobile work and part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being
- Develop your full potential: access to the DKFZ International Postdoc Program and DKFZ Career Service with targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

Contact:

Prof. Dr. Matthias Eder
Phone: +49 761270 74220

Duration: The position is initially limited to 2 years with the possibility of prolongation.

Application Deadline: November 05, 2026

Applications by e-mail cannot be accepted.

Please also note that we cannot return applications submitted by post.

We are convinced that an innovative research and working environment thrives on the diversity of its employees. Therefore, we welcome applications from talented people, regardless of gender, cultural background, nationality, ethnicity, sexual identity, physical ability, religion and age. jobs.description:
Job available in 8 locations: Bremen, Leipzig, Hannover, Remote, Düsseldorf, Berlin, Frankfurt, Hamburg

Work Schedule
Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions
Office

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

BioProduction Group (BPG) at Thermo Fisher Scientific is dedicated to providing innovative solutions for bioproduction and bioprocessing. Our team focuses on developing and delivering high-quality products and services that support the manufacturing of biopharmaceuticals, vaccines, and cell and gene therapies.

Location
Germany or Austria, ideally based in the Frankfurt area or northern Germany, within convenient reach of a major airport or transportation hub.

Territory covers Germany and, depending on home location, Austria. Travel up to 50% across the assigned territory.

Discover Impactful Work
As a Field Application Scientist (FAS) (m/f/d) within the BioProduction Group, you will serve as a bioprocessing domain expert, helping biotechnology and biopharmaceutical customers accelerate technology adoption, process development, and optimization across downstream workflows.

You will engage with customers on a peer-to-peer, application-focused basis, providing technical leadership and process expertise before, during, and after the sale. Acting as a trusted advisor and problem solver, you will help customers achieve compliant, efficient, and high-performing processes using Thermo Fisher Scientific solutions. You will also play an important role in shaping future innovations by capturing and communicating Voice of Customer (VOC) insights.

A Day in the Life:
Serve as a technical expert and consultant, applying deep bioprocessing knowledge across purification, filtration, and single-use technologies. Engage with customers on a peer-to-peer basis to support process development, optimization, scale-up, and technology integration across downstream workflows.

Lead pre- and post-sales technical activities, including product evaluations, proof-of-principle (PoP) studies, technology qualification, and implementation in regulated environments. Contribute to pre-sales activities by delivering technical presentations on the features, benefits, and applications of POROS™ and CaptureSelect™ products, addressing downstream purification challenges and positioning Thermo Fisher Scientific capabilities against customer requirements.

What to expect:

- Provide comprehensive technical troubleshooting and act as an initial point of contact for product quality and performance issues, partnering with Quality, Field Service, and Technical Support to ensure timely and compliant resolution.
- Deliver technical training to internal and external audiences, including process scientists, engineers, and operators, to build capability and confidence in Thermo Fisher Scientific technologies and workflows.
- Conduct workflow consultations and GEMBA walks at customer sites to identify process improvement opportunities and align technical solutions with operational and business objectives.
- Support Bioprocessing Development Center (BDC) activities, customer trials, and on-site demonstrations, ensuring consistent technical messaging and execution excellence.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Government Affairs Manager at Siemens Energy, you will help shape the political, regulatory, and geopolitical environment in which we operate. You will translate policy developments into business opportunities, build trusted relationships with government stakeholders, and support Siemens Energy’s leadership in advancing the global energy transition.
Working closely with Business Areas, regional leadership (Hubs), and Executive Board Members, you will identify emerging political trends, assess risks and opportunities, and develop advocacy strategies that support the company’s growth agenda. You will be the interlink to and representative for selected HUBs and the corporate Government Affairs department. Your work will directly contribute to creating favorable market conditions for energy infrastructure, decarbonization technologies, grid modernization, and energy security solutions. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Monitoring and analysis of political, regulatory, and geopolitical developments
* Advocacy, stakeholder engagement, and relationship management across key public and industry stakeholders
* Political positioning and policy support aligned with Siemens Energy’s strategic priorities
* Identification of policy-driven business opportunities, including incentives, industrial policy, and funding programs
* Preparation of executive briefings, talking points, stakeholder dossiers, and strategic assessments
* Cross-functional coordination and external representation to strengthen Siemens Energy’s positioning in the global energy transition

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Political Science, Public Policy, International Relations, Economics, Law, or a related field
* Several years of professional experience in Government Affairs, Public Affairs, Public Policy, Regulatory Affairs, diplomacy, consulting, or related fields
* Strong understanding of European and international energy policy, industrial policy, and geopolitical developments
* Proven stakeholder management, analytical, strategic, and communication skills, including executive-level presentations and briefing materials
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced international environment, manage multiple priorities, and demonstrate high integrity and commitment to compliance
* Fluent English and good German; additional languages advantageous

About the Team

The Government Affairs department supports Siemens Energy's mission to become the world's most valued energy technology company. We connect business priorities with public policy, identify geopolitical risks and opportunities, and work with governments and institutions to promote energy security, industrial competitiveness, and decarbonization. Our team combines policy expertise, stakeholder engagement, geopolitical analysis, and strategic advocacy to create business value and enable long-term growth across global markets.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

The Single-cell Open Lab at the German Cancer Research Center is seeking, starting in January 2027, a Staff Scientist as Parental Leave Replacement.

The Single-cell Open Lab (scOpenLab) provides state-of-the-art infrastructure and scientific expertise for single-cell sequencing and spatial omics. Our goal is to enable researchers to perform advanced experiments independently: we advise users on experimental design, provide hands-on training, and support them throughout project optimization, experimental implementation, and library preparation.

Our technology portfolio covers a broad range of single-cell and multi-omic approaches, including single-cell RNA, DNA, and chromatin profiling, as well as spatial transcriptomics and spatial proteomics. Beyond providing access to established technologies, method development is an important part of our work. We continuously evaluate, adapt, and establish emerging single-cell and spatial technologies and develop customized experimental workflows. Examples include HIPSDR-seq for joint single-cell DNA and RNA profiling and the implementation of new spatial omics approaches. The scOpenLab is also closely involved in MultiSpace, the platform for spatial omics within the Health + Life Science Alliance Heidelberg Mannheim. Through MultiSpace, we collaborate with other technology platforms and research groups to enable multimodal spatial profiling and the integration of spatial transcriptomic, proteomic, and other molecular readouts.

Your Tasks

We are looking for a research scientist to cover a period of parental leave and join our interdisciplinary team. The position combines user support and training with hands-on experimental work and technology development, offering the opportunity to work at the forefront of rapidly evolving single-cell and spatial omics technologies with the following tasks:

- Planning and designing spatially resolved transcriptome and proteomics projects with our users
- Training of new users for spatial and single-cell omics assays
- Optimization and integration of new methods in the lab with a focus on multimodal approaches
- Organizing and driving early access programmes
- Scheduling and maintenance of service infrastructure for image-based spatial transcriptomics

Your Profile

- University degree in life science (MSc), additional PhD preferred
- Experience and very good knowledge of NGS techniques, library preparation, tissue handling, and imaging (skills in data analysis are a plus)
- Previous work in the single-cell field is certainly an advantage
- Very good knowledge of English and German
- Self-motivation and innovative thinking will be required for the successful implementation of your work. This also includes excellent communication and organizational skills.

Please provide both a CV and a cover letter.

We Offer

- Excellent framework conditions: state-of-the-art equipment and opportunities for international networking at the highest level
- 30 days of vacation per year
- Flexible working hours
- Remuneration according to TV-L incl. occupational pension plan and capital-forming payments
- Possibility of part-time work
- Family-friendly working environment
- Sustainable travel to work: subsidized Germany job ticket
- Unleash your full potential: targeted offers for your personal development to further develop your talents
- Our Corporate Health Management Program offers a holistic approach to your well-being

Are you interested?

Then become part of the DKFZ and join us in contributing to a life without cancer!

The Clinical Diagnostics Division (CDD) provides innovative diagnostic solutions across selected in vitro diagnostics (IVD) market segments and has been a trusted partner to the IVD industry for more than 40 years.

Our portfolio includes solutions for drugs-of-abuse testing, therapeutic drug monitoring, quality control, sepsis diagnosis, prenatal screening and more. In addition, CDD offers advanced laboratory instrumentation and high-throughput automation solutions for a wide range of clinical laboratory environments.

Ideally based in e.g. Halle, Leipzig or Berlin

- Contribute to territory growth through increased clinical adoption and systematic account development.Ensure complete and up-to-date documentation of relevant account and activity information in Salesforce (SFDC).

Education

- Experience in in vitro diagnostics, biomarkers, or clinical areas such as Critical Care, Infectious Diseases, Emergency Medicine, sepsis or Antimicrobial Stewardship is an advantage.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

- Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Supplier Quality Engineer (SQE) for the Electrical Auxiliary Systems of our Gas Turbines, Steam Turbines, and Generators, you will be supporting Siemens Energies growing Power Plant Project Business and be a part of our global supply chain Team. You are responsible to secure the best performing supply base in quality, reliability, and safety and work closely with Procurement and Engineering functions in a multicultural environment. The suppliers in your scope will be the Electrical Auxiliary Systems suppliers in Europe supplying for projects worldwide. Typical equipment in scope includes Power Control Center (Electrical/Instrumentation/Controls), Switchboards, Panel Boards, Switchgears, Low Voltage Transformers, Starting Frequency Converter, Static Excitation System, Batteries & Charging Systems, E-houses, Cables, and Bus Ducting.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Supplier Monitoring: Perform supplier oversight and final product inspection during Factory Acceptance Test for regular project execution to ensure compliance with specification of our electrical components. Create inspection reports and follow up with punch list
* Nonconformance Management: Identify and initiate containment on any identified supplier non-conformances. Follow-up with corrective and preventive action as necessary
* Supplier Performance: Track Supplier performance, create reports and take adequate measures to implement supplier quality improvement- or risk mitigation measures
* Process Excellence: Utilize the various Supplier Quality tools landscape e.g. to create process transparency or generate performance reports. Your ideas on how to evolve our corporate digitalization landscape, for example by leveraging agentic AI, are highly welcome

What You Bring

* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical, industrial engineering, or a similar discipline. Equivalent combinations of education, training, and experience will be considered
* Multiyear professional experience in supplier quality management, quality management, engineering or another related technical role in the Power Generation Industry or comparable industry related to the equipment scope mentioned above
* Knowledge and experience in auditing, with ISO 9001, ISO 14001, and ISO 45001 Lead Auditor certification preferred
* Familiarity with quality methods such as 5 Why, FMEA, 8D, and RCA
* Understanding of specific component technologies and standards (or equivalents) like NEC, NFPA, IEEE, and UL is an advantage
* Willingness to travel approximately 40% of the time and strong communication skills in English

About the Team

Our Gas Services team offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a shareholder of Siemens Energy
* We offer a wide range of options for balancing family and career, such as flexible working time models, childcare facilities at many locations, the option of trial part-time work or a sabbatical
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Mass Properties department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) in the area of Mass Properties

You are a full time student, looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of a Working Student (d/f/m) in the area of Mass Properties?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Mass Properties department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Manching
- Start: January 2027
- Duration: 12 months

Definition working student

Working students (d/f/m) are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our mission

Mass Properties Manching is responsible for defining, calculating, and controlling the mass data set throughout the entire life‑cycle of an aircraft. This data set includes mass, centre of gravity and moment of inertia at component, system and aircraft levels. It is required, for example, for the preliminary design of future projects, structural design, system development, support of flight‑test campaigns, and in‑service support. Consequently, the department maintains interfaces with a variety of disciplines, both within and outside the Flight Physics domain. To keep the growing mass properties data set organised and to trace every change throughout the development of our new projects, we are building a Python‑driven, SQLite‑backed database application. In parallel, we are exploring how AI‑based automation can further increase the efficiency and accuracy of our analyses.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Python Software Development: Develop, maintain, and improve Python-based applications and reusable software components for managing aircraft mass data.
- Database Management: Support the design and implementation of database structures, queries, and data models using relational databases.
