The German Cancer Research Center (DKFZ) is one of Europe’s largest cancer research centers. “Research for a life without cancer" is the mission of our world-class scientists and all our team members.

We investigate how cancer develops, identify cancer risk factors and search for new cancer prevention strategies. We develop new methods with which tumors can be diagnosed more precisely and cancer patients can be treated more successfully. Every contribution counts – whether in research, administration or infrastructure. This is what makes our daily work so meaningful and exciting.

Our Junior Research Group "Epithelium Microbiome Interactions" (headed by Dr. Jens Puschhof) is seeking, starting at the earliest date possible, a Administrative Lab Technician.

In the EMIL group, we study how bacteria contribute to cancer development, metastasis, and treatment response. Our team includes cancer researchers, tissue engineers, microbiologists, and bioinformaticians working together to help patients by deciphering the functional impacts of bacteria in human tumors.
Using tissue samples from patients, we isolate bacterial strains and create organoids. These models can be combined with additional features of the human gut on USB stick-sized devices, “organ chips”, for detailed studies. We transplant organoid-bacteria mixtures into mouse models to study their migration and interaction in a whole-body context.
In our unique biobank at DKFZ, we characterize both tumor organoids and tumor-resident bacterial strains through whole genome sequencing, fluorescence microscopy, and other cutting-edge methods. Based on the diverse data obtained, we develop hypotheses about how specific bacterial species might influence tumors. With our broad portfolio of patient-derived models, our main focus lies on testing these relationships. Through close collaborations with clinical partners, we work towards the rapid translation of our findings into new microbiome-based strategies for the detection, prevention, and treatment of cancer.

Kartago is an international food company specializing in dates, dried fruits, Mediterranean food products, and food ingredients, serving retailers, distributors, wholesalers, and industrial customers across Europe and international markets.

Position Overview

The Sales Manager will be responsible for developing new business, managing existing customer relationships, and supporting the continued growth of Kartago GmbH.

We are looking for someone who is highly commercial and proactive, but also comfortable working in a dynamic environment where the role goes beyond sales. The successful candidate will also support logistics coordination, commercial analysis, customer follow-up, and other day-to-day operational activities when required.

Key Responsibilities

- Develop new customers and business opportunities in Germany and other European markets.
- Manage and grow relationships with existing customers.
- Identify potential retailers, distributors, wholesalers, foodservice operators, and industrial customers.
- Prepare offers, pricing proposals, presentations, and customer negotiations.
- Follow up on leads, samples, quotations, and ongoing commercial opportunities.
- Maintain a structured sales pipeline and provide regular sales forecasts.
- Analyze sales performance, margins, pricing, customer profitability, and market opportunities.
- Conduct market and competitor research.
- Coordinate with suppliers, warehouses, logistics partners, and customers to ensure smooth order execution and deliveries.
- Assist with shipment planning, inventory monitoring, and logistics when required.
- Work closely with management on commercial strategy and business development initiatives.
- Support other operational and analytical tasks depending on the needs of the business.

Candidate Profile

- Minimum 3 years of professional sales experience.
- Strong business development and negotiation skills.
- Experience in the food industry, FMCG, food ingredients, retail, or food distribution is a strong advantage.
- Fluent English is required.
- Strong analytical and organizational skills.
- Comfortable working with Excel, reporting, pricing, margins, and commercial data.
- Able to manage multiple responsibilities and priorities.
- Independent, proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented.
- Strong communication and relationship-building skills.
- Experience with international trade, import/export, or logistics is a plus.

What We Are Looking For

We are particularly interested in someone who does not see sales as simply taking orders. We want a person who can actively develop business, understand customers, analyze opportunities, solve problems, and take ownership from the initial sales opportunity through delivery.

The position offers significant exposure to different aspects of an international food business and the opportunity to grow with Kartago GmbH.

Location: Offenburg, Germany
Employment: Full-time
Industry: Food / FMCG / Import & Distribution

Job Description

About Us

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Our Mission is to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Through our PPD® clinical research services, we support clinical trials in more than 100 countries, delivering laboratory, digital and decentralized solutions that help bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Our global Clinical Operations teams provide end-to-end clinical trial support — from study start-up through close-out — across commercial and government-sponsored studies.

Why Join Thermo Fisher Scientific / PPD?

- Work on high-quality, global clinical trials across diverse therapeutic areas

About the Role

We are seeking a highly experienced Principal Clinical Research Associate (CRA) to lead and coordinate all aspects of clinical monitoring and site management for complex clinical trials. Acting as a subject-matter expert and site process specialist, you will ensure trials are conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP, applicable regulatory requirements, and internal SOPs—ensuring subject safety, data integrity, and continuous audit readiness.

In this principal-level role, you will manage complex and high-risk studies across multiple sponsor and monitoring models (e.g. FSO, FSP, government-sponsored research). You will serve as a key escalation point for sites and project teams, take a leadership role on assigned studies, and actively contribute to the mentoring and development of junior and senior CRAs alike.

What You’ll Do

Principal-Level Clinical Monitoring & Oversight

- Lead monitoring activities for complex, high-risk, or strategically important clinical trials using a risk-based monitoring approach
- Independently conduct on-site and remote monitoring visits in line with approved monitoring plans
- Perform and oversee SDR, SDV, and CRF review, ensuring the highest standards of data accuracy and integrity
- Evaluate investigational product accountability through physical inventory and records review
- Ensure essential documents are complete, inspection-ready, and compliant with ICH-GCP and applicable German/EU regulations
- Lead site initiation, maintenance, and close-out activities, providing expert guidance and recommendations

Quality, Risk & Issue Management

- Apply advanced root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking, and problem-solving methodologies to identify systemic site issues
- Strategic Project & Stakeholder Collaboration
- Serve as a trusted partner to investigative sites, sponsors, and internal project teams
- Identify trends across sites and studies and provide strategic recommendations to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM)
- Ensure accurate and timely updates of study systems (e.g. CTMS) and perform QC reviews where required
- Participate in investigator meetings and support investigator identification and feasibility activities
- Support investigator payment processes and trial financial oversight as applicable

Leadership, Mentorship & Process Improvement

- Actively mentor, coach, and support the development of junior and senior CRAs
- Contribute to project-specific and functional training initiatives
- Identify opportunities for process optimization and drive implementation of improvements
- Provide expert input into monitoring strategies and clinical operations best practices

Administrative & Operational Responsibilities

- Maintain timely and accurate completion of timesheets, expense reports, and required documentation
- Maintain frequent communication with sites between visits to ensure ongoing compliance and issue resolution
- - Drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPAs) to resolution and proactively mitigate risk
- Author high-quality monitoring reports and follow-up correspondence in a timely manner
- Act as a key escalation point for significant site issues, protocol deviations, and compliance risks
- Support and lead activities related to audits, inspections, and regulatory inquiries

Education & Experience

- Bachelor’s degree in a life sciences related field or equivalent qualification
- Minimum 5+ years of experience as a Clinical Research Associate / Monitor
- Valid driver’s license
- Full right to work in Germany
- Fluency in German and English (C1 level) – interviews will be conducted in German

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

- Strong clinical monitoring skills with hands-on RBM experience
- Excellent understanding and application of ICH-GCP and applicable regulations
- Solid therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
- Well-developed critical thinking, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills
- Strong written and verbal communication skills with medical professionals
- High attention to detail and strong organizational skills
- Ability to work independently while contributing effectively to cross-functional teams
- Flexibility and adaptability in a dynamic project environment
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office and ability to learn clinical systems (e.g., CTMS)

Scientist – Quantum Sensors & Qubit Technology (m/f/d)

The Semiconductor Laboratory (HLL) of the Max Planck Society, located on the research campus in Garching near Munich, is a leading facility for the development of highly precise radiation sensors and detector systems. On approximately 1,400 m² of cleanroom space, HLL develops, fabricates and tests advanced semiconductor detectors for applications in X-ray astronomy, particle physics and materials research. With around 50 employees from different nationalities, HLL provides a highly international and interdisciplinary environment in which scientists, engineers and technology specialists work closely together across the entire development chain — from fundamental research and simulation to device design, fabrication and experimental characterization.

To strengthen our activities in quantum sensing and advanced quantum-device technologies, and to provide scientific and technological support to our research, engineering and service teams, we are looking for a Scientist – Quantum Sensors & Qubit Technology (m/f/d) to join our team at the earliest possible date on a full-time basis (39 hours/week). 

Your responsibilities

- Develop and optimize quantum sensor concepts based on qubit systems and quantum effects.
- Perform advanced numerical simulations and modeling of qubit-based sensing systems, including relevant physical processes, noise sources and system-level performance.
- Work closely with technology development, engineering and experimental teams to translate simulation results into practical implementations.
- Analyze experimental data and use the results to refine physical models and sensor designs.
- Contribute to scientific publications, technical documentation and intellectual property.

Your profile

- PhD in physics, electrical engineering, applied physics, quantum engineering or a related field.
- Background in quantum sensing, qubit control and precision measurement.
- Experience with numerical simulation, modeling and system design.
- Analytical and problem-solving skills combined with a practical, technology-oriented mindset.
- Strong motivation to work in close cooperation with technology, engineering and experimental teams.
- Fluency in English; knowledge of German is an advantage.

Advantageous experience

Experience in one or more of the following areas would be particularly valuable:

- Cleanroom / semiconductor / microfabrication experience
- Familiarity with Python, MATLAB, COMSOL or equivalent 
- MEMS/NEMS or integrated sensor technologies
- Precision measurement and low-noise instrumentation
- Experience bridging qubit physics, device design and fabrication technology

What we offer

- International environment, diverse responsibilities and a high degree of autonomy: Flat hierarchies and a collaborative, agile team within an internationally renowned research institution. You will work closely with scientists, engineers and technology specialists across disciplines and have the opportunity to shape the development of innovative quantum-sensing technologies.
- Advantages of the public sector: Remuneration according to the German public service pay scale TVöD (Bund), depending on qualifications and experience; occupational pension scheme (VBL); 30 days of annual leave (31 days as of 2027), plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve. - Work-life balance and compatibility of family and career: Flexible working hours (flextime), opportunities for mobile working, support in finding childcare and care for family members, and a comprehensive company health management program.
- Professional development: Thorough onboarding and opportunities for internal and external training and further education tailored to your individual needs. You will have the opportunity to continuously develop your expertise in quantum sensing, qubit technology, simulation and semiconductor technology.
- Research campus: Excellent access by public transport, including the possibility of a monthly subsidy for the “Deutschland-Job-Ticket”, or by car with free parking in the immediate vicinity of the laboratory. A canteen and further dining options are available nearby, as well as campus-wide events and activities.

jobs.description:
Structural Engineer (all genders) - Material Testing & Structural Validation
Help Accelerate Industrial Decarbonization

Join exceptional people from around the world to solve some of the world's toughest energy challenges, make a real impact, and enjoy the adventure of building the future of industrial decarbonization together.

As our Structural Engineer – Material Testing & Structural Validation, you'll play a key role in developing the lightweight structural systems that make GlassPoint's technology reliable, safe, and scalable.

Working closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams, you'll combine advanced engineering analysis with hands-on testing to validate innovative designs and ensure they perform under real-world conditions. From small-scale material characterization to full-scale component testing, your work will directly influence the next generation of technology.
 

Your Impact

The structures you validate will become part of some of the world's largest industrial solar thermal plants, helping heavy industry reduce emissions while improving energy security.

You'll combine engineering theory with practical experimentation, transforming test results into optimized designs and helping GlassPoint continuously improve the performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness of its technology.

What You'll Do

Design & Improve Structural Systems

- Analyze and optimize lightweight structural systems, components, and structural connections.
- Evaluate the behavior of steel, aluminum, composite materials, and ETFE film systems.
- Support the development of innovative structural concepts for industrial solar thermal applications.
- Transform engineering insights into scalable, manufacturable design improvements.

Lead Material & Component Testing

- Plan, build, execute, and evaluate material and component tests.
- Design and instrument full-scale structural testing.
- Conduct small-specimen material testing to characterize material behavior.
- Analyze test results and translate findings into engineering recommendations.

Develop & Validate Engineering Models

- Develop, calibrate, and improve nonlinear finite element (FEA) models.
- Predict structural behavior using numerical simulations.
- Validate simulation results through physical testing.
- Continuously refine engineering models to improve design accuracy.

Collaborate Across Engineering

- Work closely with Structural, Mechanical, Manufacturing, and Operations teams.
- Support design decisions through data-driven engineering.
- Contribute to solving complex structural challenges across international projects.
- Share technical expertise and help drive continuous innovation.

Who You Are

You're someone who enjoys solving complex engineering challenges and turning analysis into practical solutions.

You combine analytical thinking with a hands-on mindset and enjoy moving between simulations, laboratory testing, and real-world engineering. You're curious, collaborative, and motivated by seeing your work become part of technologies that make a global impact.

Ideally, you'll bring:

- A degree in Structural Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline (ideally with a background in construction, civil engineering, or automotive engineering).
- Several years of experience in structural, material, or component testing.
- Experience working with nonlinear material behavior and structural analysis.
- Strong experience with numerical modelling and nonlinear FEA.
- Hands-on experience planning and executing engineering tests.
- Familiarity with sensors, instrumentation, and measurement systems.
- A structured, analytical, and independent working style.
- Confidence working in an international engineering environment.
- Excellent English communication skills; German is an advantage.
- Experience with foundation systems for solar structures, soil testing, rammed piles, ground screws, or percussion drilling is a plus.
What You'll Find at GlassPoint

- Real ownership and the opportunity to make a meaningful impact from day one.
- Exceptional colleagues from diverse disciplines who challenge, support, and learn from each other.
- Complex challenges that require curiosity, collaboration, and innovation.
- An international team united by a shared purpose and ambitious goals.
- The adventure of helping build the future of industrial decarbonization.
 
We value inclusion and foster a culture of belonging, welcoming team members of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, gender identity, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion, disability, age, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. We have zero tolerance for discrimination, harassment, bullying, or retaliation.
 

GlassPoint helps heavy industry decarbonize by replacing fuel-based steam with solar thermal heat. This reduces energy costs and improves long-term energy security.  We’re a proven technology, already operating some of the world’s largest solar steam projects across sun-belt regions in oil and gas, metals, and mining.

Postdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d) – Experimental Cancer Neuroscience

Full- or part-time | temporary (36 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für Chirurgie

We are seeking an exceptional and highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our internationally active research group at the interface of cancer biology, neuroscience and tumor immunology.
Our group investigates how the nervous system shapes tumor initiation, progression, invasion, metastasis and cancer-associated symptoms, with a particular focus on pancreatic cancer and cancer neuroscience. We combine mechanistic cancer biology with neuroscience, immunology, advanced in vivo models, spatial and single-cell technologies, functional imaging and translational human studies.
Our ambition is clear: to define and lead emerging concepts in cancer neuroscience rather than merely follow them.
The laboratory operates in a highly competitive and well-funded environment with support from, among others, the European Research Council (ERC), Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft (DFG), Deutsche Krebshilfe and Else Kröner-Fresenius-Stiftung, and is embedded in a strong national and international network in cancer neuroscience.

Your responsibilities:

The successful candidate will take a central scientific role in our experimental program and will contribute to the conception, execution and development of ambitious projects addressing neural–tumor–immune interactions.

Depending on expertise, projects may include:

- mechanistic studies of neuron–cancer and neuro–immune interactions
- functional characterization of neural signaling pathways in cancer
- genetically engineered and orthotopic in vivo tumor models
- manipulation of neuronal, immune and tumor-cell populations
- advanced imaging and molecular phenotyping
- integration of molecular, cellular and spatial data with functional experiments
- development of new experimental concepts and therapeutic strategies in cancer neuroscience

A particularly important aspect of the position is the strategic management and further development of our animal experimentation platform.

This may include:

- preparation and coordination of animal study applications and amendments
- planning and supervision of complex in vivo experiments
- establishment and optimization of experimental mouse models
- management of genetically modified mouse colonies
- breeding strategy, genotyping and colony planning
- coordination with animal facilities, authorities and collaborating laboratories
- implementation of high standards in experimental design, documentation and animal welfare

Your profile:

We are looking for a scientist with a strong experimental background in at least one – preferably several – of the following fields: Cancer Biology | Tumor Immunology | Neuroscience | Neuroimmunology | Molecular Biology

You should have:

- a PhD or equivalent doctoral degree in a relevant life-science discipline
- substantial hands-on experience in experimental biomedical research as well as experience with in vivo models, ideally tumor models and/or neuroscience models
- strong expertise in molecular and cellular biology and the ability to independently design, troubleshoot and drive complex experiments
- excellent scientific communication skills in English
- a highly collaborative but intellectually independent working style

Particularly desirable is extensive experience with:

- animal experimentation and experimental planning and preparation or management of animal experimentation applications
- genetically engineered mouse models as well as mouse breeding and colony management
- tumor models and neuroscience or neuroimmunology techniques

We offer you:

- This is not intended to be a purely technical postdoctoral position.
- We offer the opportunity to become a scientifically visible and intellectually independent member of a rapidly developing research program, with substantial room to shape projects and develop an individual research profile. 
- Our goal is to attract scientists who want to build a field, not simply complete a project.
- You will work in an internationally competitive cancer neuroscience environment; ERC-, DFG-, Deutsche Krebshilfe- and foundation-funded research programs; highly interdisciplinary collaborations spanning cancer biology, neuroscience, immunology, surgery, pathology, spatial biology and computational biology
- We offe you projects with strong potential for high-impact publications and a translational environment with direct access to human cancer material and clinically relevant questions as well as an international network of leading scientists in the emerging field of Cancer Neuroscience
- EGYM well pass, corporate benefits and discounts (e.g. Käfer), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers
- Working in the heart of Munich at Max-Weber-Platz with very good accessibility by public transport such as the subway, S-Bahn or tram 

We look forward to meeting you!

Taufkirchen / Full-time / Permanent employee YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

THE WHY

We build pressure vessels and carbon structures for spaceflight. Before our hardware flies, it gets tested — and you keep the testing running. Without you, the test bench stands still.

THE WHAT

You prepare tests, help run them, and document the results. You work in the lab and at the test bench — hands-on, in a team, with real space hardware every day.

Your tasks in detail:

- Prepare and post-process the testing areas: You set up test benches and specimens, tear down after tests, and keep the testing area ready for action. → High Performance: The test bench is ready when the team needs it.
- Run and document tests: You support destructive testing and acceptance testing (NDT) and record every step cleanly. → Accountability: What was tested is documented. No gaps.
- Say what you see: Anything unusual about a specimen, the test bench, or a result — you report it right away, not when someone asks. → Candor: You raise problems before they grow.
- Support the team and infrastructure: You pitch in where needed — in the testing team and with technical infrastructure on site. → Togetherness: We win as a team.
- Learn new things: NDT methods, new test procedures, new materials — you want to grow. We'll train you. → Playfulness: Curiosity is a strength here, not a distraction.

YOUR PROFILE

- Training: Completed vocational training as a materials tester / Werkstoffprüfer (plastics, metals, or fiber composites/CFRP) or comparable technical training.
- Experience: First experience in a test lab or materials testing is a plus — not a must. What matters more: you want to learn.
- Work style: Motivated, reliable, hands-on. You want the job done — and done right.
- Team player: You enjoy working with others and help out when things get busy.
- Languages: German and English, each at B2 minimum — one of the two confident for daily work.
- On-site: This role is 100% on-site in Taufkirchen. The lab and test bench don't fit in a home office.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Creative freedom & responsibility: Autonomy, scope for decision-making and short implementation paths.
- Flexible working hours & remote option: You can work remotely by arrangement.

- Attractive additional benefits: Choose between Deutschlandticket, EGYM-Well pass or a monthly top-up payment card (GivveCard).

- Dynamic environment: Exciting projects, development opportunities and a start-up atmosphere with agile, cross-functional collaboration.

Job description

In order to support Electrification Technologies department, Airbus Defence and Space is offering an

Internship / Master Thesis: Advanced Power Electronics & Hardware Design (d/f/m)

Are you looking for an internship or a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a Power Electronics Researcher (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Electrification Technologies department as an intern (d/f/m)!

- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn
- Start: December 2026

Are you passionate about power electronics and eager to work on next-generation hardware designs? We offer a flexible and exciting opportunity – whether you are looking for an Internship or a Master Thesis. Join our team to design, simulate, and build innovative power electronic converter systems.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

jobs.description:
Full- or part-time | temporary (24 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für RadioOnkologie und Strahlentherapie

The Department of Radiation Oncology at TUM University hospital is recruiting a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our Radiation Biology Research Group.

Our research focuses on translating novel radiotherapy concepts from experimental models toward clinical application, with a particular emphasis on spatially fractionated radiotherapy (SFRT). We aim to understand the biological mechanisms underlying tumor response and normal-tissue tolerance and to establish the preclinical evidence required for future clinical trials.

The position offers the opportunity to work at the interface of radiobiology, radiation oncology, and medical physics within an interdisciplinary translational research environment.

Your responsibilities:

- Irradiation and dosimetry of mouse cohorts using MBRT and conventional radiation, across single- vs. multi-fraction regimens
- Longitudinal neurobehavioral testing 
- Histological and immunohistochemical analysis of neuroinflammation, vascular, and structural brain changes
- Neurotransmitter profiling and biomarker analysis 
- Statistical and integrative analysis of dose-response and biomarker data to define normal-brain tolerance thresholds
- Close collaboration with scientists and clinicians from radiation oncology, medical physics, and radiobiology, and translation of findings into clinically relevant concepts for future MBRT trials

Your profile:

- We are looking for a highly motivated scientist with a strong interest in experimental and translational radiation oncology and radiobiology 
- A doctoral degree in biology, biomedical sciences, veterinary medicine, or a related field is required 
- Experience with preclinical in vivo models and animal experimentation is desirable 
- Expertise in tumor cell culture, histology, immunohistochemistry, or molecular biology would be an advantage 
- A background in radiation biology and radiation-induced normal-tissue effects would be advantageous 
- The ability to independently plan, conduct, analyze, and document experimental studies is expected 
- A strong interest in interdisciplinary and translational research at the interface of radiation oncology, medical physics, and biology is essential 
- Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in an interdisciplinary research environment are required 
- Flexibility and mobility to make full use of the scientific opportunities and research infrastructure available across TUM sites (TUM University Hospital Rechts der Isar and the Garching Research Campus) 
- Good written and spoken English skills are essential 

We offer you:

- EGYM well pass, corporate benefits and discounts (e.g. Käfer), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers
- Working in the heart of Munich at Max-Weber-Platz with very good accessibility by public transport such as the subway, S-Bahn or tram 
- Company pension plan through the Federal and State Pension Institute (VBL) 
- Self-realization through a varied and technically demanding job with interdisciplinary cooperation between various departments of the TUM Klinikum

We look forward to meeting you!

The Coating Engineer is part of a team of Mechanical and Materials Engineers within the Turbine Design Department. * Execution and support of coating qualification activities for turbine hot gas path components
* Evaluation of in‑process manufacturing data with regard to design intent

Apply Now
Product Security Senior Specialist (f/m/d) - Sovereign Cloud

Date: 09/23/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

SAP LeanIX is expanding into Sovereign Cloud environments - a strategic initiative that will make our product available to customers in regulated industries and the public sector who operate under strict data residency, security, and compliance requirements.

We are starting with NS2 in the United States, with the ambition to extend to further sovereign and government cloud environments globally over time.
This is a greenfield effort that spans engineering, product, and compliance, and it includes building the infrastructure, processes, and capabilities to meet the highest standards of data sovereignty while delivering the full power of SAP LeanIX to an entirely new category of customers.

The SAP LeanIX Security, Compliance and Governance team is looking for a motivated  Product Security Senior Specialist to engage in activities related to the SAP LeanIX Information Security Management System, and drive implementation and design of compliance controls for the SAP LeanIX Enterprise Architecture portfolio. This position puts particular focus on Sovereign Cloud / Cloud in Country certifications such as FedRAMP or equivalent national standards, and on control ownership for selected cross-engineering controls.

What You'll Do:

- 
Work together with colleagues in development, governance and security functions.

- 
Organize workshops and trainings for control owners and security champions to better understand requirements and best practices.

- 
Assist in compliance certification efforts for Sovereign Cloud and Cloud in Country environments for LeanIX Enterprise Architecture portfolio, including frameworks like FedRAMP, or equivalent national standards.

- 
Translate complex regulatory and government compliance requirements into actionable technical tasks and policy updates.

- 
Stay current with global and local regulations related to data sovereignty, privacy, and government cloud security to ensure proactive compliance.

- 
Collaborate with certification bodies and internal certification intermediaries.

- 
Engage as control owner for selected cross-engineering controls that are owned by the LeanIX Security, Compliance and Governance unit.

- 
Oversee the resolution of Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) items.

- 
Coordinate certification projects and small networks of functional colleagues for successfully obtaining certifications.

- 
Engage in Audit sessions together with internal and external auditors.

What You Bring:

- 
Bachelor’s degree in information technology, Information Security or related Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) disciplines.

- 
7+ years in Information Security, with at least 4 years focus on GRC (Governance, Risk, and Compliance), IT Audit, or a similar compliance-related role.

- 
Proven experience leading certification or attestation projects for at least one major information security framework (e.g., ISO 27001, SOC 2, C5).

- 
Deep understanding of GRC assessment methodologies, control design, and the audit lifecycle.

- 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to articulate complex technical and compliance concepts to diverse audiences (from engineers to executives).

- 
Experience with Jira.

- 
You’re an open-minded team player.

- 
Fluent spoken and written English communication skills.

Beneficial skills:

- 
Experience in BCM / DR topics

- 
Direct, hands-on experience with government-specific cloud compliance frameworks such as FedRAMP (US), IRAP (Australia), or similar national programs.

- 
Experience with NIST standards, particularly the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) and controls defined in NIST SP 800-53.

- 
Industry recognized professional certification such as CISSP, CISA, Lead Auditor or SANS

- 
Familiarity with scripting languages (e.g., Python, PowerShell) for automating compliance tasks and evidence gathering

- 
Experience with using AI tools such as Claude.

- 
Spoken and written German communication skills

Meet your team:

The Information Security team is responsible for managing the security of SAP LeanIX enterprise architecture solution in coordination with Product and Engineering organization as well as SAP’s central security team.

Taking a risk-based approach to security, compliance and governance, we support thousands of colleagues and customers within and outside of SAP LeanIX. We team up with others in SAP (e.g., SAP Global Security and Cloud Compliance, SAP DPP, SAP BTP) to identify, implement, and operate technically effective and trade-off efficient security, compliance and governance solutions.

Skills included: Agentic AI Day-to-Day Practice, AI Adoption Capability, AI Output Quality Assurance, Context Engineering, AI-Assisted Automation and Prototyping, Learning Agility, Collaboration, Complex Problem Solving, Creative Thinking, Effective Communication, Information security management, cloud security, application security, security engineering, AI-Assisted engineering.

​

The Academic Partnerships organization at SAP partners with other SAP teams to provide the best services to foster strategic research collaborations between SAP and academia. What you bring:

- Advanced degree (PhD preferred) in Computer Science or Information Systems, with a research focus on large-scale agile development, engineering metrics, or communities of practice in software organizations

The Academic Partnership organization at SAP is the bridge connecting SAP and academia. FACILITIES MANAGER EUROPE (F/M/D)

At Clario, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, we develop regulated technology that helps unlock better evidence and improve patient outcomes worldwide. Our software platforms support clinical trials, diagnostics, and medical decision?making in highly controlled regulatory environments.

As Facilities Manager Europe (f/m/d), you will support Clario's facilities across Europe with a focus on our office in Estenfeld, Germany.

WHAT WE OFFER

*
Competitive compensation.

*
Flexible working hours and working time accounts to support the work-life balance.

*
Hybrid work model, allowing for 1-2 days of remote work after the probation period.

*
Support your professional development through internal and external training and certification programs.

*
Attractive benefits (security, flexibility, support and well-being).

*
Engaging employee programs.

WHAT YOU´LL BE DOING

*
Facilities Operations: Providing overall facilities support by ensuring the seamless delivery of facility operations, building management, structural measures, maintenance teams, housekeeping, reception, cafeteria operations, asset management, visitor management, and security & safety protocols. Clario's primary European facilities are situated in Germany, Hungary, Belgium, Switzerland, and Turkey.

*
Facility Layout Standards and Compliance: Supporting facility layout standards for electrical systems, HVAC, IT infrastructure (phones, conference systems, displays), materials, access control and more. Collaborating with local contractors/vendors/departments to manage these processes through to completion, ensuring compliance with local and state building codes.

*
Site Coordination: Managing and coordinating the logistics involved in opening, relocating, or closing a facility, including security systems, access control, furniture, signage, showroom/marketing requirements, telecommunications, and more.

*
Budgeting and Capital Expenditure: Actively participating in the capital expenditure budgeting process and managing purchasing requests for facility needs. Accurately forecasting and preparing facility-related budgets. Conducting financial and business analysis, including preparing reports on expenditures, savings, and areas for cost optimization.

*
Compliance and Standards Development: Ensuring all facilities are operated and maintained in compliance with local, state, and national laws, company standards, and procedures. Responsible for developing and refining standards as business needs evolve, including ensuring annual occupational safety and fire inspections where applicable.

*
Stakeholder and Management Communication: Maintaining a dotted line to the local management teams, participating in and reporting at management meetings. Building strong relationships with key business stakeholders by collecting feedback and delivering reports on business-critical aspects, such as occupancy, site launches, and facility improvements and audits.

*
External Relations and First Point of Contact: Serving as the First Point of Contact for the landlord, labor inspectorate, municipalities, authorities, and occupational safety departments.

*
Vendor and Contractor Management: Building and maintaining strong relationships with local building management and managing third-party contractors/vendors responsible for facility maintenance and operations. This includes monitoring tasks completed, overseeing technical acceptance, and approving invoices.

*
Lease and Contract Management: Managing leases and facility agreements, including understanding legal terms and commercial contract structures. Ensuring contracts are renewed and negotiated in a timely manner.

*
Sustainability and Energy Efficiency: Supporting sustainability initiatives by tracking, reporting, and working towards reducing emissions and waste across facility operations. Implementing energy-saving initiatives, including tracking energy consumption and suggesting areas for improvement.

*
Crisis and Emergency Management: Developing and maintaining emergency response plans for the facility, including fire drills, evacuation procedures, and pandemic-related safety measures.

*
Training and Development: Coordinating safety and facility-related training for employees to ensure everyone is aware of evacuation procedures, safety protocols, and proper usage of shared resources like conference rooms, equipment, and storage areas.

*
Team Collaboration and Support: Contributing to team success by assisting colleagues in resolving internal issues and supporting shared goals.

*
Quality and Standards Management: Ensuring adherence to organizational SOPs by regularly reviewing and understanding operational guidelines. Supporting the establishment and enforcement of departmental standards to maintain consistent quality service.

*
Technical and Industry Development: Enhancing expertise through active participation in company-sponsored training programs and maintaining up-to-date knowledge of industry trends and emerging technologies to drive innovation and informed decision-making.

WHAT WE LOOK FOR

*
Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management or a comparable degree with a technical background, alongside additional business management training or further development.

*
Five or more years of experience in facilities management or an equivalent role, including proven experience in managing technical building projects.

*
Fluent language skills in both German and English are required. Additional language skills are beneficial.

*
Organizational and time management skills to prioritize tasks and meet established schedules, timelines, or deadlines.

*
Creative problem-solving skills with strong project management abilities.

*
Proficiency in working with computer software, including the MS Office suite.

*
Ability to influence others without direct authority.

*
Strong ability to adapt to changing priorities.

*
A strong desire to succeed while maintaining a professional and positive attitude.

*
Flexibility to travel to our European sites as needed, typically averaging two trips per year.

At Clario, our purpose is to transform lives by unlocking better evidence. It’s a cause that unites and inspires us. It’s why we come to work—and how we empower our people to make a positive impact every day. Whether you're advancing clinical science, building innovative technology, or supporting our global teams, your work helps bring life-changing therapies to patients faster.

Date: 10/08/2026
Company: SAP

We help the world run better
At SAP, we keep it simple: you bring your best to us, and we'll bring out the best in you. We're builders touching over 20 industries and 80% of global commerce, and we need your unique talents to help shape what's next. The work is challenging – but it matters. You'll find a place where you can be yourself, prioritize your wellbeing, and truly belong. What's in it for you? Constant learning, skill growth, great benefits, and a team that wants you to grow and succeed.

Summary & Role Information:

Join SAP Cloud Infrastructure and help build the next generation of cloud services and platform capabilities powering SAP's sovereign and regulated cloud environments.

As a Product Security Senior Specialist, you will be the operational backbone of our Cyber Defense capability — coordinating and steering our external managed SOC partner, integrating security tooling into our cloud operations stack, and ensuring consistent detection, response, and monitoring across 30+ regional datacenters globally, from Australia to Toronto. You will work in close alignment with an internal Expert who leads the Cyber Defense topic strategically, while owning the day-to-day execution independently. We are looking for someone who is self-motivated, well-organized, and can operate with minimal supervision in a fast-moving, globally distributed environment.

What You'll Do:

- Serve as the primary operational interface to our external managed SOC provider and as the primary escalation contact for internal teams during security incidents. Steer service delivery, manage and prioritize the operational backlog, plan sprints and deliverables in line with shifting priorities, define and refine detection use cases, manage escalation processes, and ensure SLA adherence across all regions.
- Integrate and maintain the security toolbelt for SAP Cloud Infrastructure's logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities. Ensure tooling coverage keeps pace with platform expansion into new regions.
- Coordinate incident response processes between the external SOC, internal engineering teams, and stakeholders. Ensure timely triage, containment, and resolution of security events — executing against defined runbooks and operational processes, and continuously identifying improvements as the threat landscape and platform evolve.
- Work with the SOC provider and internal teams to develop and refine threat detection rules, analyze threat intelligence, and adapt the detection strategy to the evolving threat landscape for cloud infrastructure.
- Support vulnerability management processes for SAP Cloud Infrastructure, ensuring findings from scanning, penetration testing, and threat intelligence are tracked, prioritized, and remediated.
- Maintain operational metrics, dashboards, and reporting for Cyber Defense operations. Provide regular status updates to the Cyber Defense Expert and Security Engineering leadership. Identify gaps and inefficiencies in existing operational workflows and tooling, and drive actionable improvements.
- Adapt Cyber Defense operations, tooling, and processes as SAP Cloud Infrastructure expands into new regions with specific regulatory requirements.
- Collaborate across teams to transform security requirements into reliable and observable solutions.

What You Bring:

Technical Foundation

- Several years of experience in security operations — SOC operations, incident response, threat detection, or vulnerability management — in a cloud or large-scale infrastructure environment.
- Hands-on experience managing security incidents, including triage, escalation, containment, and post-incident review in cloud or large-scale infrastructure environments.
- Experience coordinating or managing an external managed SOC provider, including service steering, use-case development, and escalation management.
- Working knowledge of logging, monitoring, and SIEM/SOAR tooling in cloud environments.
- Familiarity with OpenStack and/or Kubernetes from a security operations perspective.
- Experience operating security for multi-region, 24x7 datacenter environments.
- Familiarity with regulatory frameworks relevant to cloud infrastructure operations (e.g. ISO 27001, SOC 2, C5, BSI IT-Grundschutz, ANSSI SecNumCloud).
- Ability to work independently, prioritize across multiple regions and time zones, and manage operational complexity without close supervision.
- Proficiency in scripting and coding for automation of security operations tasks.

We don't expect you to have experience with every technology listed. If you have a strong foundation in several of these areas and are interested in learning the others, we'd be happy to hear from you.

Core AI Skills

- AI-assisted engineering is part of how we work at SAP.
- Experience using AI tools for engineering tasks such as coding, troubleshooting, documentation, and automation.
- Ability to provide effective context and instructions and critically review AI-generated outputs before using them in production.
- Experience using AI to support automation, infrastructure tooling, or prototyping.
- Willingness to share useful AI practices and contribute to their responsible use within the team.

Professional Skills

- Comfortable collaborating across teams, cultures, and locations and sharing knowledge with others.
- Able to communicate technical topics clearly, both verbally and in writing.
- Structured and reliable, with the ability to take ownership while working collaboratively. Able to manage a shifting backlog, re-prioritize deliverables as context changes, and keep external teams aligned to current priorities.
- Curious and pragmatic when approaching unfamiliar or complex problems.
- Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to navigate escalation paths and establish the right contact persons in the face of a dynamically growing organizational environment.
- Fluent English. German preferred. French appreciated.

Tech You Bring

- SIEM/SOAR platforms
- Logging and monitoring tooling
- OpenStack or comparable cloud infrastructure platforms
- Kubernetes ecosystem
- GitHub for configuration and issue management
- Python, Bash, or comparable scripting languages
- Cloud computing environments
- Observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana
- Threat intelligence platforms
- Ticketing systems such as Jira and ServiceNow

Meet the Team:

You will join SAP Cloud Infrastructure Security Engineering, where we build the infrastructure behind SAP's enterprise, sovereign, and regulated cloud environments using technologies such as OpenStack, Kubernetes/Gardener, Ceph, and Prometheus.

Our engineering culture is hands-on and collaborative. We work on real infrastructure problems, share what we learn, and believe a private cloud is something you build, not something you rent.

​

Bring out your best
SAP innovations help more than four hundred thousand customers worldwide work together more efficiently and use business insight more effectively. Originally known for leadership in enterprise resource planning (ERP) software, SAP has evolved to become a market leader in end-to-end business application software and related services for database, analytics, intelligent technologies, and experience management. As a cloud company with two hundred million users and more than one hundred thousand employees worldwide, we are purpose-driven and future-focused, with a highly collaborative team ethic and commitment to personal development. Whether connecting global industries, people, or platforms, we help ensure every challenge gets the solution it deserves. At SAP, you can bring out your best.

We win with inclusion
SAP’s culture of inclusion, focus on health and well-being, and flexible working models help ensure that everyone – regardless of background – feels included and can run at their best. At SAP, we believe we are made stronger by the unique capabilities and qualities that each person brings to our company, and we invest in our employees to inspire confidence and help everyone realize their full potential. We ultimately believe in unleashing all talent and creating a better world.

Job Description

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Our clinical department defines, develops and delivers clinical programmes. Our global Clinical Operations colleagues within our PPD® clinical research services provide end-to-end support for clinical trials from study start up to monitoring through to study close out, across commercial and government contracts. Together, we help clients define and develop clinical programs, minimize delays, and implement high-quality, cost-efficient clinical studies.

The role can be home-based, office-based in Munich or Karlsruhe, or hybrid, and is offered as a permanent full time (1 FTE) or part-time position (0.8 FTE / 80%).

The CRA:

- Performs and coordinates all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process.
- Conducts remote or on-site visits to assess protocol and regulatory compliance and manages required documentation..
- Acts as a site processes specialist, ensuring that the trial is conducted in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and SOPs to guarantee subjects rights, well-being and data reliability.
- Ensures audit readiness.
- Develops collaborative relationships with investigational sites.
- Detailed tasks and responsibilities assigned to role are outlined in the task matrix.
- Travel up to 50-75%

A day in the Life:

- Monitors investigator sites with a risk-based monitoring approach applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks.
- Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities.
- Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review.
- Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards.
- Brings up observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follow all issues through to resolution.
- May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner.
- Conducts monitoring tasks in accordance with the approved monitoring plan.
- Participates in the investigator payment process.
- Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution.
- Investigates and follows-up on findings as applicable
- Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required.
- Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System, CTMS).
- Performs QC check of reports generated from CTMS system where required.
- Participates in investigator meetings as necessary.
- Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites. Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Ensures trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
- Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on-site file reviews as per project specifications.
- Gives to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members. Performs additional study tasks as assigned by CTM (e.g. trip report review, newsletter creation, lead CRA team calls etc).
- Facilitates effective communication between investigative sites, the client company and the PPD project team through written, oral and/or electronic contacts.
- Responds to company, client and applicable regulatory requirements/audits/inspections.
- Maintains & completes administrative tasks such as expense reports and timesheets in a timely manner.
- Gives to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.

Education and Experience

- Previous experience in a clinical environment with exposure to clinical research, healthcare or clinical trials that provides the knowledge and skills required to perform the role
- Valid driver's license
- Full Right to work in Germany

- Effective clinical monitoring skills
- Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
- Excellent understanding and demonstrated application of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents

jobs.description:
The research group for the Topology of Correlated Systems at the TUM Center for Quantum Engineering (ZQE) and the Department of Physics is looking for a postdoctoral researcher (f/m/d) to join the BMFTR-funded collaborative project “GarliQ - Green Advanced Refrigerants: Light-element oxides & intermetallics for Quantum cooling” at the earliest possible date. The position is initially limited to 3 years, full-time.

GarliQ is a collaborative project between TUM and kiutra GmbH, funded under the BMFTR call “Enabling Technologies for Resilient R&D Supply Chains in Quantum Technologies”. The project aims to develop new materials with magnetocaloric properties for use as cooling media in adiabatic demagnetization refrigeration (ADR) systems in the millikelvin temperature range - key components of the cryogenic infrastructure for quantum technologies.

Independent synthesis of magnetocaloric material systems (oxide and intermetallic compounds) via solid-state synthesis and melt crystal growth
Structural characterization of the synthesized materials, including by X-ray diffraction
Investigation of magnetic and thermodynamic low-temperature properties using standard and dilution refrigerator cryostats; as applicable, experiments at neutron and synchrotron sources
Determination of magnetocaloric parameters (isothermal entropy change, adiabatic temperature change)
Scale-up of promising synthesis routes for integration into ADR cooling systems, in close coordination with the industrial project partner kiutra GmbH
Supervision of PhD students, master's students, and student assistants within the project
Writing scientific publications for peer-reviewed journals
Presentation of results at national and international conferences

Completed doctorate in physics, materials science, chemistry, or a related field
Solid experience in the synthesis of inorganic solids
Knowledge of structural characterization (powder X-ray diffraction, Laue diffraction, microscopy, …)
Experience with magnetic and thermodynamic measurements (magnetometry, susceptibility, heat capacity, …) at low and ultra-low temperatures
Experience operating crystal growth facilities and/or cryostats
Demonstrated publication record in solid-state physics or materials science
Independent, structured way of working and enjoyment of interdisciplinary teamwork
Excellent written and spoken English; knowledge of German is an advantage
Experience supervising students is an advantage
We offer the opportunity to contribute to an internationally visible research topic at the interface of solid-state physics and quantum technologies - in an excellently equipped low-temperature laboratory at the TUM Department of Physics and in close collaboration with an innovative industry partner.
TUM offers a working environment with flexible working hours, flat hierarchies, and open communication, as well as a comprehensive, free range of professional and personal development opportunities.
Remuneration is based on qualifications according to TV-L. TUM aims to increase the proportion of women in its workforce; applications from women are therefore explicitly encouraged.

You lead the global Finance process across Transformation of Industry, working closely with finance leaders, business stakeholders, IT teams, process sponsors, and rollout teams. Your day includes reviewing and harmonizing finance processes, defining global standards and controls, supporting ERP transformation activities, and aligning stakeholders across countries and business units. You safeguard compliance and audit readiness, guide key decisions on process governance, and work with global key users to ensure successful adoption of standardized finance processes across the organization.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Ownership of the end-to-end global Finance process covering Financial Accounting, Controlling, Consolidation and Group Reporting, Treasury, Tax and Customs, as well as Budget and Forecast processes across the target ERP landscape
* Definition and maintenance of global Finance standards, process templates, controls, and performance indicators across business units, countries, and target systems
* Assessment of current-state Finance processes and development of future-state standards supporting ERP consolidation and process harmonization objectives
* Governance of template extensions and local deviations while balancing global consistency with legal, statutory, regulatory, and business requirements
* Safeguarding of internal controls, audit readiness, regulatory compliance, and financial governance across all processes impacting financial reporting and the general ledger
* Development and leadership of the global Finance Key User community, including support of rollout activities, user adoption, testing, go-live preparation, and continuous improvement

What You Bring

* Degree in Finance, Business, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, combined with longterm experience in finance process management and ERP-enabled transformation within manufacturing, engineering, or similar industries
* Deep business process expertise in SAP FI/CO and Finance operations with strong understanding of integrations with Sales, Logistics, and Procurement processes
* Proven experience in process harmonization across multiple systems, countries, or business units as part of large-scale SAP S/4HANA or comparable transformation programs
* Experience with global template governance, fit-to-standard approaches, change control processes, internal controls, audit requirements, and compliance frameworks
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, collaboration, and influencing skills across functions, cultures, and organizational levels without formal authority
* Fluent English and a team-oriented, results-focused mindset with the ability to drive adoption, standardization, and transformation in a global environment 

About the Team

Our Transformation of Industry division is decarbonizing the industrial sector. Increasing 
electrification and efficiency are key and demand for green H2 and derivative fuels will rise. We 
enable decarbonization of the industrial sector and the transition to sustainable processes, 
building on a strong industrial customer base, a global network, diverse technologies, and 
integrated execution capabilities

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus ist Pionier einer nachhaltigen Luft- und Raumfahrt für eine sichere und vereinte Welt. Das Unternehmen arbeitet ständig an Innovationen für effiziente und technologisch fortschrittliche Lösungen in den Bereichen Luft- und Raumfahrt, Verteidigung sowie vernetzte Dienstleistungen. Airbus bietet moderne und treibstoffeffiziente Verkehrsflugzeuge sowie dazugehörige Dienstleistungen an. Airbus ist auch führend in Europa im Bereich Verteidigung und Sicherheit und eines der größten Raumfahrtunternehmen der Welt. Im Bereich Hubschrauber stellt Airbus die weltweit effizientesten Lösungen und Dienstleistungen für zivile und militärische Hubschrauber bereit.
Job description

In order to support the X-Labs department, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Internship in Flight Control Systems (d/f/m)

Are you looking for an internship and want to get to know the work of a Systems Engineer (d/f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the X-Labs department, as an intern (d/f/m)!

- Location: Taufkirchen/Ottobrunn
- Start: as soon as possible
- Duration: 6 months
- 
Within the X-Labs organization, we are targeting advanced technological breakthroughs that could be key enablers of the next generation products at Airbus.

By exploration of new air vehicle concepts and application of disruptive technology bricks we are driving a step change in air vehicle performance and allowing us to significantly rethink air vehicle design. These advances are opening up the design space and enabling us to look at new concepts and new markets previously impossible to envisage.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Traveling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Flight Controls Engineering Intern to join our dynamic flight systems team. In this role, you will gain invaluable hands-on experience designing, testing, and integrating advanced flight control systems for our next-generation aircraft. Mentored by senior engineers, you will have the opportunity to take ownership of impactful projects, applying theoretical aerospace concepts to real-world hardware and software challenges.

- Flight Control Law Development & Simulation: Assist in the design, modeling, and refinement of flight control laws to meet performance and handling requirements.
- Develop FCC dynamic algorithms: Design and optimize dynamic algorithms for the Flight Control Computer (FCC) to ensure reliable aircraft responsiveness.
- Implement control strategies in MATLAB/Simulink: Translate aerodynamic data and control theory into high-fidelity digital models.
- Conduct Software-In-The-Loop (SIL) simulations to validate control architecture stability: Run rigorous tests to analyze system performance and safety margins.
- Hardware: Lead trade studies to evaluate, select, and integrate core flight control hardware for your specific project scope, ensuring seamless communication between sensors, actuators, and the FCC.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) within Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field.
- Language skills: English Fluent, good German skills would be an advantage.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Previous project team experience (e.g., Design Build Fly, Formula SAE, university rocketry/UAV teams).
- Familiarity with simulation environments like Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) or Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL).
- Exposure to hardware integration, avionics, or basic embedded systems.
- Eagerness to learn and ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

Stellenbeschreibung:
About HeyGermany

Germany urgently needs international talent. Yet complex and lengthy recognition processes prevent many qualified professionals from working in the jobs they trained for. At the same time, employers struggle to fill critical positions.

HeyGermany wants to change that. We are building the digital infrastructure to make professional recognition and work integration faster and easier. We are starting with nursing and plan to expand into other regulated professions. Our mission is to remove bureaucratic barriers and help international talent access jobs that match their qualifications.

The Role

We are looking for a hands-on, product-driven Founding CTPO with the ambition to build HeyGermany as a co-founder. You will take full ownership of both product and technology, from understanding customer problems and defining our product vision to building, launching and scaling the solutions.

You will work closely with the Founder & CEO to shape company strategy, identify growth opportunities and turn our vision into a product that users love and businesses are willing to pay for.

We already have a live MVP (www.hey-germany.com (http://www.hey-germany.com) ), an initial recognition engine and talent pool, 400+ talent pool conversions, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding.

Your challenge is to turn this foundation into a scalable, user-centric platform that can take HeyGermany from one profession to many, while building the product and technology capabilities to support long-term growth.

What You’ll Do

- Own our product vision, strategy and roadmap, translating customer needs, business goals and market insights into clear priorities and measurable outcomes.
- Lead product discovery and development end-to-end, from user research, problem validation and prototyping to technical implementation, launch and iteration.
- Own our technology strategy and architecture, building scalable systems for qualification recognition, document processing, workflow automation and talent matching.
- Turn complex regulatory and bureaucratic processes into simple, intuitive digital experiences, with a strong focus on usability, customer value and conversion.
- Stay hands-on in building the product, making key technical decisions across frontend, backend, APIs, data and cloud infrastructure while maintaining a high standard of product quality.
- Identify and develop AI-powered product opportunities where they create real value, particularly in document analysis, structured data extraction, intelligent matching and workflow automation.
- Work directly with international professionals, employers and domain experts to understand their needs, validate assumptions and continuously improve the product.
- Define and track key product metrics, using data, user feedback and experimentation to drive product decisions, engagement, conversion and business outcomes.
- Build and lead our future product and engineering team, establishing a strong culture of ownership, customer focus, speed and continuous learning.

What We’re Looking For

- We care less about your current title than about what you have built, your product judgment and the level of ownership you are ready to take.
- 7+ years of experience in software engineering, product development or technical product leadership, with strong hands-on technical capabilities.
- A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
- A proven track record of building and shipping digital products end-to-end, ideally in a founder, founding engineer, product-minded CTO, technical product lead or similar role.
- Strong product thinking, with the ability to identify real customer problems, validate solutions, prioritize effectively and balance user needs with business impact and technical feasibility.
- Strong experience with a modern web stack, ideally TypeScript, React/Next.js, backend development, APIs, databases and cloud infrastructure.
- Practical experience building with LLMs and modern AI systems, including RAG, agents and evaluations, and using AI effectively in product development and day-to-day work.
- Experience with product discovery, user research, UX principles, product analytics and iterative development. You know how to move from an initial hypothesis to a product that delivers measurable value.
- The ability to make pragmatic decisions across product and technology, balancing speed, user experience, quality and scalability in an early-stage environment.
- A strong understanding of how product decisions connect to business outcomes, including acquisition, activation, retention and monetization.
- A founder mindset and strong connection to our mission**.** You want real ownership, are comfortable with the ambiguity of a pre-seed company and care about building a successful business, not just great technology.
- Strong English communication skills are required. German is a plus.
- Experience with document intelligence/OCR, B2B SaaS, marketplaces, HR Tech, Global Mobility or regulated/GDPR-sensitive products is valuable, but not required.

What We Offer

- €50,000–€65,000 annual base salary, with salary growth as the company scales, plus meaningful equity reflecting the founder-level ownership of the role.
- The opportunity to become a true co-founder, with long-term ownership of product and technology and meaningful participation in the company’s upside.
- Founder-level influence over product vision, technology and company strategy, with the freedom to shape what we build, how we build it and how we grow.
- The opportunity to build our product, technology architecture and future product and engineering organisation from the ground up.
- A live product, early traction, our first enterprise pilot and secured public funding. We are currently in conversations with investors for our next stage of growth.
- The opportunity to work on a problem with tangible social and economic impact: helping international professionals access jobs that match their qualifications while helping employers access talent they urgently need.

We believe professional opportunities should be determined by people’s skills, not by their ability to navigate bureaucracy.

If you want to build both the product and the technology behind a company from the ground up, take real ownership and help shape HeyGermany as a co-founder, we would love to hear from you.

Send us one product you've built that you're proud of, tell us what role you played in bringing it to life, and why this mission matters to you.
