jobs.description:
At Bayer we’re visionaries, driven to solve the world’s toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none’ is no longer a dream, but a real possibility. We’re doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives of those around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining ‘impossible’. There are so many reasons to join us. If you’re hungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there’s only one choice.

Senior Principal Scientist (all genders) - External API Development for New Chemical Entities

You are an experienced synthetic and process chemist with the ambition to shape the chemical foundation of our R&D pipeline for new chemical entities (NCEs) by designing, developing, and enabling synthetic routes that evolve into robust API manufacturing processes in partnership with our external CDMO network.

In this Drug Substance (DS) Lead position within global CMC teams, you define and drive the DS strategy and are accountable for the DS contribution to the overall CMC package. Serving as the central interface between internal stakeholders and external partners, you lead chemical process development and API supply activities, enabling phase-appropriate, scalable, and sustainable manufacturing processes that ensure timely API delivery, robust product quality, and cost efficiency.

YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- Provide scientific leadership for the design, assessment, and optimization of synthetic routes for new APIs in preclinical and clinical phases, with a focus on speed, quality, cost, sustainability, and process understanding
- Represent Drug Substance (DS) in global CMC development project teams and contribute to key scientific, strategic, and portfolio decisions, while ensuring a coherent two-way flow of strategy, decisions, risks, and progress between the internal global CMC team and external CDMO activities
- Guide and challenge route design and synthetic methodology choices at external CDMOs, translating SAR-driven chemistry into scalable routes for preclinical and clinical supply and future production in alignment with the internal DS development strategy
- Oversee external API campaigns for toxicology studies and clinical trials, including planning, risk assessment, supply-demand alignment, and budget oversight
- Steer process transfers between external partners and into internal development or external manufacturing, ensuring knowledge continuity and phase-appropriate documentation
- Contribute to robust, phase-appropriate control strategies. Co-author and review the Drug Substance sections of regulatory filings (IND/IMPD and briefing documents) and support responses to health authority questions
- Provide CMC DS assessments for in-licensing opportunities
- Provide chemical expertise and pragmatic troubleshooting across the internal and external manufacturing network. Actively contribute to the chemistry community by sharing knowledge and driving innovation across organizational boundaries

WHO YOU ARE

- Ph.D. in Chemistry or a related science, with extensive experience in the pharmaceutical industry, including an understanding of GLP/GMP and regulatory expectations
- Strong background in synthetic chemistry, with an excellent understanding of reagents, methodologies, and reaction mechanisms, plus a solid grasp of analytical techniques
- Experience in the CMC development of peptides is a plus
- Experience in steering external partners (CROs/CDMOs) or working across an external manufacturing network is a clear advantage
- Proven ability to represent chemistry and Drug Substance in interdisciplinary CMC or project teams and to act as an accountable interface between the internal organization and external partners
- A strategic thinker with the ability to think innovatively, develop and analyze multiple solutions to complex chemistry problems, and challenge the status quo
- Strong communication and project management skills across scientific disciplines, cultures, and organizational boundaries, combined with assertiveness, service orientation, and enjoyment of cross-functional teamwork
- Fluency in English (negotiation level), both written and spoken; German is an asset and willingness to learn German is required

WHAT WE OFFER

Our benefits package is flexible, appreciative, and tailored to your lifestyle, because: What matters to you, matters to us!

- We ensure your financial stability with a competitive salary between 109.800€ and 138.500€ per year (full-time) plus a variable component and a global equity-based cash plan. Your compensation is based on your qualifications, skills, and professional experience.
- Your family is a top priority. We offer loving company daycare centers at multiple locations, support in finding childcare, time off for the care of elderly or dependent family members, summer camps for children, and much more.
- We support your professional growth by providing access to learning and development opportunities, training programs through the Bayer Learning Academy, development dialogues, as well as coaching and mentoring programs.

jobs.description:
AURELIUS is a global alternative investor, distinguished and widely recognised for its operational approach. It focuses on private markets, in particular Private Equity and Private Debt. AURELIUS is driven by a spirit of entrepreneurship, with a collegiate, hands-on approach to complex projects. We are motivated, open, fun, and operate as a team of equals.

Create impact with passion!

For an AURELIUS’ portfolio company located in Bavaria we are looking for a

Head of PMO / Chief of Projects (m/f/d)

As a Head of PMO you will lead and professionalize the end-to-end Project Management / Delivery function across the EMEA utilities business, spanning residential and industrial energy tech, software, and analytics solutions. You will own delivery from project definition through mass production and customer rollout, integrating Sales, Product Management, R&D, NPI, Procurement, and Quality into one disciplined execution engine. Furthermore, you will transform a currently fragmented, product- and site-centric delivery model into a standardized, cross-BU project delivery organization with clear stage gates, transparent KPIs, and predictable outcomes. The Head of PMO will act as the single accountable owner like a “project CEO” for on-time, on-quality, and on-cost delivery of projects and new product introductions, and as the primary interface to major customers for delivery commitments. Your task is to drive execution discipline, cost control, and margin protection across the full project lifecycle. The role requires frequent travel.

Responsibilities

1. Project Delivery Leadership & Organizational Ownership

- Lead and develop the EMEA Project Delivery organization across customer projects, NPI, and cross-BU solution programs
- Define and implement the organizational setup, governance model, and PM career path, including near-/offshore delivery capacity
- Build a balanced delivery organization combining hardware project management, software/solution delivery, and NPI program management
- Ensure scalability, agility, and clear accountability across all delivery units and sites

2. End-to-End Engineering Delivery

- Own end-to-end delivery from project definition through development, industrialization, mass production ramp, and customer handover
- Act as the single point of accountability for on-time, on-quality, on-cost execution of customer projects and NPIs
- Drive execution discipline, cost control, and scalable delivery models across multi-site and multi-BU programs
- Establish a common project lifecycle, stage-gate framework, and PMO standards applied consistently across electricity, gas, thermal, software, and analytics
- Ensure robust project planning, risk management, change control, and claim management on all major programs
- Chair stage-gate reviews and enforce go/no-go decisions against scope, schedule, cost, quality, and business case

3. Cross-BU Solution Delivery (HW + SW + Analytics)

- Lead delivery of integrated solutions combining residential and industrial meters, head-end software, and analytics offerings
- Break down BU silos and orchestrate cross-BU program teams around customer outcomes, not product lines
- Establish shared solution architectures and reusable delivery playbooks across product families
- Ensure consistent solution scoping, pricing input, and delivery commitments across the portfolio

4. NPI & Industrialization

- Collaborate with Operations on NPI program management from early involvement design, to design freeze through pilot, ramp, and stable serial production
- Ensure early and structured involvement of NPI, Procurement, Manufacturing, and Quality in R&D projects
- Drive design-for-manufacturing, design-for-cost, and design-for-serviceability discipline into every new program
- Manage ramp readiness: supply readiness, test coverage, production line qualification, and yield curves

5. Cross-functional Collaboration

- Act as the delivery counterpart to Product Management (portfolio & roadmap) and R&D (technology execution)
- Partner with Sales and Customer Projects to translate customer commitments into feasible, margin-protected delivery plans
- Provide delivery input into bids, contract negotiation, and commercial terms (milestones, LDs, acceptance criteria)
- Collaborate with Procurement and SCM to secure supply, lead times, and cost targets for project ramp
- Collaborate with Quality to embed quality gates and field-performance feedback into delivery governance
- Align with Finance on project controlling, revenue recognition, milestone billing, and cash collection

6. Financial & Resource Management

- Own the project delivery cost base and the aggregated margin performance of the project portfolio
- Drive project margin protection: budget adherence, contingency management, scope and change control
- Optimize allocation of PM and delivery resources across customer projects and NPI programs
- Drive build vs. buy vs. outsource decisions for delivery capacity, balancing control, cost, and flexibility
- Support business cases and mid-term planning with realistic delivery assumptions and risk-adjusted estimates

7. Transformation & Change Leadership

- Lead transformation initiatives to increase delivery productivity, reduce time-to-market, and improve predictability
- Standardize and digitalize PMO tooling (planning, reporting, risk, resource management)
- Build a high-performance, accountable, and customer-centric delivery culture
- Drive upskilling and certification of the PM community across hardware, software, and solution delivery

8. Governance, Risk & Compliance

- Ensure project delivery complies with contractual, regulatory, cybersecurity, and quality requirements
- Establish transparent portfolio reporting to the CEO and executive team, including early warning on at-risk programs
- Own risk register for the delivery portfolio and drive systematic mitigation

Your Profile

Professional Experience

- Minimum 15+ years of experience in project, program, and delivery leadership, including senior roles (VP/SVP level) in an international, matrix organization
- Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional delivery organizations spanning hardware, software, and integrated solutions
- Significant experience in customer project delivery in a B2B environment (preferably utilities, energy, industrial technology, or telecom infrastructure)
- Strong NPI and industrialization background: bringing new hardware and software products from development into serial production and customer rollout
- Demonstrated success in owning end-to-end delivery from project definition to mass production and customer acceptance
- Experience running structured stage-gate and PMO frameworks at scale, with measurable improvements in OTD, margin, and predictability
- Solid commercial acumen: contract, bid, and claim management; project P&L ownership; milestone billing and working capital control
- Experience in driving organizational transformation and productivity improvements (cost, efficiency, time-to-market)
- Experience in global/multi-site setups, including near-/offshore delivery structures
- Exposure to carve-out, integration, or major transformation programs (strong plus)

Intercultural Experience

- Proven leadership experience in international and cross-cultural environments, managing teams across multiple geographies
- Strong experience in navigating matrix organizations and global governance structures
- High level of cultural awareness, adaptability, and communication effectiveness at executive and customer level
- Fluency in German and English is a prerequisite

Personal attributes

- University degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field
- Advanced degree (MBA or equivalent) is a plus; recognized PM certifications (PMP, IPMA, PgMP, SAFe) are a plus
- Strong technical understanding across hardware, embedded systems, software, and cloud/analytics solutions — able to challenge and steer technical trade-offs
- Deep mastery of project and program management methods, stage-gate governance, and modern delivery models (Agile at scale, hybrid HW/SW delivery)
- Proven ability to drive execution at scale in multi-site, distributed delivery organizations, including vendor and outsourcing management
- Data-driven delivery mindset: use of KPIs, portfolio dashboards, and analytics to improve OTD, quality, and productivity
- Strong business and P&L awareness, with ability to protect and expand project margin under commercial pressure
- Ability to connect customer commitments, technical execution, and financial outcomes
- Strong ROI orientation: able to challenge scope, prioritize based on value, and terminate programs that no longer meet hurdle rates
- Strong decision-making capability under ambiguity, especially in evolving organizational and carve-out setups
- Excellent stakeholder management skills across CEO / board level, customers, suppliers, and internal functions
- High degree of resilience and change leadership capability in transformation environments
- Ability to attract, develop, and retain top program and delivery talent

At the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law, scholars pursue research relating to fundamental issues and current developments in the areas of public international law, European Union law, and the constitutional and administrative law of individual states, together with numerous visiting scholars from all over the world. In its fields, our library is the largest in Europe and one of the most comprehensive in the world.

The newly established Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER), headed by Dr. Gordon Friedrichs at the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law in Heidelberg, invites applications for two

Research Fellow positions (Doctoral Researchers) (x/f/m)

with a preferred starting date of 1 January 2027 (the positions are funded for three years)

The Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER) investigates how global order is transformed as states - particularly great and middle powers - pursue competing visions of the principles, rules and institutions that structure international relations amid intensifying geopolitical rivalry. The group conceptualizes these processes as constellations of global (dis)ordering through which states seek to advance their visions of order by creating, reshaping, connecting, bypassing, or disengaging from international institutions, building new formal or ad hoc institutional arrangements, and strategically leveraging economic and technological interdependence. DISORDER examines how such constellations emerge across the fields of security, economy, and technology, and what forms of global order they produce, transform, or erode.

Job description

The successful candidates will develop independent doctoral dissertation projects within the framework of the Max Planck Research Group “Constellations of Global (Dis)Ordering” (DISORDER). Their research should contribute to the group’s broader inquiry into how states pursue competing visions of global order through international institutions and how these processes reshape global order across different issue areas.

Possible orientations of the doctoral projects include:

- an actor-centred perspective, examining how a particular great or middle power pursues its vision of global order across different issue areas institutional settings; or
- a domain-centred perspective, comparing how different states interact with and reshape international institutions within a particular field, such as security, economy, or technology.

Potential empirical cases may include, but are not limited to, the United States, China, Russia, India, Brazil, Japan, and other international actors such as the European Union.

The doctoral researchers will:

- develop and conduct an original PhD project that contributes to the conceptual and empirical agenda of the DISORDER research group;
- conduct empirical research using qualitative methods such as process tracing, qualitative content and discourse analysis, and semi-structured interviews;
- contribute to the comparative and collaborative research activities of the group;
- participate in research group meetings, workshops, conferences, and other academic activities;
- present research findings at international conferences and prepare publications for peer-reviewed academic outlets;
- contribute to the organization of workshops, conferences, and other activities of the research group and the MPIL.

Your profile

- An excellent Master’s degree or equivalent in Political Science, with a specialization in International Relations or Foreign Policy Analysis
- A strong research interest in global order, international institutions, and great- and middle-power politics, including their foreign policies
- A substantive interest in one or more of the group’s empirical issue areas (security, economy, and technology)
- A strong interest in qualitative research and familiarity with relevant research methods
- Excellent written and spoken English
- Additional language skills and country- or region-specific expertise relevant to the proposed doctoral project are considered assets
- The ability to conduct independent research while contributing actively to a collaborative research environment

We offer

- An attractive and international work environment with an unparalleled research infrastructure and a good working atmosphere
- A varied, responsible and team-orientated job
- Remuneration in accordance with the guidelines of the MPG funding agreements (65 per cent of EG13, TVöD-Bund)
- Access to our world-leading library and a multitude of databases
- A workplace that is easy to reach by public transport and free employee parking spaces
- A job ticket for public transport
- Offers for work-life balance and four affiliated daycare centres

Application

The Max Planck Society has set itself the goal of employing more severely disabled people. Applications from severely disabled persons are expressly encouraged. The Max Planck Society strives for gender equality and diversity. We welcome applications from all backgrounds. Furthermore, the Max Planck Society aims to increase the proportion of women in areas where they are underrepresented. Women are therefore strongly encouraged to apply.

Interested candidates are invited to submit their complete application exclusively via the online application system (https://jobs.mpil.de/3vrp7) available on our website by 22 November 2026.

Applications should include a CV, a cover letter of no more than two pages, copies of relevant degree certificates and transcripts of records, a one-page summary of the applicant’s Master’s thesis, a five-page PhD project proposal that clearly relates to the research agenda of the DISORDER group and indicates which of the thematic orientations outlined above the proposed project primarily addresses, and two letters of recommendation

The documents will be deleted after the application process. The interviews will take place in late November/early December in person at the Max Planck Institute for Comparative Public Law and International Law in Heidelberg. Application expenses cannot be covered.

For questions regarding the positions, please contact Dr. Gordon Friedrichs at friedrichs@mpil.de (https://mailto:friedrichs@mpil.de) .

jobs.occupation: Rare Disease Manager (Key Account Manager) for NF1, Middle East of Germany (all genders) (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
Work Your Magic with us!

Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That's why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimaginable with us.

United As One for Patients, our purpose in Healthcare is to help create, improve and prolong lives. We develop medicines, intelligent devices and innovative technologies in therapeutic areas such as Oncology, Neurology and Fertility. Our teams work together across 6 continents with passion and relentless curiosity in order to help patients at every stage of life. Joining our Healthcare team is becoming part of a diverse, inclusive and flexible working culture, presenting great opportunities for personal development and career advancement across the globe.

Your Role: As a Rare Disease Manager (Key Account Manager) for Neurofibromatose Typ 1 (NF1) , you will be at the heart of transforming how patients with rare diseases access life-changing therapies — your work directly influences treatment pathways and outcomes for some of the most underserved patient populations. You will own your territory like a true entrepreneur, taking full accountability for strategy, execution, and sustainable business growth across hospitals, treatment centers, and referral networks. You will develop and execute customized strategic account plans that strengthen centers of excellence, optimize referral pathways, and accelerate time-to-treatment for patients in need. Building deep, trust-based partnerships with physicians, nurses, pharmacists, and multidisciplinary teams will be your daily currency — and you will do it with scientific credibility and genuine care. Leveraging your deep scientific expertise, you will engage healthcare professionals as a peer and trusted partner, translating complex clinical evidence into meaningful conversations that drive better standards of care. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional colleagues in Medical Affairs, Market Access, Marketing, and Commercial teams to align strategies and maximize impact across the healthcare ecosystem. Data is your compass: you will use CRM tools, market analytics, and territory business planning to identify opportunities, monitor performance, and continuously refine your approach. You will champion disease awareness and patient education initiatives, playing a key role in shaping the rare disease landscape in your region. Acting as the voice of the customer, you will bring actionable field insights back to the organization — directly influencing strategy at a national level. This is a rare opportunity to combine commercial excellence with genuine patient impact — if that drives you, this role was made for you.

Your territory covers key hubs across the Middle East of Germany — mainly Dresden, Leipzig and Göttingen area — and ideally, you already call one of these regions home.

Who You Are:

- You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Medicine, or a related life science field; a qualification as Pharmaceutical Representative per local regulatory requirements is a plus.
- You bring at least 4–5 years of commercial experience in the pharmaceutical, biotech, or healthcare industry, with a proven track record in strategic account management and market development.
- You have hands-on experience in rare disease environments and a strong understanding of the complex stakeholder dynamics involved.
- You possess deep knowledge of healthcare systems, reimbursement pathways, and patient access processes, ideally with exposure to high-cost specialty therapies.
- You are scientifically agile — able to engage with complex clinical data and translate it into compelling, compliant customer discussions.
- You combine an entrepreneurial mindset with strong analytical capabilities, taking ownership of results and thriving in ambiguous, fast-evolving environments.
- You are a skilled communicator and relationship builder, experienced in working across cross-functional teams and navigating complex stakeholder landscapes.
- You are fluent in German and English and highly willing to travel within your territory, including overnight travel as required.
- A valid driving license is required.

What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We believe that this variety drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging that impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!

Apply now and become a part of a team that is dedicated to Sparking Discovery and Elevating Humanity!

jobs.occupation: Optical Architect (d/f/m) for Optical Instruments (DevOps Engineer)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Earth Observation & Science projects within Space Systems, Airbus Defence and Space in Ottobrunn is looking for an

Optical Architect (d/f/m)

You will join a multicultural team of engineers specialized in the development of optical (sub-)systems working for Earth Observation & Science projects within Space Systems. These developments cover instruments for ESA, CNES, DLR and EU programmes across the spectral range from ultraviolet to thermal infrared. Examples include LIDARs (ATLID, MERLIN), Multi-Spectral Instruments (Sentinel-2 MSI, Sentinel-4, Sentinel-5) from the Copernicus programme, infrared instruments (LSTM, TRISHNA), meteorological instruments (IASI-NG and METimage) embarked on MetOp-SG, instruments for scientific missions like EUCLID, cameras embarked on LEO and GEO satellites, and national programmes.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria.

Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Define and develop optical subsystem architecture and verification strategies for space-borne instruments in project phases B2, C, and D following defined processes.
- Act as the main technical contact point for optical domain matters, supporting systems engineers on technological, design, verification, risk, cost, and schedule aspects.
- Perform optical design and analysis, including stray light analysis, optical layout, tolerances, and stray light, thermal, and optical performance (STOP) budget allocations.
- Coordinate optical subsystem engineering and Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) activities across multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Thermal, Electrical, Detection-chain, Cleanliness).
- Derive, consolidate, and maintain optical subsystem requirements in alignment with higher-level specifications (e.g., SRD, IRD) and verification plans.
- Oversee subcontracted optical equipment procurement, reviewing data packages and test plans to ensure on-time, on-cost, and on-quality delivery.
- Contribute to future programmes (phase 0 or A/B1), support internal/external R&D proposals for new optical technologies, and participate in lessons-learnt exchanges.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Optical Engineering
- Proven multi-year experience in optical instrumentation or optical sensors, ideally for space applications
- Solid experience in optical layout, design, tolerance, and STOP analysis, including maintenance of optical allocations/budgets.
- Proficiency with commercial optical design software (e.g., Code V, Zemax, FRED) and programming languages (e.g., Matlab, Python).
- Sound technical knowledge of optical components (e.g., mirrors, photonics, gratings, fibers, lasers, coatings) and space equipment alignment/testing strategies.
- Strong communication skills, collaborative problem-solving approach, and experience in managing suppliers or subcontractors.
- Professional working proficiency in English; knowledge of German is beneficial.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.description:
WELCOME TO BASF

In Global Business Services, we support BASF's divisions with a cross-functional network and offer modern solutions tailored to the needs of the business. As a specialized service unit we ensure a high level of customer orientation and we design our services to be cooperative, efficient and future-oriented.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT
Our Regional Treasury EMEA department is responsible for the Treasury and Cash Management activity of BASF Group companies in the EMEA region. Within our Bank team, we are responsible for validating customer and supplier master data, ensuring adherence to internal Fraud Prevention requirements.

- In your new role, you support the project team with day-to-day tasks such as mass changes.
In addition, you are responsible for managing your own small projects from initiation through to full completion, as well as providing reports and supporting optimization projects.
- The validation and preparation of new business partners form a core part of your responsibilities, along with various analyses and reports depending on requests and needs.
- Besides that, you are ensuring that team knowledge, communications, and publications are kept up to date.
- Lastly, you are in regular contact with various units across the BASF Group.
- commercial vocational training or studies and first professional experience in the field of Master Data and working in projects
- confident handling in working with SAP R/3, particularly in the FI module, as well as with MS Office
- comprehensive knowledge of process flows, Business Partner master data workflow, products, customers and entity goals
- strong analytical sense and an eye for details is required, goal-oriented, precise working methods and high customer orientation
- fluent and convincing communication in English, further language skills are welcome

WHAT WE OFFER

- Gross annual salary (full-time): 40.000 - 46.000 €, depending on qualifications and professional experience - In addition, you can expect a bonus dependent on the company's success
- 30 days of paid vacation, special leave and sabbatical options
- Flexible working hours so that you can organize your working and private life according to your needs
- Location-independent working models with defined days of presence in Berlin and residence in Germany - here a first impression
- Work mobile from other EU countries for up to six weeks

HOW TO REACH US

- Katarina Borisov (Talent Acquisition), Tel: +49 30 2005-59269 will be happy to answer your questions for this position. You are welcome to book an online appointment.
- You can also reach our recruiting team here.
- First information about our application process can be found here and in our Q&A video.

Go beyond and create global impact: At Munich Re, we're proud to be one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, primary insurance, and insurance-related risk solutions. Our group is made up of the reinsurance and ERGO business segments, along with our asset management company, MEAG. We operate globally and are active in all lines of the insurance business.
Since our founding in 1880, we've built a reputation for unrivalled risk-related expertise and a solid financial foundation. We use our strengths to support our clients' business goals and drive technological progress. We're also at the forefront of developing coverage for emerging risks, from rocket launches and renewable energy to cyber threats and artificial intelligence.
With around 44,000 people worldwide, our group's corporate culture is defined by performance, mutual respect, and trust. All this makes us an attractive employer providing global career development opportunities and prospects.
Credit risks are the main underwriting focus in EULA5. The Global Credit Solutions (GCS) team is writing business mainly with global banks by insuring credit risks originated by the banks, where the team assumes the role of a primary insurer. Your task as a Client Relation Risk Manager is to attract new bank clients, manage existing bank clients and writing proactive business within your responsibility. It is necessary to meet credit decision in conjunction with the Risk Underwriting (RUW).
Your Job

- Developing our global business by binding new transactions with new and existing clients
- Establish new and foster existing client relationships, with focus on the global banks. Identify the relevant people within these organisations and establish a personal relationship
- Negotiation and finalizing of insurance policies and Master Risk Participation Agreements with the global banks
- Own risk assessments of the transactions offered by the banks, especially in the area of trade finance
- Assessment of the banks capabilities in originating and assessing credit risks in all relevant trade finance products

Your Profile

- University degree, preferably in business or economics, or equivalent training (banking traineeship followed by relevant further education)
- Several years' professional experience within a bank or professional experience in the risk transfer market between banks and insurance companies in the field of Global Trade Finance
- Proven track record in originating, structuring and closing trade finance and credit risk transactions directly with banks and/or corporates, combined with a demonstrated ability to generate new business opportunities and build long-term strategic client relationships across international markets
- Several years of professional experience in client management and the acquisition and development of international banking and corporate clients
- Strong business development capabilities, including the ability to identify new market opportunities, expand market presence and establish strategic partnerships in key trade finance markets
- Demonstrated experience in establishing, developing and scaling new business areas, products, platforms or market initiatives, ideally in an international environment
- Deep understanding of global trade finance products, risk mitigation structures and relevant international markets
- Strong commercial mindset combined with sound risk assessment capabilities, relationship management skills and the ability to successfully execute complex transactions
- Superior analytical skills in conjunction with a pronounced risk awareness and sense of responsibility, along with a willingness and ability to justify decisions in a clear and comprehensible manner
- Team-oriented, entrepreneurial and solution-driven personality with a high degree of initiative and the ability to work independently
- Business-level English required; additional excellent foreign-language skills an advantage
- Confident manner, high degree of social skills when interacting with colleagues, clients or in-house interfaces

Application Instructions
Please apply through our online portal and upload your CV, as well as your academic reference letters, including school certificates, graduation certificates and transcripts of record for any degrees. If applicable, please also submit reference letters from any previous employers or certificates from any other qualifications you may have. The female reproductive tract is a highly dynamic system in which tissue mechanics, active forces, and fluid flow interact with cellular and physiological processes. Yet, how these physical properties contribute to reproductive function remains poorly understood.

Within the ERC Starting Grant project REPROMECH – Quantitative Mechanics of the Oviduct: Force, Flow, and the Physiological Operating Point, our group investigates how forces and mechanical properties shape the function of the female reproductive system. We combine approaches from reproductive biology, mechanobiology, and experimental biophysics to quantitatively characterize living tissues across cellular and tissue scales.

The doctoral project will investigate the mechanical properties of the female reproductive tract and their relationship to tissue function.

Tasks

- Quantification of mechanical properties of the female reproductive tract using complementary mechanical measurements and advanced microscopy
- Preparation and culture of ex vivo tissue samples
- Histological characterization of biological samples
- Quantitative image and data analysis
- Critical analysis and interpretation of experimental results

Profile

- You hold a Master’s degree or equivalent in reproductive biology, developmental biology, biology, biophysics, physics, bioengineering, biomedical engineering, biotechnology, or a related discipline.
- We are looking for a candidate with strong experimental aptitude, excellent practical laboratory skills, manual dexterity, and a quantitative and analytical mindset.

- Previous experience in reproductive biology, experimental biophysics, microscopy, or work with laboratory animals is advantageous but not required. Candidates with a background in reproductive biology and an interest in quantitative and biophysical approaches are particularly encouraged to apply.
- Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English are required.

The position is funded for an initial period of three years within the ERC Starting Grant REPROMECH, with the possibility of extension, and is available from 1 January 2027 or as soon as possible.

We offer a vibrant international research environment, access to state-of-the-art infrastructure for quantitative microscopy and mechanobiology, and opportunities for scientific training and conference participation.

Ultimately, you will help ensure that AI-driven change is not only deployed successfully, but embraced, embedded, and sustained across Procurement.

About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

Your Role & Mission

The mission of the Flash team at Forto is to fundamentally redesign operations processes by leveraging automation and intelligent decision-making to handle shipments more efficiently. We aim to scale CoPilot so that it becomes the primary system used by operations managers, enabling them to be more effective and efficient in their daily work.

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Flash team, you will help build AI-driven solutions and the CoPilot that powers our logistics operations. You will maintain and evolve a sophisticated event-driven, distributed architecture designed to answer one key question:

How do we improve shipment handling and bring efficiency to our operations teams at scale?

From quotation and rate management, to shipment execution and schedule optimization (capacity utilization and GP optimization), to carrier integrations and automated data extraction from unstructured sources (emails, PDFs, spreadsheets), this role focuses on building reliable, data-heavy systems that directly impact revenue and operational performance.

What you will do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable and resilient backend systems
- Contribute to an event-driven, distributed architecture
- Work on AI-adjacent systems (integration, orchestration, data-heavy workflows)
- Own services end-to-end (design, implementation, documentation, operation)
- Collaborate closely with product managers, operations, and other engineers
- Communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs
- Contribute to technical standards and best practices within the team
- Foster a culture of excellence by coaching team members in best practices for backend engineering, domain-driven design, and navigating the complexities of the logistics domain.

Required Skills and Experience

- Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis, particularly as they apply to large-scale data processing and financial calculations.
- Proven professional software craftsmanship, with a focus on building high-quality, maintainable, and testable code (an understanding of TDD is a plus).
- Expertise in designing and implementing large-scale, event-driven microservices architectures and robust APIs, with a keen understanding of data consistency in distributed systems.
- Deep understanding of synchronous vs. asynchronous communication patterns and their impact on system performance and reliability
- Hands-on experience developing distributed backend applications, with a strong focus on data consistency, system quality, low latency, and high availability.
- Proficiency in microservices, with hands-on experience in backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration for deploying and managing scalable pricing services.
- Experience with cloud providers (AWS or GCP preferred) for deploying and managing highly available and scalable applications.
- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with strong critical product thinking and a sense of ownership over the accuracy and effectiveness of pricing data.
- Fluent in English, both verbal and written, for effective communication within a global team.

Preferred Skills and Experience

- Experience integrating AI/LLM-powered features into user faced applications
- Experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in complex product domains

Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! 

Why work with us?

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.

Citizenship

The Opportunity

We are looking for an SAP HANA Performance Team Leader to plan, execute, and validate the performance of SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV and AOS. This role is responsible for qualifying our software to meet SAP benchmark targets and certifying third-party OEM servers for inclusion in SAP’s certified hardware directory.

About the Team

Nutanix's Solutions & Performance Engineering team is a globally distributed organization of architects, performance engineers, and industry specialists focused on validating, optimizing, and accelerating customer success across strategic workloads and industry ecosystems.

Your Role

- Manage a team of remote employees and subcontractors to benchmark SAP HANA and other SAP software components on bare-metal servers. Virtualize similar configurations on Nutanix AHV using the same hardware to identify and improve performance differences between virtualization and bare metal.
- Deploy and troubleshoot various SAP HANA configurations, and establish and document the Nutanix best practices for this workload.
- Identify new strategies and configurations to improve SAP HANA performance on new software versions and denser hardware specifications that expose performance issues in the platform software.
- Work with core engineering teams to troubleshoot performance issues impacting SAP HANA and determine root causes that can be corrected through code changes.
- Deploy new hardware infrastructure in the SAP Linux lab in Walldorf, Germany, and manage infrastructure dependencies.
- Build strong relationships at SAP Headquarters in Walldorf, Germany to gain support from key stakeholders.
- Align Nutanix strategic outcomes with SAP strategic outcomes and influence SAP stakeholders to support Nutanix goals.
- Guide teams in using SAP HANA test harness tools, including SAP validation and certification suites. Serve as a subject matter expert to support performance teams in qualifying and certifying our solution.
- Analyze results from SAP validation and certification suites, compare them to SAP's KPI thresholds, diagnose failures, and drive issues to root cause across the full stack.
- Provision, configure, and troubleshoot SAP HANA parameters, SLES/RHEL for SAP tuning, vCPU/NUMA topology, kernel scheduling, general storage topologies, virtual storage controllers, and network fabrics.
- Experience with automating hardware and software deployments, infrastructure as code, and APIs.
- Ability to explore how AI can be used to automate processes further using advanced AI models.
- Understand the impact of new CPU and memory innovations on SAP HANA workloads and how Nutanix AHV and AOS must evolve to achieve performance benchmarks close to bare metal.
- Understand both scale-up and scale-out HANA and other key architectures of the SAP HANA database.
- Assist in producing written artifacts including SAP Notes, best practice guides, test plans, and KPI result packages for SAP submissions.
- Develop sizing guidelines, configuration recommendations, and reference architectures for SAP HANA on Nutanix AHV/AOS.
- Help customers and Nutanix sellers on large deals involving SAP HANA.
- Work with hardware OEMs to enable them to achieve their own hardware validations for SAP HANA with Nutanix.
- Assist with Nutanix support escalations.

What You Will Bring

- 5+ years in SAP HANA infrastructure or general database performance engineering, with at least 2 years focused on virtualized HANA.
- Deep Linux OS experience
- Experience with Nutanix HCI
- Performance monitoring tools
- Hands-on experience running SAP HANA test harness validation and certification suites, interpreting KPI results, especially storage latency and throughput tests, and understanding the reasons for test failures.
- Working knowledge of SAP HANA, the SAP HANA hardware directory, and, ideally, SAP's certification requirements for HCI and virtualized deployments.
- Strong Linux performance skills on SLES for SAP or RHEL for SAP, including hugepages, C-states and power governors, NUMA topology, SNC2, I/O schedulers, and the standard observability toolkit (perf, sar, iostat, blktrace, numastat, ftrace).
- Practical experience with virtualization performance, including CPU pinning and NUMA alignment, vCPU-to-pCPU ratios, memory reservation, and virtual storage and network path behavior.
- Nutanix AHV/AOS experience is strongly preferred. ESXi or KVM experience will be considered if the candidate can demonstrate relevant expertise.
- Comfortable with distributed storage concepts, including replication factor, data locality, write path and oplog behavior, and understanding latency percentiles.
- Scripting for automation and analysis (Python, Bash) and familiarity with Ansible or Terraform for repeatable lab builds.
- Excellent communication skills in both English and German, with the ability to engage meaningfully with customers.

Great to have

- Direct involvement in prior SAP HANA hardware, HCI, or cloud certification submissions.
- Experience with SAP HANA System Replication, scale-out landscapes, and HA/DR validation under fault injection.
- Familiarity with SAP application-layer benchmarking (SD benchmark, BW/4HANA or S/4HANA workload profiles) in addition to infrastructure KPIs.
- Nutanix certification (NCP/NCM) or SAP HANA Technology certification.

Overview

Keysight (https://www.keysight.com/us/en/about.html)  is on the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~15,000 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do. (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ykxkSz5DlPo&t=16s)

Our award-winning (https://jobs.keysight.com/awards)  culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

About the Role
In this hybrid role combining UI expertise with broader software engineering, you’ll contribute to the development of next-generation simulation applications that integrate real-world physics, interactive visualization, and responsive user interfaces.

As a UI Software Engineer – Simulation Applications, you won’t just focus on aesthetic frontend components—you’ll work across the presentation and application layers, contributing to the overall architecture, functional behavior, and user experience of complex engineering tools. This includes enabling seamless data interaction, responsive controls for simulation parameters, and integration of real-time results.

Your work will directly impact how engineers across domains interact with simulation environments that support their product innovation and validation.

About the Team

Join a collaborative and international R&D team based in Frankfurt, working closely with colleagues in the USA and other global locations. You’ll be part of an agile group of frontend developers and UX designers, backed by experienced software architects and domain experts in physics and mathematics.

Responsibilities

- Collaborate with product managers and UX designers to translate user needs into intuitive UI features.
- Develop and design new software features for our engineering applications to meet key market and next-generation product goals.
- Maintain and enhance existing applications.
- Ensure high-quality code with automated testing and documentation.
- Contribute to code reviews and continuous integration processes.

Required Qualifications

- Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
- Solid experience with C++ and object-oriented software design.
- Proficiency in Qt Widgets for UI development.
- Understanding of modern software architectural principles.
- Professional-level fluency in English (spoken and written).
 
Desired Qualifications
- Strong analytical skills and the ability to understand and implement complex requirements.
- Effective communication and teamwork in multicultural environments.
- Familiarity with C# or Python.
- Experience with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD).
- Knowledge of CMake, Conan, or similar tools for dependency and build management.
  
Please Note the Work Model before applying:

While this position is not fully remote, Keysight offers a very flexible working arrangement designed to support productivity and work-life balance.

- During the initial onboarding phase, we expect a higher level of on-site presence to ensure smooth integration, collaboration, and access to team support.
- After onboarding, work location and hours will be defined through alignment with your manager and team structure.
- In general, a hybrid model with on-site presence 2–3 days every other week or every 2nd week is expected.

We value flexibility and trust our teams to coordinate in a way that supports both individual needs and team effectiveness.

About us7Learnings is one of the leading retail optimization platforms. We help retailers to optimize their pricing and marketing spend. Our solution uses advanced machine learning models to forecast demand for different price points with high accuracy. With our powerful self-learning algorithms, retailers can increase their profitability and revenues by up to 10%. We offer the most intuitive way to steer prices. Our prices simply maximize the business goals set by our clients. Our solution is easy to integrate and offers a high return on investment.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES THE WHAT
You develop and operate the test infrastructure for our aerospace components — from test method and test bench design to campaign execution, data evaluation, and traceable reporting. You bring a fresh engineering perspective to new projects and strengthen our validation capabilities with every campaign.

THE WHY
To end COPV failure in spaceflight.
Every composite pressure vessel that flies is proven on a test bench first. Testing is where design assumptions meet physical reality — burst, proof, cycle, and environmental campaigns generate the data that lets our customers trust their hardware in orbit. This role owns that proof.

YOUR IMPACT

You don't run tests. You deliver proof.

You ensure:
• every test campaign delivers reliable, reproducible data on schedule
• test benches and methods evolve with our products — not behind them
• results are documented so clearly that anyone can trace a data point back to its source

Important note: This role covers hardware testing and quality assurance of our COPVs and carbon structures. We are not hiring for Software QA or software testing positions.

Your tasks in detail and by priority:

Provide test infrastructure
Develop, build, and technically provision test methods and test benches — mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic setups including sensor and DAQ integration — to support product validation and qualification.
→ High Performance: Precision at speed. Test-ready when the hardware is.

Plan and execute test campaigns
Conceptualize, prepare, and run structured test campaigns (e.g. proof, burst, pressure cycling, or environmental testing) according to project and customer requirements. You own the campaign end-to-end.
→ Accountability: Your bench, your campaign, your data.

Evaluate measurement data and report with precision
Analyze measurement results, assess accuracy and reliability, and prepare comprehensive and fully traceable test reports. The data says what it says — you report it straight.
→ Candor: Honest data. Clear reports. No spin.

Drive engineering solutions
Approach testing challenges with curiosity and initiative — new fixtures, smarter instrumentation, and better methods. Testing is applied problem-solving, and you treat it that way.
→ Playfulness: Experiment on the bench, not in production.

Collaborate on-site
Work hands-on with design, manufacturing, and quality teams in Taufkirchen to close the loop between test results and product improvement.
→ Togetherness: Test data only matters if the whole team can act on it.

YOUR PROFILE Must-Haves
• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, Physics, or a related technical field.
• First practical experience (internships, thesis projects, or 1-3 years of professional experience) in hardware testing, test bench development, or an experimental engineering environment.
• Solid understanding of test methodologies and experimental setups, including practical experience with sensors, data acquisition (DAQ), and mechanical, hydraulic, or pneumatic test systems.
• Ability to critically evaluate measurement data and create clear, traceable documentation; experience with Python or MATLAB is a plus.
• Strong ownership mindset and the ability to drive technical topics forward in a structured and independent manner.
• Fluent English and a curious, hands-on mindset with a strong willingness to learn.

Nice to have
• Experience with composite materials or pressure vessel testing.
• Experience with LabVIEW, aerospace testing standards (e.g. ECSS), cryogenic testing, or measurement uncertainty analysis.

WHAT WE OFFER
• Choose your own benefit: Germany ticket, Egym Wellpass, or a tax-free Give Card
• Healthy & social lunch culture: Fresh meals during shared lunch breaks
• High level of autonomy & real impact: You own a critical seam in the business — between what we sell and what we build
• Startup mindset meets aerospace innovation: Flat hierarchies, fast decisions, and space for your ideas
• Stunning views: Rooftop terrace with views of the Alps in Taufkirchen, or indoor garden in Garching-Hochbrück
• Growth opportunities: Work on technically demanding projects with real stakes
• We live our team culture: From tech talks to team events and after-work gatherings — we celebrate success together

A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Resident Quality Engineer (f/m/d), you will spend your day working closely with suppliers, manufacturing teams, and cross-functional stakeholders to ensure product quality, production stability, and delivery performance. A significant portion of your role involves being on-site at supplier locations, leading quality escalations, supporting production recovery, and driving sustainable process improvements. You will analyze manufacturing challenges, coordinate corrective actions, conduct audits, and collaborate with engineering and operations teams to strengthen process capability and customer satisfaction. With approximately 25–30% travel, you will play a critical role in maintaining quality excellence across the supply chain.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Deployment to supplier sites as a dedicated quality escalation expert to stabilize production following critical quality, technical, or delivery issues
* Leadership of immediate containment activities to prevent defect escapes, protect customers, and maintain operational continuity
* Development and management of supplier recovery plans including action tracking, milestone management, accountability, and executive reporting
* Execution of root cause analyses, manufacturing process reviews, and quality audits to identify risks, process gaps, and improvement opportunities
* Definition, implementation, validation, and sustainability tracking of corrective and preventive actions to address both short-term and systemic issues
* Collaboration with supplier engineering, quality, and operations teams to improve process capability, product quality, manufacturing efficiency, and long-term performance

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline
* Extensive experience in quality management, manufacturing environments, supplier quality, and production process improvement
* Strong expertise in root cause analysis, problem-solving methodologies, Kaizen, supplier recovery activities, and critical manufacturing process assessments
* Proven ability to identify technical failure mechanisms, implement sustainable process improvements, and ensure long-term effectiveness of corrective actions
* Experience working in cross-functional and international environments, ideally with turbine hot gas components or other complex manufacturing technologies
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, and analytical skills, combined with fluency in German and English and willingness to travel approximately 25–30% to supplier locations worldwide

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and 
decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, 
steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, 
modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

About CF Assurance (CF A)
Our mission at Controlling and
Finance Assurance (CF A) is to provide objective, factual and independent
foresight to help Siemens be excellent and to improve the overall success of
the company. As a business partner to Siemens management, we leverage our
expertise in a wide range of topics in order to create an impact. We offer an
inspiring, diverse and inclusive environment for our people to develop
professionally and personally. Our core values – being respectful, curious,
humble and open – define how we work together as a department.
To deliver on our vision of
being pioneers in assurance and a talent incubator for Siemens, CF A offers a
unique Growth and Development Model. We believe in the concept of lifelong
learning and encourage our people towards continuous upskilling as a natural
part of their career. This is your chance to build your network within the
company and become part of a diverse, international and innovative team.
About CF A Internal Control (IC)
CF A Internal Control (IC) is
the central governance department for the internal control system at Siemens.
We create impact through the definition and continuous improvement of a
state-of-the-art internal control methodology and the support of our global
internal control community in applying it. In close collaboration with
corporate governance owners, we maintain a central repository of globally
harmonized control requirements (the ‘Policy and Control Masterbook’) as well
as our ‘Risk and Internal Control (RIC) Manual’ as the foundation for the
internal control process.
As Siemens transforms
into ONE Tech Company, our IC department plays a critical role in
ensuring robust Internal Controls across the enterprise, especially over
Financial Reporting (ICFR) and Sustainability Reporting (ICSR). We are at the
forefront of leveraging innovative technologies – including Generative AI – to enhance control effectiveness, drive automation, and support
Siemens' strategic growth levers.
We are looking for a
dedicated, results-oriented pioneer who leverages their expertise and inspires
others to give their best. You are comfortable challenging established
approaches and driving change where it creates value. Be bold and apply now to become a part of our CF Assurance Internal Control team in
Munich or Erlangen.
Accelerate your career and change the world of tomorrow with us.
What You'll Do:

- Drive Innovation with Generative AI (GenAI): Ideate, design, and
implement innovative use cases leveraging GenAI to
transform IC processes – covering ideas from automated control testing and
risk assessment to intelligent documentation and anomaly detection. You
will be a key driver in exploring how GenAI can enhance control
effectiveness, efficiency, and insights.
- Shape the Future of Internal Controls Methodology: Be part of the team responsible for the
effective yet efficient design of Siemens' Internal Control methodology, especially
for IT controls of systems relevant for financial reporting (e.g.,
ITGC/ITAC) and sustainability reporting.
- Own and Evolve the IC Framework: Take responsibility
for the IT Controls part of our Internal Control System (ICS) methodology
and update the RIC Manual to reflect new methodological
developments, regulatory requirements, and technological advancements.
- Enable and Empower the Global IC Community: Coach ICS
professionals throughout the world on all aspects of the internal control
system and become the primary contact for IT Controls methodology and
emerging topics like platform- and GenAI-driven controls.
- Develop and Deliver Training & Guidance: Create and deliver
Internal Control trainings, guidance materials, and presentations to
support the global rollout of methodologies and tools, fostering a culture
of continuous learning and excellence.
- Collaborate with the External Auditor: Align and discuss
Internal Control topics and methodology with the external auditor to
ensure compliance and best-practice alignment.
- Keep Management informed: Understand global
patterns regarding IT controls of the Siemens Group and evaluate control
deficiencies, leveraging data analytics and AI-driven insights where
applicable, and be confident to bring relevant topics into management’s
view.
- Contribute Beyond IC: Engage with the
broader CF Assurance function and expand your experience through
assignments as a guest auditor, contributing to the 'CF A innovation process', or supporting cross-functional transformation initiatives.

Your Profile for "Making the Future Possible":

- Strong Academic Foundation: Degree in business
administration, information systems, finance, or related studies, ideally
a master’s degree.
- Proven IC & IT Controls Expertise: Extensive professional experience in Internal Control (including ICFR) with
a focus on IT controls. You understand the role IT systems
like SAP ERP play in an ICFR control landscape and how systems enable IT
Application Controls (ITACs) and are protected by IT General Controls
(ITGCs).
- Passion for Innovation & GenAI: Strong interest and
ideally hands-on experience in Generative AI and its
application to business processes. You are excited to explore, ideate, and
pilot GenAI use cases that drive automation, intelligence, and efficiency
in internal controls and risk management.
- Curiosity for other relevant Technologies: Genuine interest in
topics like RPA, low-code apps, AI/ML, and their potential
benefits and challenges in ICFR and ICSR environments. You stay current
with technological trends and are eager to experiment and learn.
- Growth Mindset: You enjoy taking on
new challenges and growing with them. You thrive in ambiguity and are
comfortable pioneering new approaches.
- International & Intercultural Experience: Work experience in
an international business setting and intercultural collaboration is a
strong plus, reflecting Siemens' global footprint and diverse teams.
- Adaptability & Results Orientation: You impress with
your ability to adapt to a fast-growing, dynamic environment, your focus
on results, teamwork, and customer orientation.
- Excellent Communication Skills: Strong
communication skills in German and English (written and
spoken) to engage effectively with global stakeholders.
- Digital Proficiency: Very good MS Office skills and comfort working with digital tools and
platforms. Willingness and ability to quickly learn and adopt new
technologies is essential.

Why Join Us?

- Contribute to strategic initiatives around GenAI, digital business, and innovation in the context of internal controls.
- Work at the intersection of governance, technology, and innovation, shaping the future of internal controls in
a global technology leader.
- Access to continuous learning and development opportunities, including exposure to cutting-edge
technologies like GenAI, and the chance to grow your career across
Siemens.
- Join a diverse, international, and inclusive team that values curiosity, collaboration, and bold
thinking.

Ready to pioneer the future of Internal Controls? Apply now and make an impact with us!

Allianz SE has an in-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz SE does not accept unsolicited resumes from agencies or search firm recruiters.

Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

At Allianz, we stand for unity: we believe that a united world is a more prosperous world, and we are dedicated to consistently advocating for equal opportunities for all. And the foundation for this is our inclusive workplace, where people and performance both matter, and nurtures a culture grounded in integrity, fairness, inclusion and trust.

We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, social class, disability or sexual orientation, or any other characteristics protected under applicable local laws and regulations.

Join us. Let's care for tomorrow.

Who will you join?

Group Compliance - Investigations
About the role

Allianz Group Compliance is evolving its investigations function toward a more integrated, increasingly technology- and AI-enabled operating model. We are at the beginning of that journey. The primary requirement for this role remains hands-on experience in complex investigations. In addition, the role holder will help shape how the function adopts investigative technology and AI - pragmatically, and in a responsible, human-led way. We welcome candidates from an investigations, IT-forensics or legal-tech background who combine strong investigative capability with a genuine interest in developing this area.

How can you make an impact?

As an Investigator / Investigation Counsel, your responsibilities will include:

Investigations

- Member of the rapid-reaction task force to lead investigations on ad hoc Compliance issues
- Assess, prioritize, execute and lead complex compliance investigations
- Collaborate with Regions / Global Lines / other entities on delegated investigations
- Provide expert guidance and support to Compliance Officers at local, regional and global levels
- Monitor, follow-up and escalate issues as necessary, ensuring resolution and compliance
- Make effective use of investigative technology and, as it is introduced, AI-enabled methods (e.g. e-discovery, data analytics) to work efficiently and at scale, keeping human judgment at the centre
- Continuously enhance and share insights and lessons learned

Governance

- Develop and implement governance frameworks to support effective investigation processes
Review and update policies related to internal investigations and whistleblowing to ensure alignment with industry standards
Contribute to the further development of the investigations operating model, including the responsible integration of technology and AI as the setup matures  *  Provide guidance on governance issues related to internal investigations and whistleblowing to enhance organizational integrity

Awareness

- Contribute to initiatives aimed at elevating the awareness and effectiveness of the Whistleblowing program

Reporting

- Ensure comprehensive and accurate data entry into the Compliance Case Management Tool (CCMT)
- Develop and present detailed reports and presentations on Compliance investigations and related topics to senior management
- Analyze case data and CCMT usage to identify trends, providing strategic insights and reports where required
- Prepare responses to media requests and provide input to Sustainability reports, Audits and other similar / related information requests

Integrity Committee

- Fulfill obligations under the Integrity Committee Terms of Reference (both ad hoc and standing committees)
- Prepare and present Integrity Committee reports and minutes

What are you made of?

Minimum Qualifications

- Solid experience (3+ years) and proven competence in conducting and, increasingly, leading complex investigations effectively and efficiently, ideally with international exposure
- Strong expertise in remediation and mitigation measures in an international and multicultural environment
- Exceptional ability to communicate clearly and constructively with all levels, including senior management, within a multicultural organization
- Proven ability to learn, acquire and apply new knowledge and skills in digital and investigative methodologies, laws and regulations

Preferred Qualifications

- In-depth knowledge of the insurance business is an advantage
- Some practical, operational experience with investigative technology - e.g. e-discovery, data analytics, IT forensics or legal-tech tools - whether gained as an investigator, IT-forensics specialist or legal-technology professional
- Interest in helping build an AI-enabled investigation capability, with a pragmatic and responsible view of where technology adds real value;
- Strong communication and report-writing skills (fluent English required; additional languages a plus)
- Results-driven team player
- Willingness to work across time zones and travel internationally
- Strategic and innovative approach to working in a governance function
- High level of confidentiality and discretion
- Previous experience in insurance or asset management business functions, consulting, digital / tech is a plus
- Experience applying ChatGPT, Generative AI, and Ethical AI solution

Do we have what you need?

- Flexible and hybrid work model
- Multinational and inclusive community
- Great career development and learning opportunities
- Company pension and health insurance
- Employee stock purchase program with a discount
- Health and well-being offerings
- Supportive family care benefits
