jobs.occupation: PhD position (m/f/d) on immune reset through CAR T in chronic inflammatory diseases (Biologe/Biologin)
jobs.description:
State-of-the-art medicine and nursing care you can rely on! - Since being founded in 1815, Universitätsklinikum Erlangen has offered medicine of the highest standard and incorporated the latest insights from medical research and state-of-the-art equipment into diagnosis and therapy. More than 10.000 employees from approximately 50 different occupations are needed to provide the wide range of services offered by Universitätsklinikum Erlangen, ensuring our patients receive the very best care around the clock.

As a PhD student, you will investigate how human immune-cell networks shape tissue inflammation, regeneration and response to cellular therapies. The project will focus primarily on the human immune system and combine patient-derived material with experimental models to address mechanistic questions in cellular immunology.

Your tasks:

- Characterizing human immune-cell populations and their functional states using multiparameter flow cytometry and high-dimensional immune phenotyping.
- Investigating cellular interactions and immune networks by integrating phenotypic, functional and molecular data from immune cells and tissues.
- Studying immune responses to cellular therapies, including the mechanisms underlying immune depletion, reconstitution and tissue regeneration following CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.
- Generating and analyzing molecular data using approaches such as bulk and single-cell RNA sequencing and other transcriptomic or spatial technologies.
- Establishing and applying experimental models to investigate mechanisms identified in human samples, including selected mouse models of intestinal inflammation, immune reconstitution and tissue regeneration after CD19 CAR-T-cell therapy.
- Developing and combining experimental and analytical approaches ranging from established methods such as ELISA, Western blotting and flow cytometry to advanced multidimensional cytometry, UMAP-based analysis and transcriptomic approaches.
- The project offers substantial scope to develop an individual scientific profile. Previous experience with these techniques is welcome, but curiosity, scientific independence, willingness to learn, and enthusiasm for understanding how immune cells interact in human disease are similarly important.

Essential experience/ qualifications:

- Above the average motivation and work ethics
- Strong theoretical and practical background in standard methods of molecular and cellular biology as well as cellular immunology
- English writing and speaking skills
- Ability to work together in a multi-national team that is supportive of one another
- A master degree (M.Sc.) in immunology, biology, molecular biology, molecular medicine or equivalent

additional advantages:

- Experience in omics data science
- Hands-on experience in human immunology

We offer:

- The position is full-time and will be payed according to salary group TVL-E 13, 65% (DFG-typical rate)
- Intended pay grade depending on qualifications and personal requierements
- Initially, the position is limited for one year, with the possibility of an extension till the degreee is achieved
- The head of the department guaranties in writing that there is funding till the degree is achieved.
- Hiring process opened and will be completed asap.
- An enthusiastic, interdisciplinary team of scientists and doctors
- High end translational research
- State-of-the-art laboratories
- Two-Stepp mentoring with a hands-on mentor (post-doc) plus the PI as supervisor with high frequent project discussions for efficient development
- Structured program for hard- and soft-skills in research (paper and grant writing classes, paper clubs, soft-skill training)
- Notes for applicants (f/m/d) ( https://www.karriere.uk-erlangen.de/bewerbung/hinweise-fuer-bewerbende/ )
- Comprehensive health promotion offers
- All benefits of the public service incl. supplementary pension plan of the Versorgungsanstalt des Bundes und der Länder (VBL) (Federal and State Government Employees' Retierment Fund)
- Family-friendly enviroment

jobs.occupation: Head of Global Commodity Engineering Mechatronics 2 (f/m/d) (Betriebswirt/in (Hochschule))
jobs.description:
Job Posting: Head of Global Commodity Engineering Mechatronics 2 (m/f/d)
Transform the everyday.
This role is responsible for leading the global strategy, governance, and execution of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components across the entire supply chain. The individual ensures suppliers, manufacturing processes, quality standards, and material strategies are optimized for cost, quality, productivity, resilience, and sustainability while driving cross-functional collaboration between Procurement, Engineering, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Quality teams worldwide.
In short, this is a senior global leadership position focused on improving supplier performance, product quality, operational efficiency, and supply chain effectiveness throughout the lifecycle of mechanical and mechatronic materials and components.

What we offer you

- Flexible training opportunities for both your professional and personal development that you can tailor to your interests
- (Global) development programs that can be customized according to your wishes and ambitions
- Diverse health and wellness offerings
- A work environment where you can contribute with your whole personality and truly feel like part of Siemens

Since each of over 300,000 team members feels that other benefits are particularly important, and we cannot list our entire benefit portfolio here, you can find more information here.

The individual benefits are subject to regulatory, contractual, or corporate conditions.

How you will make an Impact with us

- You will be responsible for the global strategic direction of Material Lifecycle Management for mechanical and mechatronic components, including drawing-controlled parts, assemblies, manufacturing scopes, and supply chain investments.
- You will lead a team  (either directly or through collaboration models) and provide functional governance for local Material Lifecycle Management teams focused on mechatronics. You will ensure clear roles, standards, decision-making processes, and effective cross-site collaboration.
- You will develop and implement a global strategy for mechatronic parts, processes, and suppliers, focusing on standardization, technical feasibility, quality capability, supply chain resilience, sustainability, Total Cost of Ownership (TCO), and productivity.
- You will define supplier quality-related processes, methods, and standards for mechanical components and drive their global deployment, application, and continuous optimization across an international network.
- You will oversee preventive quality planning and industrialization readiness, particularly risk assessments, Process FMEA, Control Plans, Production Control Plans, First Article Inspection/PPAP, process audits, and release procedures for drawing-controlled purchased parts.
- You will establish a robust supplier problem management system with clear 8D governance, root cause analysis, effectiveness verification, lessons learned, claims management, and escalation procedures to sustainably reduce quality costs and recurring defects.
- You will further develop global and regional suppliers in collaboration with Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Logistics, and other partners, focusing on process capability, performance, technological expertise, capacity, risk mitigation, and ESG requirements.
- You will drive transparency, digitalization, and data-based management through supplier quality KPIs, audit and action management, quality cost tracking, risk dashboards, and standardized management reporting.
- You will identify productivity opportunities throughout the material lifecycle, including standardization, product variant reduction, make-or-buy optimization, value stream and supply chain analysis, cost and process improvements, and robust relocation and localization strategies.
- You will represent Mechatronics Material Lifecycle Management in global decision-making committees and ensure strategic contributions are integrated early into development, sourcing, investment, and production decisions.

What you bring

Leadership & Governance

- You bring extensive long-term leadership experience in global, multicultural organizations, including both direct people leadership and cross-functional management across sites, functions, and hierarchical levels. You are capable of developing teams, clarifying responsibilities, setting priorities, and driving organizational change effectively.

Mechanical & Mechatronic Components

- You possess a strong understanding of mechanical and mechatronic materials, especially drawing-controlled parts, manufacturing processes, tolerances, inspection concepts, process capability, industrialization, engineering changes, capital investments, and global supply chain risks.

Strategy, Digitalization & Productivity

- You have experience in strategy development, process standardization, digital reporting, data-driven decision-making, productivity programs, and leading complex transformation or optimization initiatives within international manufacturing and supplier networks.

Methodological Expertise

- Knowledge of quality and continuous improvement tools is advantageous, including:
- Process FMEA
- PPAP (Production Part Approval Process)
- 8D Problem Solving
- Ishikawa (Fishbone) Analysis
- 5 Why Analysis
- Pareto Analysis
- Process Audits
- Corrective Action Management
- Lessons Learned Processes
- Control Plans
- KPI and Performance Reviews
- Structured Escalation Processes

Communication & Collaboration

- You are recognized for clear communication, diplomacy, negotiation skills, and the ability to align Procurement, R&D, Manufacturing, Quality, Finance, and Suppliers toward common goals. Fluency in both German and English, along with willingness to travel globally to company sites and suppliers, completes your profile.

Languages: Fluent in English, additional languages are a plus

You are much more than your qualifications, and we believe in the potential of every single candidate. We look forward to getting to know you!

Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion in our Diverse Global Workforce. At Siemens, we are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that values your skills and provides equitable opportunities to progress. For us, competitiveness goes hand in hand with diverse teams and a shared sense of belonging. Our technology is powered by innovation, fueled by the diverse thinking and the unique merits of our people. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday, for everyone, together with us.

As an equal opportunity employer (https://www.siemens.com/en-us/company/about/social-commitments/belonging/) , we welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds and particularly encourage applications from persons with disabilities. In the case of equal qualifications, severely disabled applicants and applicants with equivalent status will be given preference.

About us

Siemens Digital Industries Automation (DI AUT) is one of the world’s leading providers of industrial automation. Our innovative automation portfolio enables companies of all sizes in both the process and discrete manufacturing industries to accelerate their automation—and thus their digital transformation—across the entire value chain. This allows our customers to increase productivity and flexibility and become future-ready through technologies such as software-defined systems and artificial intelligence. Siemens Xcelerator—the open digital business platform—helps to implement this more easily, quickly, and at scale. Together with partners and a broad ecosystem, Siemens supports its customers on their journey toward becoming a Digital Enterprise.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES The What: At Blackwave GmbH, we develop and manufacture high-performance carbon fiber components for airplanes, rockets, and satellites — pushing the limits of lightweight design and precision manufacturing. Our mission: To end COPV failure in spaceflight. The benchmark for performance, reliability and cost efficiency.

The Why: Because quality is the foundation of innovation. Every component we deliver must perform flawlessly under extreme conditions — in the air, in orbit, and beyond. As part of our Quality team, you ensure that our processes meet the highest standards, enabling us to turn cutting-edge ideas into flight-ready solutions.

Important Note: This role is focused on Quality Assurance of our hardware (COPVs). We are not currently hiring for Software Quality Assurance positions

• Project & Process Quality Assurance: You define and implement quality assurance strategies across the entire product lifecycle - from suppliers and development to serial production.
• Manufacturing & Process Quality: You accompany production on the shop floor, working closely with manufacturing teams to ensure quality requirements are effectively implemented at all production stations.
• Change Control: You support product and process changes, ensure quality requirements are considered and contribute to approval and implementation activities.
• Root Cause Analysis & Corrective Actions: You analyze quality deviations using structured methods (e.g. 8D, Ishikawa, 5-Why), derive sustainable corrective actions, and ensure their implementation.
• Continuous Improvement & Audits: You monitor key quality indicators (e.g. audit findings, non-conformities) and proactively drive continuous improvement of processes and standards.

YOUR PROFILE
• Training & studies - You have completed degree in engineering, quality management, production technology, or a comparable qualification
• Professional experience - You have relevant experience in quality planning and risk management, ideally in a manufacturing environment
• Analytical Thinking & Root Cause Analysis: You are skilled at identifying patterns, isolating root causes (e.g. using 8D, 5-Why, Ishikawa), and translating findings into actionable improvements
• Standards & Compliance Knowledge: You are familiar with applicable quality standards and their practical implementation, as well as experience with ISO9001
• Working Style & Mindset: You work independently, think in solutions, and enjoy deriving insights from quality data. You pursue excellence and value precision and reliability
• Language skills - Very good written and spoken English, German is also nice to have for collaboration between departments

WHAT WE OFFER
• Personal responsibility & creative freedom: You actively contribute to the further development of our production technologies.
• Flexible working hours & mobile working: Work-life balance is not an empty promise with us.
• Start-up spirit meets aerospace: flat hierarchies, short decision-making processes and room for innovation.
• Individual benefits: Choose between a Germany ticket, Egym-Wellpass or a tax-free benefit in kind with the Give Card.
• Fresh food every day: Shared lunch break with healthy, varied dishes.
• Alpine view included: Our roof terrace invites you to relax after work.
• Further development guaranteed: You will grow both professionally and personally through exciting projects and exchanges with experts.
• We live and breathe team culture: whether it's a tech talk, team event or after-work - we celebrate successes together.

About us Blackwave designs, manufactures and ships flight-qualified, commercial off-the-shelf composite overwrapped pressure vessels (COPVs) for launch vehicles and satellites. Founded in 2016 and headquartered in Munich, Germany, the company delivers COPVs from a standardized portfolio with flight heritage. The approach reduces lead time from months to days while ensuring that each tank is qualified and flight-ready. Blackwave's mission is to end COPV failure in spaceflight. The company employs more than 150 people across manufacturing facilities in Germany and Texas.More information at Blackwave.com and the procurement platform COPV.com.

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections,  where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

A healthier future. It’s what drives us to innovate. To continuously advance science and ensure everyone has access to the healthcare they need today and for generations to come.

Creating a world where we all have more time with the people we love. That’s what makes us Roche.

At Roche, we believe precision medicine radically improves lives. Our Global CAP/CLIA laboratories are the "heartbeat" of diagnostic innovation, bridging the gap between early research and life-saving commercial diagnostics. As a Laboratory Manager, you aren't just overseeing a facility; you are leading a team that transforms complex biological data into the insights clinicians need to treat patients with cancer and other life-altering diseases.

We are seeking a high-caliber Laboratory Manager (m/f/d) to oversee our dual-specialty pathology and immunoassay laboratory. This role requires a unique blend of technical expertise in tissue-based diagnostics and immunoassay automated testing.

You will be responsible for the operational excellence of the lab, ensuring that both the Histology/Pathology and Immunoassay/Chemistry departments function at peak efficiency while maintaining total compliance with ISO15189, CAP (College of American Pathologists) and CLIA regulations.

The Opportunity

You will oversee a dual-specialty laboratory at the forefront of the industry. Your leadership will span two critical domains:
* Anatomic Pathology: Managing high-complexity tissue-based diagnostics, including advanced Immunohistochemistry (IHC) and In Situ Hybridization (ISH)
* Immunoassay Excellence: Driving peaks of operational efficiency in our automated immunoassay tracks on state-of-the-art cobas® platforms

You will also be a key driver in our Digital Pathology transformation, integrating whole-slide imaging and AI-based image analysis into routine clinical workflows to set new standards for diagnostic precision. Your key responsibilities:

* Visionary Operational Leadership: Supervise the daily "rhythm" of the lab, synchronizing pathology and immunoassay workflows to ensure competitive turnaround times (TAT)
* Guardian of Quality: Maintain an "inspection-ready" culture, serving as the primary lead for CAP/CLIA and ISO 15189 audits
* Champion of People: Lead, mentor, and inspire team of Laboratory scientists, fostering a culture of continuous learning and technical excellence
* Strategic Technical Oversight: Manage the validation and implementation of new assays and novel platforms, ensuring every piece of equipment is a high-performing component of our diagnostic system
* Innovate & Improve: Actively identify opportunities for workflow optimization and cost-effective management without ever compromising the quality that defines the Roche name

Who you are
* You hold a Bachelor’s degree in Clinical Laboratory Science, Medical Technology, or a related Biological Science. A Master’s (MHA/MBA) or PhD is highly preferred.
* Furthermore, you have 5+ years of experience in a clinical laboratory setting
* Proven expertise in both anatomic pathology and automated immunoassay workflows is a distinct advantage
* The ideal candidate isn't just a technical expert; You are a leader who fosters a culture of quality, safety, and continuous improvement with at least 2 years of experience in a leadership role
* You live the Roche mindset by maintaining a track record of zero-deficiency inspections and a passion for navigating the complexities of emerging global regulations

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Fleet Performance & Reliability Manager H145 (d/f/m)

Are you looking for a cross-functional role with broad visibility across Airbus Support & Services? Do you want to shape the operability of future aircraft developments while driving in-service performance for world-class helicopter fleets?

In this role, you will focus on the Airbus H145—our market-leading, twin-engine multi-mission helicopter deployed worldwide for emergency medical services (HEMS), law enforcement, military, and offshore operations. Your key objective will be to optimize the operational reliability, availability, maintenance economics, and fuel efficiency of the global H145 fleet as well as upcoming helicopter developments.

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.

- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Manage Reliability: Define and maintain reliability benchmarks for the H145 fleet and new helicopter developments.
- Act as Key Interface: Serve as the central focal point for fleet data across program management, engineering, and suppliers.
- Analyze Fleet Data: Evaluate flight hours and failure rates to optimize operational availability and costs.
- Drive Product Improvements: Identify, analyze, and prioritize technical and maintenance improvement opportunities to reduce customer costs.
- Maintain Performance Metrics: Build and manage KPI dashboards covering maintainability, costs, and fleet availability.
- Support Bidding & Proposals: Provide realistic operational and cost data for RFQs, proposals, and customer projects.
- Harmonize Methods: Standardize data analytics methodologies and tools across different helicopter programs.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Aerospace Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
- Industry Experience: Professional experience in the aviation sector, preferably with helicopter systems knowledge.
- Analytical Mindset: Strong background in data analytics with an understanding of reliability and maintenance metrics (RAMT/DMC).
- IT Proficiency: Fluent with standard IT applications, databases, and reporting systems (ideally SAP BW).
- Skills: Proactive mindset with proven experience coordinating cross-functional activities and managing stakeholders.
- Business Acumen: Customer-centric focus combined with strong economic thinking and problem-solving skills.

As a Junior Technology Analyst (f/m/d), you will support the Technology Manager by gathering, structuring, and maintaining technology scouting intelligence across emerging technologies, startups, research developments, market signals, and innovation ecosystems relevant to Grid Technologies. Testability Engineer Eurodrone (d/f/m)

Testability as a discipline of RAMT, is the design effort to ensure that a system's condition and faults can be detected and isolated with minimal effort and time. It focuses on maximizing observability through sensors and interfaces and enhancing diagnostic capability through Built-In Test Equipment (BITE).

The mission of Testability is to maximize the visibility and transparency of a system's internal state through intentional design. A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Senior Negotiation Lead in the Corporate Strategic Procurement Department at Siemens Energy, you will play a crucial role in shaping and executing high-stakes negotiation strategies that drive value for the company. You will be the go-to expert for complex negotiations, providing both hands-on and strategic guidance to transform settings and outcomes. Each day, you will engage in impactful negotiations, optimize supplier agreements, and enhance procurement processes. Your expertise will directly influence our corporate procurement strategies, contributing to Siemens Energy’s mission of reimagining energy for a sustainable world. 

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Develop and execute negotiation strategies for complex supplier negotiations, driving cost optimization, cost recovery, risk mitigation, and improved commercial terms
* Lead critical supplier negotiations and provide strategic advice to Procurement leaders on objectives, trade-offs, escalation strategies, and outcomes
* Further develop the negotiation competence hub by establishing consistent negotiation standards, methodologies, and best practices
* Build negotiation capabilities across the organization through coaching, training, and knowledge sharing
* Translate negotiation outcomes and lessons learned into enhanced commodity, supplier, and procurement strategies
* Drive digital innovation and continuous improvement across the negotiation lifecycle, fostering a strong negotiation mindset and culture of excellence

What You Bring

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree or MBA is a plus.
* Extensive professional experience in strategic procurement and/or commercial negotiations, with a proven track record in complex, high-stakes environments
* Deep knowledge of negotiation principles and advanced methodologies, combined with strong commercial acumen and excellent analytical and strategic thinking skills.
* Outstanding communication, influencing, and advisory skills, with the ability to effectively challenge and engage senior stakeholders.
* Strong coaching and collaboration skills, with proven ability to build effective cross-functional and international networks and manage multiple priorities.
* Passion for digitalization and innovation, with experience in digital procurement and negotiation tools; fluency in English, with additional languages as an advantage.

About the Team

Our global Special Projects and Transformation team is part of Siemens Energy’s Corporate Commodity  Management organization. We partner with Procurement teams and businesses worldwide to deliver strategic  initiatives, strengthen capabilities, and transform how Procurement creates value.  You will join a collaborative and forward - looking team where diverse perspectives, ownership, and continuous learning are valued.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs

Serco is an international provider of services to governments and public organisations, operating across sectors where delivery, public confidence and reputation matter. In Europe, Serco works through both established Serco operations and specialist local businesses, combining international capability with a strong understanding of national requirements and operating environments.

European Homecare (EHC) in Germany and ORS in Switzerland are part of Serco and provide immigration and social care services in their respective markets. Each business has its own history, identity, workforce and stakeholder environment. Communications must therefore be locally relevant and sensitive to the nature of the services delivered, while supporting closer alignment with Serco’s standards, values, channels and wider European direction.

The European Communications team supports operations across 10 countries, four sectors and five languages. It provides strategic advice, shared standards and specialist support across internal communications, media relations, issues and crisis communications, digital content and reputation. This role is the senior local communications lead for EHC in Germany and leads internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, while working as an integral member of the European Communications team.

The postholder will have the autonomy to shape and deliver communications locally, working closely with local leaders and drawing on the expertise and support of the European Communications team. The role calls for sound judgement, curiosity and a practical approach to strengthening employee understanding, engagement and reputation as EHC and ORS continue their journey within Serco.

Key purpose  

- Lead communications for EHC in Germany across internal and external channels, ensuring communications are accurate, relevant and appropriate for a sensitive public-service environment.
- Own internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, helping leaders keep employees informed, engaged and connected to local priorities and Serco’s wider direction.
- Act as a trusted communications adviser to the EHC and ORS leadership teams, providing clear, practical and well-judged counsel, including in complex, sensitive or fast-moving situations.
- Build strong networks across the local businesses and Serco Europe, connecting people, expertise and information so communications are coordinated and effective.
- Support the continued integration of EHC and ORS within Serco, respecting their local identities while embedding Serco’s communications standards, governance, channels and values.

Structure and reporting relationship 

The role reports to the Customer Relations (CR) & Operations Director Switzerland. The postholder is also a core member of the European Communications team and works closely with the Director of Communications, Marketing and Public Affairs Europe and European Communications colleagues on priorities, standards, governance and delivery. The role operates with a high degree of independence and works closely with EHC leadership in Germany and ORS leadership in Switzerland.  

Internal Communications

- Own and deliver the internal communications plans for EHC in Germany and ORS in Switzerland, including print and digital newsletters, leadership updates, employee announcements, change communications and internal campaigns, working closely with local leaders and the European Communications team.
- Draft and distribute newsletters; act as an internal correspondent to identify and write impactful stories.
- Lead employee engagement initiatives aligned with Serco’s values and business priorities.
- Develop and maintain content for internal platforms.  

External Communications

- Lead day-to-day media relations in Germany and preferably Switzerland, including media monitoring, handling enquiries, preparing spokespeople and coordinating responses with European Communications colleagues when required.
- Lead local issues management and crisis communications preparedness, providing calm, practical and well-judged advice to leaders in sensitive or difficult situations.
- Produce clear written and visual content for external channels, including social media, in line with European Communications standards and priorities.
- Manage the German-speaking  website of Immigration Europe and related external digital content for Germany and Switzerland, in line with European Communications standards and approvals.

Integration Communications

- Contribute to integration plans following recent acquisitions, ensuring employees and stakeholders are informed and engaged.
- Apply strong change communications judgement, identifying how different audiences may respond to change and adapting messages, channels and engagement approaches to their needs and sensitivities.

Social Media & Content Creation

- Collaborate with the European communications team to source, create, and promote content that showcases services, people, and impact.

Stakeholder Engagement

- Build and sustain trusted relationships across operations, HR, corporate functions and leadership teams, creating effective networks within EHC in Germany, ORS in Switzerland and the wider European business.
- Represent the European Communications function locally. Act as a trusted communications adviser to EHC leaders in Germany across the full communications remit and to ORS leaders in Switzerland on internal communications, constructively challenging proposed approaches where reputational, employee or stakeholder considerations require it.
- For German-speaking market, develop and maintain strong working relationships with relevant media, partners, public authorities and other external stakeholders, supported by accurate and well-maintained contact information and external specialist partners.

Essential technical and professional skills, knowledge, and qualifications 

- Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
- At least seven years’ relevant communications experience, including substantial responsibility for advising senior leaders, managing communications independently and delivering through influence in a complex, matrixed organisation.
- Proven experience across internal communications, external communications, media relations, change communications and employee engagement.
- Strong change management and change communications acumen, with the ability to understand audience sensitivities, anticipate resistance and translate complex change into clear, relevant communications.
- Excellent planning and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands across two businesses and maintain consistent delivery.
- Demonstrable experience of working with journalists, handling media enquiries and advising spokespeople, with the judgement to manage sensitive or high-pressure situations.
- Strong digital communications capability, including confident use of Microsoft 365, SharePoint and content management tools.
- Ability to brief and manage specialist creative support when needed, ensuring outputs meet communications objectives and brand standards.
- Able to navigate a large, matrixed company while remaining pragmatic, visible and hands-on within smaller subsidiaries. Comfortable balancing accountability to a local operational leader with active membership of a European functional team, adapting style without compromising communications standards.
- Sound understanding of, or experience in, public services, immigration, social care, government or another sensitive, regulated operating environment.

Additional / special features of the role 

- Highly self-sufficient and dependable, with the judgement to set priorities, make sound decisions, escalate appropriately and maintain delivery without close supervision.
- Credible, politically aware and collaborative, with the interpersonal confidence to build networks, sustain trusted relationships and influence colleagues from operational teams to senior leadership.
- Inclusive and audience-focused, prepared to reach beyond familiar channels and proactively engage employees and stakeholders with different roles, backgrounds, levels of access and communications needs.
- Calm and resilient in demanding or ambiguous environments, able to handle sensitive issues, challenge constructively, protect confidentiality and maintain effective relationships during difficult situations.
- Tech-savvy and adaptable to new digital tools and platforms.
- Interested in the evolution of the immigration market in Europe, incl. the politicial impact on the business of the Sector Immigration Europe

Desirable

- Must: German native or fully proficient
- Must: English level B2
- Desirable: French
- Experience in regulated environments or public sector communications.

jobs.description:
Postdoc (m/f/d) – Translational Cancer Research | Gastroenterology 

Full- or part-time | temporary (36 months) | Klinik und Poliklinik für Innere Medizin II, Gastroenterologie

The Department of Internal Medicine II at TUM Klinikum rechts der Isar is recruiting a highly motivated Postdoctoral Researcher to join our newly established Max Eder Research Group.

Our research aims to decipher the molecular mechanisms of tumor evolution, cellular plasticity, and therapy resistance in gastric and gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma (GEAC). By integrating longitudinal patient samples from prospective clinical trials with cutting-edge multi-omics technologies and functional model systems, our group is committed to understanding the biological mechanisms underlying treatment resistance in upper gastrointestinal cancers and translating these discoveries into novel therapeutic strategies.

The position offers the unique opportunity to work at the interface of clinical oncology, cancer genomics, computational biology, and functional cancer research within an outstanding translational research environment.

Your responsibilities:

You will investigate the molecular mechanisms of tumor evolution, cellular plasticity, and therapy resistance in GEAC through the integration of longitudinal multi-omics datasets from prospective clinical trial samples. 

Your research will focus on computational analysis and interpretation of large-scale molecular datasets, including:

- Analysis and integration of single-cell and spatial transcriptomic datasets to characterize tumor evolution and treatment response
- Inference of tissue-specific gene expression and tumor activity from plasma cell-free DNA fragmentation patterns
- Development of computational approaches for the integration of genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic and immune profiling data
- Multi-omics integration to reconstruct tumor evolutionary trajectories and characterize cellular plasticity during treatment
- Development and implementation of bioinformatic pipelines for high-dimensional sequencing datasets
- Close collaboration with clinicians, biologists, computational biologists and international collaborators
- Presentation of research at international conferences and publication in high-impact scientific journals

Your profile:

We are seeking an ambitious computational scientist with a strong interest in translational cancer research and multi-omics data analysis.

Required qualifications

- PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Data Science, Biomedical Sciences, Cancer Genomics or a related quantitative discipline
- Strong experience in the analysis of next-generation sequencing data (e.g. transcriptomic and/or genomic datasets)
- Excellent programming skills in R and/or Python
- Experience working in Linux/Unix environments and using reproducible computational workflows
- Ability to independently design and drive scientific projects
- Excellent communication skills and proficiency in English

Preferred qualifications

Experience in one or more of the following areas is highly desirable:

- Cell-free DNA sequencing and fragmentation analysis (highly desirable)
- Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis and/or Spatial transcriptomics
- Multi-omics integration
- Machine learning or statistical modelling of biological datasets
- Cancer genomics and tumor evolution

We offer you:

- A postdoctoral position within a newly established and rapidly growing Max Eder Research Group funded by the German Cancer Aid
- An outstanding translational research environment embedded within TUM Klinikum rechts der Isar, one of Europe’s leading academic medical centers
- Close collaboration with internationally renowned research groups at the Institute of Cancer Research (ICR), Sutton, UK, and Chalmers University of Technology, Gothenburg, Sweden, including opportunities for scientific exchange and short-term research stays at both partner institutions.
- Direct integration with prospective clinical trials and longitudinal patient cohorts
- Close collaboration with physicians, computational biologists and internationally recognized research partners
- Strong mentorship and excellent opportunities for scientific independence and career development
- Support for national and international conference attendance
- Competitive salary according to TV-L
- EGYM Wellpass, corporate benefits, company pension scheme (VBL), cafeteria, sports and cultural offers
- Modern workplace in the heart of Munich with excellent public transport connections

We look forward to your application!

Job description

In order to support the Chief Engineering Eurodrone team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Eurodrone Overall RPAS Technical Manager (d/f/m)

Eurodrone Programme – Shaping the future of UAS

With its groundbreaking industrial and commercial setup and its unique certification and flexibility, European Medium Altitude Long Endurance (MALE) Remotely Piloted Aircraft System (RPAS) showcases how European industry can find innovative ways to support strategic autonomy needs and prepare for the Future Combat Air System. European MALE RPAS is not just the first programme to fully implement digital design manufacturing and services (DDMS). It is also seen as a ‘light-house’ programme, not only within Airbus, but also for the entire aeronautics industry in Europe.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Technically lead and direct the overall planning and implementation to ensure the readiness and conduction of Eurodrone Phase 1C activities across all contributing organizations - including top level planning of all maintenance and RPAS updates from an overall perspective:

- Secure Flight Test Readiness of the involved test centres in Germany, Italy and Spain (e.g., training, logistics, airworthiness, operations, resources, processes).
- Provide leadership, guidance and direction on any aspects related to the maintenance, preparation and future support of the Eurodrone test fleet, associated activities (including potential FTI updates).
- Lead the installation/maintenance of a strategic fleet program.
- Support program teams to produce all technical documentations for future options.
- Act as technical customer interface for GFx management and loan requests for the use of GFx assets.
- Priories and steers equipment, GSTE and FTI spares distribution across Test Centres (Benches and RPAS prototypes), including repair management and availability of export licenses in coordination with equipment management, procurement and logistic teams.
- Execute overall management of extant or potential Cross-Program conflicts
- As the Eurodrone Engineering focal point, provide and take full responsibility for Major Asset Activity Reporting (RPAS, Benches and Equipment/Spares for BT, GT, FT, DTIS and IDTTs), supporting the program and customer reporting process (status and issues).
- Lead lessons Learned, conflict resolution, and any other matter related to whole P1C activities, amongst others RPAS bench, ground or flight testing.
- Contribute to Overall RPAS BT, GT and FT tasks allocation, considering all technical & program constraints and project directives, risks, dependencies and opportunities and underwrite the agreed output and act as escalation point of the Flight Test Management Group in case arbitration between test centers needed.
- Ensure consistency between Test Program and Certification/Qualification Plans.
- Lead adaptation of contract, if and when required.
- Coordinates and chairs: BT, GT and FT Functional Reviews (e.g., IRR, TRR, VR, FFR, Co-TRR), integrated within the Eurodrone meetings cycle, providing Program and Customer Representatives full visibility of the status of each test program
- Provide guidance, advice, recommendations or other appropriate responses to Eurodrone Chief Engineer and Program senior management on:
- the status of the BT, GT and FT program
- the status of the Eurodrone test fleet
- issues relevant to maintaining the availability of the test fleet to support present and future Eurodrone contracts.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Master's degree in Aeronautical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical field.
- Minimum of 8 - 10 years of experience in Flight Test Management of multinational programs, preferably in the multinational Test Center environment.
- Minimum of 5 years of experience aerospace test and verification, with a strong focus on RPAS/UAS or complex aircraft systems.
- Proven experience in leading and managing technical teams in a demanding aerospace environment.
- In-depth knowledge of flight test methodologies, data acquisition systems, and flight test instrumentation.
- Strong understanding of aerospace safety regulations, airworthiness requirements, and certification processes (e.g., EASA, MIL-STD) with national airworthiness authorities.
- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
- Strong communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively interact with diverse stakeholders.
- Proficiency in German and fluency in English is required
- Spanish or Italian is a plus.
- Ability to travel as required for test campaigns and meetings.

jobs.occupation: Working Student for Engineering - Transformation and Change Management (d/f/m) (Ingenieur/in - Luft- und Raumfahrttechnik)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support the Engineering department, Airbus Helicopters is looking for a

Working Student for Engineering - Transformation and Change Management (d/f/m)

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of an Engineering Change Manager (d//f/m)?  Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the Engineering department as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Donauwörth
- Start: as soon as possible
- Duration: 24 months

Join us as a working student (d/f/m) in Engineering to actively support our transformation and change towards the Engineering of tomorrow. This role offers an exciting opportunity to support the top management and prepare our engineering for the future by implementing the latest design tools (incl. AI) in an international environment, contributing to the continuous improvement and evolution of our exciting products. In your job you will be able to bring in your creative solutions. You will be coached by experienced experts and top management of our company.

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation.
- Partial mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Traveling within Europe (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Assist in Transformation and Change projects for an international engineering function.
- Assist in the creation, preparation, documentation of workshops, events and roadshows for the leadership team and the engineering teams.
- Support the communication to the teams with creative formats (e.g. podcasts,...).
- Contribute to analyzing the effectiveness of the transformation initatives and identify gaps.
- Support the creation of inspiring presentations.
- Support in operative and administrative tasks.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled as a full-time student (d/f/m) in Business Administration, Industrial Engineering and Management, Work & Organizational Psychology, Human Resource, or a comparable degree program.
- Knowledge of—and ideally experience with—G Suite applications and Artificial Intelligence.
- Ideally, knowledge of and experience with Change Management.
- Strong interest in digital technologies and their application.
- Ability to work independently.
- Language skills: Fluent in English (written and spoken); German language skills are a strong advantage.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

#MYCYM

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

You work closely with engineering, suppliers, customers, and cross-functional project teams to deliver gas turbine auxiliary systems. Your day includes creating and updating engineering documentation, supporting project execution activities, and coordinating technical interfaces with internal and external stakeholders. You also contribute to the digitalization of engineering processes, support colleagues using SAP S/4HANA engineering-related modules, and ensure project requirements, quality standards, and supplier deliverables are met throughout the project lifecycle.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Responsibility for customer order engineering activities for gas turbine auxiliary systems
* Creation and maintenance of piping and instrumentation diagrams as well as preparation of engineering documentation, specifications, drawings, data sheets, and parts lists
* Support of data-driven project execution methods and implementation of digitalized engineering processes across multiple teams
* Provision of user support for engineering-related SAP S/4HANA applications and continuous process improvement initiatives
* Coordination of suppliers for engineering and manufacturing activities, including progress monitoring, quality assurance, documentation review, and acceptance inspections
* Clarification and coordination of technical interfaces with customers, suppliers, site personnel, engineering partners, and internal stakeholders

What You Bring

* Degree in process engineering, mechanical engineering, plant engineering, or a comparable engineering discipline, combined with professional experience in project execution
* Experience in at least one relevant engineering field and a strong understanding of engineering project environments
* More than 2 years of experience with SAP S/4HANA, including basic knowledge of Materials Management (MM) and Product Lifecycle Management (PLM)
* Passion for process simplification, automation, digitalization, and openness to new technologies and modern ways of working
* Analytical mindset, structured working approach, and ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks simultaneously
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, very good English language proficiency, and willingness to develop innovative solutions in interdisciplinary teams

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. Job description

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working student (d/f/m) in Strategic Procurement

Are you a full-time student (d/f/m) looking for a working student position and would like to familiarise yourself with the work of strategic procurement? Then apply now! We would be delighted if you could support us in Strategic Aerostructure Procurement as a working student (d/f/m) for approx. 15 - 18 hours per week!

- Location: Manching
- Start: Immediately
- Duration: Approx. 12 months

Around 60% of the value of the Airbus Products comes from our external supply chain, composed from thousands of suppliers all over the world. The Procurement function is therefore a key contributor to the sustainable profitability and to the technical innovation of Airbus.

Definition working student
Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.
This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.
Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location
Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- A final thesis is possible after consultation with the department.
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Traveling overseas or within Germany (team events) is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Support our Procurement team with projects in Strategic Purchasing

- During tendering e.g. by setting up Non-Disclosure Agreements, request and evaluate offers and preparation of selection reports.
- During the set-up & management of contractual agreements with suppliers.

Opportunity to develop project management skills

- Generate project plans and set up adequate reporting schemes.
- Analyses of relevant KPIs.
- Active risk management of the relevant procurement perimeter.

Collaboration with strategic buyers and internal customers.

- Support the definition and update of the commodity strategy with market research, data analysis and supplier operational and strategic excellence evaluation
- Planning and executing small improvement projects

Required knowledge and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the field of business administration, engineering or economics.
- Confident handling of MS Office or Google Suite.
- First practical experience desirable.
- Business fluent in English, German desirable, all other additional languages are welcome.
- You are a team player, communicative and have an independent way of working.

Please upload the following documents in English or German: cover letter, CV, relevant certificates, certificate of enrolment.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

- Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
- Excellent communication and documentation skills.

You are looking for a master thesis and want to get to know the work of a signal processing engineer for space systems? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the department Telecom & Navigation Processing as a Master student (d/f/m)!

- Location: Taufkirchen / Ottobrunn, near Munich
- Start: 01.10.2026
- Duration: 6 months

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria. Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Your tasks and responsibilities, Scope of Master’s Thesis

6G / 5G is giving the convergence of terrestrial and satellite-based networks a major boost. Under the keyword "Non-Terrestrial Networks (NTN)", satellites are being consistently integrated into the mobile communications standard for the first time, subsequently paving the way for a global and dense communication network in the future 6G generation.

Due to the inherent conditions of wireless communication – and particularly with the deployment of open standards and vast coverage areas – the threat posed by jammers and spoofers is ubiquitous. Specifically at the physical layer, the detection and suppression of malicious signals constitute an enormous challenge that must be overcome to ensure the integrity of the network.

The Master’s Thesis position will support the ongoing R&D activities on on-board implementation and scaling of a jamming robust gNodeB. The successful candidate shall contribute to one or more of the following fields:

- Sequence Analysis: Investigating the mathematical and statistical properties of different sequence designs in the context of NTN-specific channel conditions.
- Attack Modeling: Developing simulation models for various pilot-spoofing and jamming scenarios to evaluate their impact on signal integrity.
- Robustness Characterization: Analyzing how different sequence properties react to malicious interference through various performance metrics.
- Feature Identification: Identifying unique "signal signatures" or features that can be used to distinguish between legitimate and spoofed signals.
- Benchmark Development: Providing a comparative evaluation of sequence-based robustness to support the development of on-board detection algorithms.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled as a full-time student in Telecommunication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
- Strong foundation in Digital Signal Processing (DSP) and Communication Theory
- Proficiency in scripting and simulation using MATLAB or Python
- Basic understanding of OFDM waveforms
- Familiarity with communication standards (e.g., 3GPP, 6G/5G, or CCSDS) is a plus
- Excellent written and spoken English for technical documentation and communication; German is a plus.

As the Head of Governance & Digital Architecture for Grid Technologies you are the Strategist of the GT Digital Services organization. Your day will be spent deﬁning the strategic Digital Services roadmap for the Grid Technologies business area, establishing the architecture roadmap for the Grid Technologies business area, that guides our technology decisions, overseeing the respective project portfolio and driving the critical change management initiatives that underpin our transformation. You take care that the GT Digital Services roadmap and Cybersecurity strategy is fully connected and contributes to the GT Business Area priorities but also well aligned with the global Siemens Energy Strategy and roadmap. As the Enterprise Architect for Grid Technologies, you are the key orchestrator who ensures that all parts of the GT Digital Services activities are aligned and delivering maximum value to the business.

How You’ll Make an Impact
* You will be responsible for creating the strategic framework that enables the entire digital organization to succeed.
* Leading, inspiring, and transforming a high-performing team of experts in IT Architecture and Cyber Security, Data Enablement, and Change Management, as well as owning and continuously evolving the digital roadmap and IT governance framework for Grid Technologies, ensuring all activities are transparent and aligned with business objectives and SE standard.

You will identify and develop a tool that provide transparency on our GT processes, tools & applications as well as Data, aligning closely with the BS EQS team. You will support the cybersecurity community in increasing its skills.

* Strong business and ﬁnancial acumen with productivity mindset; C suite level communication and presentation; translation of complex business strategies into coherent technology roadmaps and investment portfolios with maximized ROI.
* Very strong experience as Enterprise Architect with exceptional strategic and communication skills. Broad and deep knowledge of IT architecture frameworks (e.g. TOGAL, ITIL etc) and modern technology trends such as AI embedment; expert level knowledge of Project & Portfolio Management principles, tools, and methodologies incl. simulation.
* Forward looking mindset and passion for emerging IT/OT technologies (e.g., Generative AI, Digital Twins, Edge Computing) with application in industrial contexts.
* Strong understanding of Data Governance and Cybersecurity Frameworks as well as Change Management methodologies; deep expertise in IT governance, strategic planning, and ﬁnancial management of a large, complex IT budget

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Mission Systems Equipment Design Responsible (d/f/m)

Your Mission

As Equipment Design Responsible, you will be the technical authority for airborne equipment throughout its entire lifecycle, for various weapon systems. You will transform operational and system-level needs into robust, certifiable equipment solutions, working closely with international suppliers and multidisciplinary engineering teams. You will ensure that equipment designs meet demanding performance, qualification, and certification requirements while supporting integration, testing and in-service operations. This role offers a unique combination of design responsibility, technical depth and direct influence on the successful delivery of advanced airborne capabilities.

Your location (Manching)

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and special payments
- 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great international, group wide development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, subsidies for public transport, employee benefits at cooperating companies
- On-site-facilities: Medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteen and cafeterias, kindergarten close to the site
- Compatibility of family & work (part-time models, flexible working hours, individual timeout)
- Networking and connection: Employee events, groups and initiatives
- Working in a diverse environment, with more than 140 nationalities, where every voice is heard

Your Tasks and Responsibilities

- Own the technical responsibility of airborne mission systems equipment throughout the full development lifecycle, including in-service support activities.
- Preparation and validation of Equipment technical specification and other contractual documents. Managing equipment requirements from higher-level system architecture and customer specifications down to equipment-level allocation.
- Technical management of suppliers of airborne equipment: technical evaluation, design and qualification follow up, milestones management, stages of involvement, validation and acceptance of deliverables, management of limitations and deviations, support to defect investigations and repairs, harmonization and control of supplier and program plans.
- Review technical solutions, challenge design decisions when necessary, and support issue resolution during development and integration phases.
- Ensure compliance with applicable aeronautical and contractual standards and certification requirements (e.g. DO-254) during the design and qualification, repair, obsolescence and re-design activities.
- Coordinate multidisciplinary engineering activities with internal specialists (safety, EMC, environmental qualification, RM&T, Quality, ILS, Airworthiness,…).
- Interface with customers, partner companies and certification authorities for technical matters related to equipment functionalities, design, qualification and problem resolution.
- Monitoring and support of the subsequent Equipment Integration including Sub-system, system verification and flight tests.
- Support requests concerning Equipment queries, in service occurrence reports and defect investigations.

Your Profile:

- (Master) Degree in electronics/electrical engineering, aerospace engineering, or equivalent
- At least 3-5 years of professional experience
- Strong technical background in electronic equipment development: embedded electronics (Microcontrollers, FPGAs, ASICs,... ), mission computers, high-speed digital interfaces, video or data processing systems, real-time embedded architecture,...
- Knowledge and practical expertise with airborne equipment:
- Qualification and certification
- Hardware development/design and verification (e.g. DO-254, ARP4754A, AMC 20-152A, DO-160, MIL-STD-810)
- Software development (DO-178) is considered a plus
- Ability to technically assess supplier solutions and support problem-solving activities during development
- Experience in technical supplier management is a plus
- Experience in requirements engineering and requirements management tools (DOORs) is a plus
- Comfortable taking ownership and making technical decisions
- Strong communication skills and ability to interact with suppliers, customers and authorities in an international environment
- Teamplayer and comfortable in international and multidisciplinary engineering environment: demonstrated skills to work independently and in a collaboratively manner within an international team, including the ability to coordinate and influence people
- Business-fluent English, German is a plus
- Willingness to travel internationally to supplier facilities and customer sites when required

Job description

In order to support our Computer Vision Team, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for a

Working Student (d/f/m) Mission Systems

You are a full time student (d/f/m), looking for a working student position and want to get to know the work of our Computer Vision team? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us as a working student (d/f/m) with approx. 18 hours a week!

- Location: Manching
- Start: Juli 2026
- Duration: 12 months

Definition working student

Working students are students who are enrolled at a University or some other institution of higher education, and who are employed in a reasonably long, fixed-term position parallel to their studies. This position must not be confused with an internship or with the possibility of writing a final thesis.

This employment usually takes place directly on the company's premises. A working student's main focus remains on their studies, which is why, during term-time, working students are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week.

Working students therefore usually work near their place of study, so as to conveniently combine studying and employment.

Your location

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with an 18-hour week (flexitime).
- Mobile working after agreement with the department.
- Traveling within Germany is possible after consultation and agreement from the department.
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Support for training of vision AI models.
- Benchmarking and optimization.
- Investigate state of the art vision technologies.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) within Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence or a similar field of studies.
- Programming skills in Python are mandatory.
- Programming skills in C/C++ or Java is desirable.
- Drone piloting licence A1/A3 would be desirable.
- Fluent in German or English.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!
